title: Automotive Technician
description:
2 positions · Troubleshooting · Test setups · New components · R&D

Do you enjoy figuring out why something does not work? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two technicians who want to troubleshoot electric vehicles and machines, set up test setups and take part when we develop and test new components. You do not need many years of experience. What matters most is that you are hands on, curious and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We develop and produce conversion kits for authorised dealers and end customers, and we work with everything from vans to heavy off highway machines such as dumpers and excavators. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

The job

You will join our technical team in R&D and work closely with engineers, software developers and mechanics. You will be where things are tested and tried out in practice. One day you are troubleshooting a van, the next you are helping build a test setup for a new component. The work is mainly based in Dragør, but tasks at other locations may occasionally come up.

Your tasks will include:

•       Troubleshoot electrical systems and wiring harnesses on vehicles and machines

•       Set up and maintain test setups, both on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Help test new components and get them installed and integrated

•       Use diagnostic tools and CAN logs to find faults

•       Support engineers and software developers with the hands on work during testing

•       Document faults, solutions and test results so the rest of the team can use them.

Is this you?

You may be newly qualified or have a few years of experience from a workshop or similar. We care more about your troubleshooting skills and willingness to learn than about how long you have been in the trade.

•       Trained as a car mechanic, mechatronics technician, truck mechanic, construction machinery mechanic, electrician or similar

•       Experience with electrical troubleshooting on vehicles or machines

•       Comfortable using a multimeter and diagnostic equipment

•       Hands on, systematic and good at keeping things organised

•       Curious and quick to learn new things

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you know some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN, SavvyCAN or similar

•       Electric or hybrid vehicles, or high voltage systems

•       A driving licence for larger vehicles.

What we offer

•       A varied job on many different vehicles and machines

•       The chance to learn a lot about electric vehicles, CAN and high voltage

•       Close collaboration with engineers and software developers, where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Access to test equipment and modern diagnostic tools

•       An informal team in a growing startup

•       Good facilities, shared lunch and easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Number of positions: 2

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

•       Department: R&D

•       Location: Mainly on site in Dragør, with some flexibility by agreement

•       Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines about yourself and your troubleshooting experience to louie@ren-teq.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Louie Lucas Bisgaard Nyeland at louie@ren-teq.com or +45 27812385.

title: Battery Technology Lead
description:
Are you passionate about battery technology? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for someone to lead our testing of battery cells and modules, and to make us ready to switch quickly when new battery technologies reach the market. Many years of experience is not the most important thing. What matters most is that you have a solid background in battery technology, from either work or studies.

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We develop and produce conversion kits for authorised dealers and end customers, and we work with everything from vans to heavy off highway machines. You will have the main responsibility for our battery testing and for making us ready for new cell types, formats and suppliers. You will also be an important technical voice when we decide how batteries are used in our systems. You will be part of R&D and work closely with our engineers.

Is this you?

title: Automotive Software Engineer
description:
2 positions · Electric vehicles · Broad profile · R&D

Do you want to help create software that runs in real vehicles in your very first week? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two software people who are curious, learn fast and want to try their hand at a bit of everything. You do not need to be a specialist or have many years of experience. What matters most is that you are adaptable and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We convert everything from vans to dumpers and excavators, and all the vehicles run on control software we develop ourselves. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, a small team, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

What is it like to work with us?

Our software developers are never far from the product. The workshop is right next door, and the changes you make in the morning can be tested in a vehicle in the afternoon. We are a small team where everyone helps each other, and you will quickly work closely with engineers, mechanics and management.

We do not expect you to know everything from day one. You will get time to learn our system, and support from colleagues working with CAN, embedded software, high voltage and testing. In return, we expect you to be curious, ask questions and be keen to get stuck in.

The job

You will start by getting to know our system: how the vehicles are controlled, how the software is structured, and how it all ties together with CAN and hardware. After that, you will become part of the daily software work and help develop the system further. Our control software is currently built in Simulink, and we are moving parts of it to C/C++, so you will work with both.

Your tasks will include:

•       Get to know our control software and how it works together with the vehicle

•       Flash and test software on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Test new components and help integrate them into the system

•       Debug using CAN logs and measurement data

•       Help develop new features and improve existing ones

•       Document what you learn and build so the rest of the team can use it too.

Is this you?

We are looking for broad profiles rather than specialists. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of experience. What matters most is that you have a good foundation and a desire to learn.

•       A degree in software, electronics, mechatronics, automation or similar, or equivalent experience

•       Programming experience, for example C, C++, Python or Matlab

•       Curious, adaptable and quick to learn new things

•       You enjoy hands on work and seeing things work in real life

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you have tried some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       Simulink or Stateflow

•       Embedded software or microcontrollers

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN or Vector

•       Electric vehicles, batteries or high voltage systems

•       Git.

What we offer

•       A job where you see your software running in real vehicles on the road and on construction sites

•       A fast-paced professional development opportunity with broad insight into software, hardware and electric vehicles

•       A small, informal team where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Varied tasks on many different vehicles and machines

•       The opportunity to grow with the company and shape how we build our software going forward

•       Workshop and offices in Dragør with easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

title: Tender Manager, Renewable Offshore Services; Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus, UK - Grimsby
description:
Are you motivated by turning complex customer requirements into competitive and commercially robust proposals? Do you thrive on creating structure, coordinating specialists, and driving tender processes from opportunity to contract award? Then you could be our new Tender Manager.Your position As our new Tender Manager, you will play a key role in securing renewable offshore service opportunities, with a particular focus on offshore wind. You will lead the complete tender lifecycle, from initial qualification and bid strategy through proposal development, internal approval, submission, clarification, negotiation, and handover to project delivery. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and HSEQ, you will bring together the right expertise and turn complex requirements into clear, compliant, and customer-focused solutions. You will create structure throughout the process, maintain tender governance, manage commercial risks, and ensure that every submission is delivered on time and to a high standard. In this full-time position you will report to the Sales Director, Service. Your place of work will be Esbjerg, Aarhus, Copenhagen or Grimsby, UK and travelling for customer meetings, site visits, negotiations, and other tender-related activities should be expected. At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity throughout all tender activities.Your tasks & responsibilities As Tender Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering assigned tenders while ensuring clear ownership, effective collaboration, disciplined governance, and alignment with our commercial objectives. Your tasks will include, but are not limited to:
  • Leading renewable offshore service tenders from qualification and bid/no-bid assessment through submission, negotiation, award, and structured handover.
  • Establishing tender strategies, plans, timelines, responsibilities, review gates, and communication routines across the bid team.
  • Coordinating technical, operational, commercial, contractual, procurement, finance, and HSEQ contributions into coherent and compelling proposals.
  • Managing pricing inputs, assumptions, exclusions, compliance, risks, opportunities, clarifications, and internal approval processes.
  • Preparing and quality-assuring customer-focused submissions while capturing lessons learned and contributing to the continuous improvement of tender processes, tools, and content.
Your profile & qualifications We are looking for a commercially aware and structured tender professional who enjoys bringing people and specialist disciplines together around a shared deadline. You take ownership, maintain an overview when the process becomes complex, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at different levels of the organisation. You combine attention to detail with the ability to understand the bigger commercial picture. You are comfortable challenging inputs, following up on deliverables, and ensuring that the proposed solution is both competitive and operationally achievable. To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have: 
  • Relevant experience in tender or bid management within offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, oil and gas, engineering, or technical services. 
  • Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary tenders involving several internal and external stakeholders. 
  • A strong understanding of tender governance, compliance, cost estimation, pricing, contractual risk, approvals, negotiations, and handovers. 
  • Excellent written English and strong communication, editing, planning, and stakeholder-management skills. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant tender, CRM, document-management, or collaboration platforms. 
Additional languages relevant to our key markets will be considered an advantage. Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

  • Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

  • Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

  • Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

  • Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

  • Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

  • Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

  • A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

  • First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

  • Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

  • Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

  • A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

  • The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

  • Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

  • Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

  • Practical experience with target trial emulation.

  • Experience in international research collaborations.

  • Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

Application deadline

November 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Interviews

Interviews are expected to take place in early December 2026.

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Hospitalsringen 90, 5260 Odense S.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

  • Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

  • Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

  • Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

  • Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Works independently and takes a structured approach

  • Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

  • Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

  • Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

  • Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

title: Studieadjunkt i bygningskonstruktioner til Bygningsingeniøruddannelsen ved AAU Energi Esbjerg
description:
Vil du være med til at uddanne fremtidens diplomingeniører inden for byggeri og anlæg, hvor konstruktioner, bæredygtighed og energioptimering tænkes sammen fra første semester? På Campus AAU Esbjerg får du en central rolle i undervisning, vejledning og koordination på bygningsingeniøruddannelsen i et tæt fagligt miljø med korte veje mellem undervisere og studerende. Stillingen er en varig fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Dine arbejdsopgaverSom studieadjunkt i bygningskonstruktioner bliver du en nøgleperson i udviklingen af bygningsingeniøruddannelsen på Campus AAU Esbjerg. Uddannelsen er forankret i Institut for Energi, og du bliver derfor en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor byggeri, energi, klima og bæredygtighed tænkes sammen på tværs af kursusaktiviteter og projektforløb. Bygningsingeniøruddannelsen i Esbjerg giver de studerende mulighed for at arbejde både eksperimentelt og digitalt, herunder med numeriske beregninger f.eks. FEM.

En væsentlig del af din hverdag kommer til at bestå af vejledning af diplomingeniørstuderende på bygningsingeniøruddannelsen fra første til syvende semester. Du følger hold og projektgrupper tæt, giver faglig og metodisk sparring og hjælper de studerende med at koble teori om konstruktioner, materialer og belastninger til konkrete ingeniørprojekter. I vejledningen indgår både den generelle udvikling af de studerendes ingeniørfaglige dømmekraft og arbejdet med specifikke problemstillinger inden for bygningskonstruktioner i beton, stål og træ.

Stillingen omfatter desuden faglig ansvarlighed i relation til konstruktionsingeniørprofilen, hvor der arbejdes med statisk kontrol af etagebygninger, stålkonstruktioner, betonkonstruktioner og trækonstruktioner. Du vil bidrage til, at de studerende lærer at tilrettelægge og dokumentere statiske beregninger i overensstemmelse med relevante standarder og normer, og du vil indgå i dialogen om, hvordan bæredygtighed, klimahensyn og energioptimering tænkes ind i projekteringen af bygningskonstruktioner.

En central del af jobbet er koordinering på tværs af uddannelsens semestre. Du medvirker til at skabe sammenhæng mellem kursusaktiviteter, projektarbejde og praktik, så uddannelsens faglige progression bliver tydelig for både studerende og undervisere. Det indebærer blandt andet semestrets planlægning, løbende opfølgning i semesterforløbet og samarbejde med kolleger om justeringer og udviklingstiltag. Derudover får du ansvar for praktikkoordinering, hvor du bidrager til dialogen mellem uddannelsen, de studerende og virksomhederne om indholdet i praktikforløb og om samspillet mellem praktik og resten af studiet.

Afhængigt af din faglige profil kan der også indgå konfrontationsundervisning i centrale kurser inden for konstruktion, for eksempel statik og styrkelære på både grundlæggende og videregående niveau, kurser i last og sikkerhed, bygningsmaterialer, betonteknologi og -konstruktion samt emner relateret til spændbeton, elementbyggeri og midlertidige konstruktioner. Her vil du arbejde med at skabe sammenhæng mellem de analytiske beregninger, materialeforståelse og de praktiske forhold, som konstruktionsingeniører møder i praksis.

Hvis du har interesse og dokumenteret erfaring inden for forskningsområder relateret til byggeri og risikobaserede tilgange, vil der kunne åbnes for en kobling til forskningsaktiviteter. Det kan for eksempel være emner som robusthed og modstandsdygtighed i den byggede masse, risikobaseret drift og vedligehold, samspil mellem livscyklusvurdering, økonomi og ”resilience” eller mere specifikke problemstillinger i relation til konstruktioner, klima og energiforsyning. Omfanget heraf vil afhænge af din profil og instituttes behov.

Dine kompetencerDu har en uddannelsesbaggrund som bygningsingeniør på kandidatniveau eller civilingeniørniveau, eller du kan på anden måde dokumentere en faglig tyngde, der svarer hertil. Du har solid erfaring som konstruktionsingeniør med statisk dokumentation af bygningskonstruktioner, og du er vant til at arbejde systematisk med normer, standarder og projekteringsgrundlag. Det er vigtigt, at du kan dokumentere flere års relevant erfaring med statisk dokumentation, som typisk vil svare til arbejde på niveau med en statiker i konstruktionsklasse 2.

Du har flere års erfaring med statiske beregninger, herunder bestemmelse af laster og lastnedføring, grænsetilstandsberegninger og dokumentation af enten etagebygninger eller brokonstruktioner. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt med opbygning af beregningsmodeller og dokumentation af resultater, og du er fortrolig med at omsætte komplekse tekniske krav til robuste og forståelige løsninger. Har du erfaring med betonteknologi og grænsetilstandsberegninger i beton, vil det være en klar fordel. Det samme gælder erfaring med træteknologi og beregninger i træ samt eventuel erfaring med funderingsberegninger og anvendelse af geotekniske forundersøgelser.

Kendskab til og anvendelse af metoder baseret på FEM i forbindelse med statisk dokumentation af etagebygninger eller brokonstruktioner vil være meget relevant i stillingen. Du er tryg ved at bruge digitale beregningsværktøjer som en integreret del af dit arbejde og kan hjælpe de studerende med at forstå både muligheder og begrænsninger ved sådanne værktøjer. Samtidig har du en interesse i, hvordan bæredygtighed, klimahensyn og energioptimering kan indarbejdes som naturlige parametre i projekteringen af bygningskonstruktioner.

Det er en forudsætning for stillingen, at du kan undervise, vejlede og eksaminere på dansk. Du kan formidle komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en måde, der gør det muligt for studerende at opbygge både forståelse og sikkerhed i faget, og du er nysgerrig på, hvordan undervisning, øvelser og projekter kan udvikles, så de afspejler ingeniørarbejdet i praksis.

Som person trives du med at have tæt kontakt til studerende og kolleger, og du har lyst til at tage et samlet ansvar for undervisningsforløb, semesterkoordinering og praktik. Du arbejder struktureret og kan skabe overblik på tværs af kurser, projekter og årgange, og du følger opgaver til dørs i et miljø, hvor der er mange parallelle aktiviteter. Du bidrager konstruktivt til samarbejdet i det lokale fagmiljø og er villig til at dele viden og erfaringer, så uddannelsen og de studerendes læring hele tiden kan udvikles.

Hvem er viDu bliver en del af bygningsingeniøruddannelsen på Campus AAU Esbjerg, som er forankret i Institut for Energi ved Aalborg Universitet. Uddannelsen er kendetegnet ved et tæt og overskueligt studiemiljø, hvor der er kort afstand mellem studerende og undervisere, og hvor der er gode muligheder for løbende dialog om både det faglige indhold og tilrettelæggelsen af undervisningen. I det lokale miljø indgår du i et samarbejde med kolleger, der både har erfaring fra praksis og fra universitetsverdenen, og som har et fælles fokus på at uddanne ingeniører, der kan løse konkrete udfordringer i byggeriet.

Miljøet på Campus AAU Esbjerg er præget af et tæt samarbejde mellem forskellige uddannelser og forskningsområder inden for energi, byggeri og relaterede tekniske felter. Det giver gode muligheder for at trække på erfaringer og perspektiver på tværs af faggrupper, og for at udvikle undervisningsforløb, hvor de studerende arbejder med problemstillinger, der går på tværs af klassiske faggrænser. Uddannelsen arbejder løbende med at inddrage forsøg, laboratorieaktiviteter og digitalisering i undervisningen.

Som medarbejder på Campus AAU Esbjerg får du et arbejdsliv, hvor der er fokus på både kvalitet i undervisningen og på et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv for medarbejderne. Planlægningen af undervisning og vejledning sker med blik for at skabe sammenhæng mellem kursusaktiviteter, projektarbejde og perioder med forberedelse, så der i de mindre undervisningstunge perioder også kan være mulighed for koncentreret fordybelse i udvikling af undervisning eller andre opgaver. Du bliver samtidig en del af Aalborg Universitet som helhed, hvor der er adgang til pædagogisk opkvalificering, adjunktforløb og kollegial sparring på tværs af campusser og institutter.

Kvalifikationskrav Kvalifikationskravet til stillingen er en kandidateksamen eller kvalifikationer på tilsvarende niveau. Der skal desuden foreligge en positiv bedømmelse af ansøgerens undervisningskvalifikationer. Ansøgning Din ansøgning skal indeholde følgende:  

  • Ansøgning, hvori begrundelser for at ansøge, kvalifikationer i forhold til stillingen samt intentioner og visioner for stillingen angives 
  • CV  
  • Eksamensbeviser (Kandidatbevis) 
  • Dokumentation for undervisningsmæssige kvalifikationer. 
  • Publikationsliste (valgfri) med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, du ønsker tages i betragtning ved bedømmelsen. Du må maksimalt vedhæfte 5 publikationer.

Du kan læse mere om krav til din ansøgning her.  

Ansøgning sendes via Aalborg Universitets rekrutteringssystem, som kan tilgås under stillingsopslaget på Aalborg Universitets hjemmeside. 

Aalborg Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og har diversitet som en kerneværdi. Derfor opfordres alle uanset personlig baggrund og orientering til at søge stillingen.   Har du spørgsmål?  Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os. Se kontaktpersoner nederst i opslaget. 

Øvrige informationer  Du kan læse mere om vores rekrutteringsproces her.  

Vi anbefaler, at du gemmer en kopi af stillingsopslaget, da opslaget bliver fjernet, når ansøgningsfristen er udløbet. 

Ansættelsesprocessen på Aalborg Universitet indebærer en shortlistingsproces. Du kan læse mere om det her. 

Ansættelsesprocessen på Aalborg Universitet kan omfatte en risikovurdering som et værktøj til at identificere potentielle risici forbundet med nyansættelser, der sikrer arbejdspladsens sikkerhed, compliance og integritet.  Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Ansættelse sker i henhold til bekendtgørelse om ansættelse af videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter og bekendtgørelse om stillingsstruktur for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter samt protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter. 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til overenskomst for akademikere i staten og protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.  Der er 3 måneders gensidig prøvetid i stillingen.

Aalborg Universitet - Viden for verdenAalborg Universitet er en international arbejdsplads med mere end 3700 ansatte. Vi udbyder virkelighedsnære uddannelser og skaber forskningsresultater i verdensklasse gennem samarbejde mellem forskere, studerende og offentlige og private virksomheder. Sådan opnås erkendelser, nye løsninger på samfundets problemer og viden, der forandrer verden. Vores hovedcampus ligger i Aalborg, men vi har også campus i Esbjerg og København.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description: Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksBattery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

title: PhD in Quantum Computing for Power Systems
description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from December 1, 2026, or as soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksThis PhD position focuses on the application of quantum computing to computational challenges in power systems with high shares of renewable energy. You will investigate quantum and hybrid quantum–classical methods for power system analysis and optimization, with emphasis on their practical performance and suitability for real-time applications.

Your work will include formulating representative power system analysis and optimization problems, developing and implementing quantum and hybrid quantum–classical solution methods, and comparing their performance with relevant classical approaches. You will also evaluate the developed methods through numerical studies and real-time power system simulation. The research will involve scientific programming, analysis and documentation of results, and dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and international conferences.

The position is offered within the Center for Research on Microgrids, and the PhD student will be affiliated with the Electric Power Systems and Microgrids section at AAU Energy.

Your competencies The applicant must have a relevant educational background in electrical engineering, energy engineering, computer science, or a closely related field. You should have a solid foundation in mathematical modelling and numerical methods, together with experience in scientific programming, preferably in Python. Knowledge of power system analysis and optimization (e.g., power flow and optimal power flow), as well as experience with quantum computing methods and algorithms (e.g., HHL or variational quantum linear solvers for linear system problems, and QAOA or quantum annealing for optimization problems), is expected.

Experience with real-time power system simulation using platforms such as RTDS or OPAL-RT would be an advantage. Previous peer-reviewed journal publications at the intersection of quantum computing and power and energy systems would also be considered an advantage. You should be motivated to further develop your expertise across both power systems and quantum computing.

You should be able to organize and conduct research independently, document and communicate your methods and results clearly, and discuss technical challenges constructively with colleagues. The position requires both independent research and collaboration with researchers from different disciplinary backgrounds, as well as good written and spoken English.

title: Senior Signal Processing Engineer – Acoustics & DSP
description:
Triton Depth | Copenhagen, Denmark | Full-time

About Triton Depth

Triton Depth is a Danish defence technology company developing advanced maritime sensing and surveillance technologies.

We bring together expertise in electronics, embedded systems, signal processing, and artificial intelligence to develop innovative solutions for some of the most challenging problems in maritime security.

We are a fast-growing, multidisciplinary engineering team working on technologies with real-world applications in defence and critical infrastructure protection.

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Signal Processing Engineer with a strong background in digital signal processing (DSP), preferably specializing in acoustics.

You will work on complex signal-processing challenges, developing algorithms that extract meaningful information from real-world acoustic data. Your work will involve advanced mathematical modelling, spectral analysis, filtering, detection, and statistical signal processing.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy exploring signals, understanding their underlying physical characteristics, and pushing the boundaries of what can be extracted through classical signal-processing techniques.

This is a research-intensive, hands-on engineering position with significant technical freedom and ownership.

You will work closely with our embedded software, electronics, and AI teams, taking ideas from mathematical concepts through experimental validation and practical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and implement advanced digital signal-processing algorithms.

  • Analyze complex acoustic signals in both time and frequency domains.

  • Develop techniques for spectral analysis, digital filtering, noise reduction, and signal detection.

  • Apply statistical signal processing and estimation theory to extract meaningful information from noisy measurements.

  • Investigate new signal-processing approaches and evaluate their performance using real-world data.

  • Develop efficient implementations of algorithms for practical applications.

  • Design experiments, analyze results, and continuously improve algorithm performance.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary engineering team to integrate signal-processing solutions into operational systems.

Qualifications

We value technical ability, curiosity, and problem-solving skills more than specific degrees or years of experience.

We would like you to have:

  • An MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • A strong theoretical foundation in digital signal processing.

  • Experience with spectral analysis, FFT, digital filters, and time-frequency analysis.

  • Knowledge of statistical signal processing, detection theory, and estimation methods.

  • Experience developing and evaluating signal-processing algorithms.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, and/or C++.

  • Experience working with real-world measurement data, including noisy or low-SNR signals.

  • The ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Acoustic signal processing.

  • Adaptive filtering and advanced noise-reduction techniques.

  • Passive sensing systems.

  • Real-time or embedded DSP.

  • Advanced mathematical modelling and numerical methods.

  • Signal processing within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Academic research, including publications or a PhD in a relevant field.

Experience in the defence industry is not required. We welcome candidates from both industry and academia, including researchers looking to apply their expertise to real-world engineering challenges.

What We Offer

Work on meaningful challenges. Contribute to advanced technologies addressing real-world security challenges.

Technical freedom and ownership. Take responsibility for complex engineering problems, explore new approaches, and influence the technical direction of our products.

From research to reality. See your algorithms move beyond simulations and become part of real systems deployed in demanding environments.

A multidisciplinary engineering environment. Work alongside talented engineers specializing in embedded software, electronics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering.

A growing defence technology company. Join Triton Depth at an exciting stage, where individual contributions have a direct impact on the company's technology and future.

Who You Are

You are someone who genuinely enjoys understanding signals.

You are curious about the information hidden within complex measurements and have the mathematical knowledge and practical skills to uncover it.

You are equally comfortable exploring theoretical concepts, experimenting with algorithms, and analyzing real-world data.

You enjoy difficult, open-ended technical challenges and take pride in developing solutions that work outside controlled laboratory environments.

Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to turn advanced signal-processing research into technology with real-world impact.

Apply

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Send us your CV and a short introduction describing your background and relevant experience.

We are particularly interested in hearing about signal-processing projects, research, or technical challenges you have worked on.

Location: Copenhagen, DenmarkEmployment: Full-time

title: Associate Professor in Radiography
description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching ResponsibilitiesThe position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and ExpectationsThe Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

  • Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

  • Strong research environments as a driving force for development

  • The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

  • A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

  • Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

  • Relevant clinical experience

  • Relevant experience in educational administration

  • A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

  • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan

  • a detailed description of research experience 

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

  • PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

  • Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

  • Expertise in visual attention and perception

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

  • Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

  • Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

  • Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

  • Good command of statistics

  • Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

  • Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

  • Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

  • A detailed CV

  • Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

  • A complete and numbered list of publications 

  • Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

  • Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark
