title: Ingenieur (m/w/d) für Typgenehmigung und Qualität - Werden Sie Spezialist für Minibusse (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
description: Ingenieur (m/w/d) für Typgenehmigung und Qualität- Werden Sie Spezialist für MinibusseMöchten Sie dazu beitragen, dass unsere Minibusse alle Anforderungen der EU-Vorschriften erfüllen und ordnungsgemäß genehmigt und dokumentiert sind? Haben Sie ein abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium und Interesse daran, sich von Grund auf in die Themen Homologation und Typgenehmigung einzuarbeiten? Dann könnten Sie genau die richtige Person für uns sein!Über die VBI GroupDie VBI Group ist ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen, das 1980 gegründet wurde. Wir kaufen und verkaufen neue und gebrauchte Busse. Mit Standorten in Christiansfeld und Kliplev in Dänemark sowie in Nekla in Polen liefern wir jährlich mehrere Hundert Busse an Kunden in ganz Europa.Am Standort Kliplev, der Ihr primärer Arbeitsort sein wird, bauen wir Basisfahrzeuge wie den Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, den Iveco Daily und den MAN TGE zu fertigen Minibussen der Fahrzeugklassen M1, M2 und M3 um – darunter auch rollstuhlgerechte Fahrzeuge.Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer offenen, unkomplizierten Unternehmenskultur.Ihre AufgabenAls Ingenieur (m/w/d) für Typgenehmigung und Qualität übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in den Bereichen Typgenehmigung, technische Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung.Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören unter anderem:- Verantwortung für EU-Gesamtfahrzeug-Typgenehmigungen (WVTA) gemäß Verordnung (EU) 2018/858 als Hersteller in der zweiten Fertigungsstufe.- Bearbeitung neuer Typgenehmigungen, Erweiterungen bestehender Genehmigungen und der dazugehörigen Beschreibungsunterlagen.- Anlage und Registrierung von Fahrzeugen in den Systemen der dänischen Fahrzeugbehörden sowie Bearbeitung von Einzelgenehmigungen.- Erstellung und Prüfung von CoC-Dokumenten (Certificate of Conformity).- Prüfung von Teilgenehmigungen für Komponenten wie Sitze, Sicherheitsgurte, Verglasung, Beleuchtung und Rampen.- Verantwortung für die Produktionskonformität (CoP – Conformity of Production).- Teilnahme an Audits mit Behörden und technischen Diensten wie IDIADA und TÜV.- Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems (QMS) sowie unseres Cybersicherheitsmanagementsystems (CSMS) gemäß UN-Regelung Nr. 155.- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktion, dem Vertrieb und unserem Werk in Polen.Das bringen Sie mit- Ein abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium, beispielsweise im Maschinenbau oder in der Produktionstechnik, oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation.- Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und analytische Arbeitsweise.- Interesse daran, sich in technische Vorschriften, Normen und Dokumentationsanforderungen einzuarbeiten.- Die Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig konstruktiv mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammenzuarbeiten.- Gute mündliche und schriftliche Kenntnisse in Dänisch, Englisch und Deutsch.Erfahrung im Fahrzeugbereich, mit Typgenehmigungen, Fahrzeugprüfungen oder Qualitätsmanagement ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Ihr technisches Verständnis und Ihre Motivation, sich in ein spezialisiertes Fachgebiet einzuarbeiten.Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, Ihren eigenen Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitzugestalten und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.Sie kommen aus Norddeutschland? Dann müssen Sie nicht unbedingt bereits Dänisch sprechen. Wenn Sie Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen und bereit sind, Dänisch zu lernen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!Das bieten wir Ihnen- Eine umfassende Einarbeitung in die Bereiche Homologation und Typgenehmigung.- Eine solide Grundlage mit bestehenden Genehmigungen, technischer Dokumentation und etablierten Verfahren.- Eine eigenverantwortliche Schlüsselposition mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Berichtslinie zur Geschäftsleitung.- Eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktion und unserem Werk in Polen.- Ein offenes und hilfsbereites Arbeitsumfeld in einem wachsenden Familienunternehmen.- Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.Die Stelle auf einen BlickArbeitsort: Kliplev bei Aabenraa, DänemarkAnstellung: VollzeitEintritt: Zum nächstmöglichen ZeitpunktWir führen Bewerbungsgespräche fortlaufend. Daher freuen wir uns, wenn Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung so bald wie möglich zusenden.Bewerbung und KontaktBitte senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung und Ihren Lebenslauf an:dbp@busimport.dkBei Fragen zur Stelle können Sie sich gerne direkt an unseren CEO Dan B. Pedersen wenden:Telefon: +45 40 35 62 52Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!--------------------------------------------------------------------------Ingeniør til homologering og kvalitet** **– bliv specialist i minibusserVil du være med til at sikre, at vores minibusser er korrekt godkendt og dokumenteret efter EU's regler? Har du en ingeniøruddannelse og lyst til at lære homologering og typegodkendelse fra bunden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.Om VBI GroupVBI Group er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt i 1980. Vi køber og sælger nye og brugte busser. Vi har afdeling i Christiansfeld, Kliplev og i Nekla, Polen og leverer flere hundrede busser om året til kunder i hele Europa.I Kliplev-afdelingen, der vil være dit primære arbejdssted, opbygger vi basiskøretøjer som Mercedes Sprinter, Iveco Daily og MAN TGE til færdige minibusser i klasse M1, M2 og M3 – herunder også kørestolsbusser.Vi er en virksomhed i vækst.  Beslutningsvejene er korte og omgangstonen uformel. JobbetSom homologerings- og kvalitetsingeniør får du en central rolle i arbejdet med typegodkendelse, dokumentation og kvalitet.Dine primære opgaver bliver bl.a.:- Ansvar for EU-helbilsgodkendelser (WVTA) efter forordning (EU) 2018/858 som 2.-trinsproducent.- Håndtering af nye godkendelser, udvidelser og informationsdokumenter.- Oprettelse af køretøjer i NIV/Færdselsstyrelsens systemer samt enkeltgodkendelser.- Udarbejdelse og kontrol af CoC-dokumenter.- Kontrol af delgodkendelser på komponenter som sæder, seler, ruder, belysning og ramper.- Ansvar for CoP-kontroller (Conformity of Production).- Deltagelse i audits med myndigheder og tekniske tjenester som IDIADA og TÜV.- Vedligeholdelse af vores kvalitetssystem (QMS) og cybersikkerhedssystem (CSMS/UN R155).- Tæt samarbejde med produktion, salg og vores fabrik i Polen.Vi forestiller os, at du:- Har en ingeniøruddannelse, fx som maskin- eller produktionsingeniør, eller en tilsvarende teknisk baggrund.- Arbejder struktureret, grundigt og analytisk.- Har lyst til at sætte dig ind i tekniske regler, standarder og dokumentation.- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.- Taler og skriver både dansk, engelsk og tysk.Erfaring med køretøjer, typegodkendelse, syn eller kvalitetsstyring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en god teknisk forståelse og lyst til at lære et specialiseret område. Du vil få gode muligheder for at præge og udvikle dit eget arbejdsområde.Kommer du fra Nordtyskland, behøver du ikke kunne dansk fra start, hvis bare du taler tysk /engelsk og har lyst til at lære dansk.Vi tilbyder- Grundig oplæring i homologering og typegodkendelse.- Et solidt udgangspunkt med eksisterende godkendelser, dokumentation og procedurer.- En selvstændig nøglerolle med stor indflydelse og direkte reference til ledelsen.- Tæt samarbejde med både produktion og vores fabrik i Polen.- En uformel og hjælpsom omgangstone i en familieejet virksomhed i vækst.- Løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension.Arbejdssted: Kliplev ved AabenraaAnsættelse: FuldtidTiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.Send din ansøgning og CV til dbp@busimport.dk.Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte CEO Dan B. Pedersen på +45 40 35 62 52.

title: Opvasker søges til attraktiv stilling i København K
description:
Ansøgningsfrist: 24. november 2026 

 

Trives du med at holde orden, arbejde i et godt team og være en vigtig del af den daglige drift i et professionelt køkken? Så er det måske dig, vi søger. 

 

Er det dig vi mangler? Vi søger en stabil og engageret opvasker til et travlt køkken i København K. Du får en central rolle i at sikre, at køkkenets daglige drift fungerer effektivt, og at både service, udstyr og arbejdsområder altid lever op til de højeste standarder for hygiejne og kvalitet.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Opvask og rengøring af service, køkkenudstyr og produktionsredskaber.

  • Sikre løbende orden og struktur i opvaskeområdet.

  • Håndtere større mængder opvask i et travlt køkkenmiljø.

  • Medvirke til at opretholde høje standarder for hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed.

  • Samarbejde med køkkenets øvrige medarbejdere for at sikre en velfungerende hverdag.

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra lignende arbejde, gerne fra storkøkken, kantine eller restaurationsbranchen.

  • Arbejder effektivt, struktureret og selvstændigt.

  • Trives i et miljø, hvor tempoet til tider er højt.

  • Har en positiv indstilling og er en god holdspiller.

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk

 

Stillingen kræver sikkerhedsgodkendelse. Vi tilbyder fast arbejde i et professionelt køkkenmiljø, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone. Det er en hverdag med faste arbejdstider, og der er mulighed for at blive en del af en stabil arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet og samarbejde.

Stillingen er 35 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag kl. 07:00 til 14:00.

Denne stilling er tidsbegrænset på 6 måneder.

 

Ansøgning 

Er du klar til at blive en vigtig del af køkkenets daglige succes? Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, senest d. 24. november 2026. For yderligere information kontakt Køkkenchef Jean Sparre Balken Allermand på mail: jean.allermand@dk.issworld.com

title: BM-Gulvservice ApS is hiring a Floor Layer with Mechanical Skills
description:
BM-Gulvservice ApS is looking for a motivated Floor Layer to join our team working with the installation, renovation and finishing of wooden floors.

Your primary responsibility will be practical flooring work at customer sites. We are particularly interested in applicants with good mechanical understanding who can also help maintain our equipment, identify faults and carry out minor mechanical repairs when needed.

Job title: Floor LayerDISCO-08 code: 712200

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Measure and prepare work areas and subfloors.

  • Cut, fit and install wooden flooring.

  • Sand and renovate existing wooden floors.

  • Prepare surfaces and apply finishing treatments.

  • Check the quality of completed work, including joints, levels and surface finish.

  • Operate flooring machinery and carry out routine equipment checks and maintenance.

  • Identify common mechanical faults and perform minor repairs or adjustments at customer sites, within your competence and according to manufacturer instructions.

  • Report faults requiring specialist repair and keep tools and equipment in good working condition.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a practical or technical background and an interest in quality flooring work.

  • Works accurately with measurements, materials and tools.

  • Has good mechanical understanding and practical skills in equipment maintenance and minor repairs.

  • Can approach mechanical problems systematically and recognise when specialist assistance is required.

  • Is reliable, takes responsibility and works well with colleagues.

  • Can communicate in English and understand work and safety instructions.

Previous experience with wooden flooring is an advantage. Relevant technical training and practical skills gained in another field will also be considered.

Training in our flooring methods and familiarisation with our specific equipment will be provided according to your background.

WE OFFER

  • A full-time position primarily focused on wooden flooring.

  • Varied installation and renovation projects at customer sites.

  • The opportunity to use and develop both flooring and mechanical skills.

  • Cooperation with experienced colleagues.

  • Salary according to qualifications and employment conditions consistent with Danish standards.

HOW TO APPLY

We welcome applications from candidates in Denmark and abroad.

Please send your CV, relevant certificates and a short application in English using the contact details provided in this advertisement.

Describe your practical background and any experience with flooring, tools, machinery maintenance or repairs.

Start date by agreement, subject to any required work authorisation.

BM-Gulvservice ApS

title: Chef – Chinese Cuisine (Bao & Noodle Specialist)

We Offer:

Application

* CV

title: Lead Robotics/Drone Software & Computer Vision Engineer for TRDP ApS
description:
TRDP is a Danish defence-tech startup developing autonomous interceptor drone systems.

We are a small, hands-on team of 10 engineers and specialists working across robotics, software, electronics, mechanical engineering, drone building and flight testing.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines hands-on software development, computer vision, AI and systems architecture with the ability to guide a small engineering team.

Our software team currently consists of three robotics engineers with experience in mobile robotics, drones and visual odometry.

Your responsibilities

  • Take an active role in software development, integration and testing.

  • Contribute to computer vision, AI-based perception, object detection, tracking and sensor fusion.

  • Design and maintain the overall software architecture.

  • Coordinate and prioritise development tasks within the software team.

  • Integrate software, sensors, electronics and control systems.

  • Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Work closely with our electronics, mechanical engineering and flight-testing teams.

Your background

  • Degree in robotics, software engineering, computer science or a related field.

  • Strong practical experience with robotics software and complex system integration.

  • Solid knowledge of computer vision, AI and sensor fusion.

  • Experience with software architecture and embedded systems.

  • Ability to guide other engineers while contributing directly to development.

  • Experience with C++, Python, ROS 2, PX4/ArduPilot or similar technologies is an advantage.

Who you are

You are a hands-on engineer with a strong understanding of complete robotic systems.

You enjoy writing code, solving complex technical challenges and turning ideas into working prototypes. You can guide specialists, make architectural decisions and ensure that individual technologies work together.

Our culture and mindset

At TRDP, we believe in no bullshit, taking responsibility and getting things done. We value practical skills, direct communication, technical curiosity and people who turn ideas into working solutions.

We also believe that the things we hold dear are worth fighting for. That conviction drives our work in defence technology. We are looking for people who share that mindset and want their engineering skills to make a real difference.

Working language: English.

Contact: talents@trdp.dkWebsite: www.trdp.dk

Aftenholdstider ligger fra 13.55-23.05 4 dage om ugen fra Mandag til Torsdag

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende - men vi ser gerne at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller erfaring. Heroveni er det et plus hvis du har erfaring med betjening af produktionsanlæg og generel procesforståelse. Dette kunne være tidligere arbejde som proces-/industrioperatør og eller smed/mekaniker, med indsigt i fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg. Om randstadRandstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

description:

Vejen Kommune søger engagerede og omsorgsfulde personer, der ønsker at uddanne sig som social- og sundhedsassistenter (SOSU-assistenter). Hvis du brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og ønsker at bidrage til deres trivsel og livskvalitet, så er dette din chance!

 

Hvad tilbyder vi?
  • Meningsfuld uddannelse: Som SOSU-assistent får du en uddannelse, der gør en reel forskel i folks liv. Du vil lære at yde pleje og støtte til borgere i alle aldre, hvilket giver dig en unik mulighed for at påvirke deres hverdag positivt.
  • Praktisk erfaring: Uddannelsen kombinerer teori med praktisk oplæring på plejehjem, i hjemmeplejen, på hospitaler og i psykiatrien. Du vil få hands-on erfaring, der forbereder dig til virkeligheden i sundhedssektoren. Teorien foregår på SOSU-skolen i Esbjerg. 
  • Støtte og vejledning: Vi sørger for, at du trives under din uddannelse. Du vil have en dedikeret vejleder, der følger dig gennem hele forløbet og giver dig feedback og sparring.
  • Karrieremuligheder: Uddannelsen åbner døren til mange spændende karrieremuligheder inden for sundhedssektoren. Du kan specialisere dig inden for forskellige områder og fortsætte med at udvikle dine færdigheder.

 

Hvad forventer vi af dig?
  • Engagement: Du skal have lyst til at arbejde med mennesker og en vilje til at lære og udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt, hvilket kræver nysgerrighed og mod til at komme ud af din comfortzone
  • Empati og omsorg: Du skal kunne vise forståelse og støtte til borgere i forskellige livssituationer.
  • Samarbejdsevner: Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger og andre faggrupper, så gode kommunikationsevner er vigtige.
  Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Som elev får du løn i henhold til gældende FOA overenskomst. Hvis du er over 25 år, kan du få voksenelevløn. Din arbejdstid er 37 timer om ugen.

  Vil du vide mere?

Du er altid velkommen til at kontakte en af uddannelseskoordinatorerne; 

Line Korsbæk, mobil 30 17 09 07Rianne van Santen, mobil 40 49 09 46

  Hvordan ansøger du?

Er du klar til at tage det første skridt mod en meningsfuld karriere? Send din ansøgning til os! Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende, så vær opmærksom på din mail og SPAM filter. 

Bliv en del af vores team i Vejen Kommune, og vær med til at skabe en bedre hverdag for vores borgere!

title: Vil du prøve kræfter med en hverdag med mange varierende arbejdsopgaver?
description:
Jobbet

Som vores nye kollega bliver du en del af det daglige arbejde på ejendomskontoret, og vil arbejde tæt sammen med driftspersonalet.

Derudover vil du også skulle samarbejde med administrative medarbejdere og udføre opgaver på tværs af organisationen.

 I en almen boligorganisation følger vi nogle faste årshjul og deadlines, hvor det til tider kan være hektisk. Der vil dog også være mere stille perioder, hvor der bliver mulighed for opsamling. Du vil få en central rolle i samarbejdet med mange forskellige kollegaer og deres respektive funktioner.

Din faste kontorplads vil blive på ejendomskontoret, men der kan forekomme opgaver, hvor du skal supplere i administrationen.

 Der vil være rig mulighed for at udfordre dig selv i en travl, spændende og afvekslende hverdag med mangeartede opgaver, hvori brug af IT, mundtlig og skriftlig kommunikation er væsentlig.

 Arbejdsopgaverne omfatter:

·        Håndtering af opkald og mails fra beboere samt bistå i åbningstid

·        Koordinering af opgaver i driften

·        Organisere flyttesager

·        Udarbejde skrivelser

·        Projektkoordinering og opfølgning

·        Udføre referater

·        Brevhåndtering

·        Mindre indkøb

Arbejdsopgaverne udføres i samarbejde med øvrige kollegaer i driften og administrationen.  

Personprofil

Som medarbejder i Bo42 lægger vi vægt på, at du er serviceminded, venlig og imødekommende over for alle beboergrupper.

·        Du har gode samarbejdsevner

·        Du er rutineret bruger af IT, herunder Excel og Word

·        Du kan bevare overblikket og arbejde med faste deadlines

·        Du er både sprogligt og skriftlig stærk

·        Du er struktureret og har ordenssans

·        Du har en kontoruddannelse eller erfaring fra lignende job

Vi tilbyder

·        Et godt arbejdsmiljø med kollegialt fællesskab, hvor samarbejde har stor betydning

·        En alsidig arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver

·        Du får frihed til at handle og tage ansvar. Vi lægger vægt på udvikling, og tilbyder dig en stilling, hvor du kan udvikle og styrke dine kompetencer og arbejdsopgaver

·        Attraktive løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst

·        Sundhedsordning

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdstiden kan være 30-37 timer pr. uge, inklusiv frokost.

Du må forvente, at der kan forekomme arbejde uden for normal arbejdstid – herunder ved møder.

Hvis du er interesseret

Send din ansøgning sammen med CV til, job@bo42.dk, senest den 8. november 2026.

Hvem er vi

Med næsten 1200 boliger er Bo42 den største almene boligorganisation på Bornholm.

Ejendomskontor og administration er centralt beliggende i Rønne.

Vi er i alt 20 medarbejdere fordelt på drift og administration.

Du kan læse mere om os på vores hjemmeside www.bo42.dk

title: Deltidsstilling som kirketjener ved Lyngby Kirke, Kongens Lyngby sogn
description:
I Lyngby Kirke søger vi nu en deltids-kirketjener til 18 timer om ugen, gerne med erfaring fra lignende stilling. Kirketjeneren skal arbejde sammen med vores to fuldtidskirketjenere. Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt. Den primære arbejdstid ligger i dagtimerne på hverdage og i weekender. Der vil være aftenarbejde ved særlige arrangementer. Du vil have en fast ugentlig fridag, og du skal dække dine kirketjenerkollegaer ved ferie og andet fravær. Lyngby Kirke er en levende arbejdsplads med mange kirkelige aktiviteter og forskellige arrangementer. Deraf følger en del rengøringsopgaver, som du vil skulle varetage i samarbejde med de andre kirketjenere. Trives du i en hverdag, hvor dagene ikke er ens, og med gode kollegaer omkring dig, er du måske vores nye kirketjener. Arbejdsområderne omfatter bl.a.:
  • Kirkelige handlinger og gudstjenester samt øvrige arrangementer i kirken.
  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirke, mødelokaler, kontor og sognegård.
  • Opstilling af borde og stole til diverse arrangementer.
  • Indkøb af forplejning og forbrugsmaterialer til kirkens drift.
  • Opdækning og afrydning til møder m.m.
Vi kan tilbyde dig:
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor du er betydningsfuld både for dine kollegaer og vores kirkegængere.
  • At du kan være med til at sætte dit præg på vores kirketjenerarbejde.
  • Et afvekslende og alsidigt arbejde.
  • Mulighed for kurser og kompetenceudvikling.
  • Engagerede kollegaer, menighedsråd og frivillige.
Vi forventer af dig:
  • At du er imødekommende og vil bidrage til, at kirkegængerne og husets brugere føler sig velkomne.
  • At du er ansvarsbevidst, omhyggelig, velsoigneret, pålidelig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.
  • At du trives i en hverdag, hvor du skal kunne håndtere mange forskellige opgaver.
  • At du evner og har lyst til at indgå i et konstruktivt samarbejde med kirkens øvrige faggrupper, frivillige og menighedsrådet.
  • At du har sans for æstetik, og sætter en ære i at vores bygninger er rene og indbydende.
  • At du kan betjene IT (Powerpoint, filmvisning ol.).
  • Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, at du har kørekort.
Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk. Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen. Årslønnen for en fuldtidsstilling ligger inden for intervallet 324.667,02 kr.- 408.841,08 i kr. (nutidskroner). Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.230,62 kr. (nutidskroner). OK-tillæg på 1.400,52 kr. Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening. Løn samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk. Ansættelsen er på overenskomstvilkår med prøvetid på tre måneder. Vær opmærksom på at der kan blive bedt om referencer, og at der vil blive indhentet straffeattest og børneattest. Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til menighedsrådsformand Marianne Secher på telefon 5151 3035. Din ansøgning vedlagt CV sendes via knappen ”Ansøg”. Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning senest fredag den 13. november kl. 12. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at finde sted i uge 47.

description:

Din primære opgave bliver at vikle paller med strækfolie ved hjælp af en maskine. Derudover vil du hjælpe med almindelige lageropgaver og praktiske opgaver efter behov.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Håndtering og klargøring af paller og varer.

  • Almindeligt lagerarbejde.

Vi søger dig, som

  • Har gode danskkundskaber,

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og møder til tiden.

  • Trives med praktisk og fysisk arbejde.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og effektivt.

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at hjælpe, hvor der er behov.

Erfaring fra lagerarbejde er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling, er lærenem og klar til at tage fat.

Interesseret?

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig, og har du mulighed for at starte hurtigst muligt, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler og behandler ansøgninger løbende, da vi ønsker at finde den rette medarbejder hurtigst muligt.

title: Natlastbilchauffør søges til fast fuldtidsstilling
description:
Natlastbilchauffør søges – Simba Nordic Transport ApS

Simba Nordic Transport ApS søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst lastbilchauffør til en fast fuldtidsstilling med primært aften- og natarbejde.

Arbejdsopgaver

* Transport af gods på faste ruter og efter tildelte transportopgaver.

* Afhentning og levering af gods til tiden.

* Daglig kontrol og vedligeholdelse af lastbilen.

* Håndtering af transportdokumenter.

* Overholdelse af gældende regler om køre- og hviletid.

Kvalifikationer

* Gyldigt kørekort til kategori CE.

* Gyldigt EU-chaufføruddannelsesbevis (kode 95).

* Erfaring med godstransport er en fordel.

* Ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og selvstændig.

* Evne til at arbejde fleksibelt i aften- og nattetimerne.

* Fast fuldtidsansættelse.

* Arbejdstiden ligger primært mandag til fredag med aften- og natkørsel.

* Arbejdsstedet varierer efter transportopgaverne.

* Overnatning i lastbilen kan forekomme, hvor det er lovligt.

* Arbejdstid, pauser og hvileperioder tilrettelægges efter gældende regler.

* Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Om virksomheden

Simba Nordic Transport ApS er en dansk transportvirksomhed, der udfører professionelle godstransportopgaver med fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og pålidelig levering.

Vi tilbyder en selvstændig stilling med faste transportopgaver og mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og oplysninger om dine chaufførkvalifikationer til Simba Nordic Transport ApS via de kontaktoplysninger, der fremgår af jobannoncen.

title: Rahoitusasiantuntija
description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Olemme rakentaneet uuden palvelumallin ja työkalun, jonka avulla et vain ohjaa asiakasta eteenpäin. **Viet rahoitushankkeen itse ensimmäisestä keskustelusta loppuun saakka.****Trusty Finance Broker** tuo asiakastyön, rahoitusanalyysin ja rahoittajille valmisteltavan aineiston samaan työympäristöön. Sinulle se tarkoittaa **vähemmän rutiinia ja enemmän aikaa asiakkaalle**. Voit hoitaa useampia rahoitushankkeita laadusta tinkimättä.**Trusty Finance Broker muuttaa rahoitusasiantuntijan arjen**Hyvä asiakaskeskustelu on vasta alku. Sen jälkeen yrityksen tilanne pitää jäsentää, rahoituksen perusteet arvioida ja aineisto valmistella. Trusty Finance Broker vie tämän työn kanssasi järjestelmällisesti maaliin.- **Asiakastyötila pitää kokonaisuuden käsissäsi.** Asiakkaat, rahoitushankkeet, sovitut asiat ja seuraavat askeleet ovat yhdessä näkymässä. Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Technical Lead; DK - Frederikshavn
description:

As Senior Electrical Engineer, Technical Lead at Semco Maritime, you will take ownership of the electrical installation scope in a nationally significant naval project.Your position In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team working closely with design, procurement, fabrication, and quality control. You will help turn technical requirements and design into practical, high-quality installation solutions and ensure efficient production throughout all phases of shipbuilding, in compliance with naval and classification standards. The final title will depend on your experience and qualifications.Your work will have a direct impact on the successful delivery of the Arctic ships and on the continued development of the Danish naval shipbuilding industry.The position will be based in Frederikshavn, where the Arctic ships will be assembled, and is a full-time, permanent position.Your tasks & responsibilities As Senior Electrical Engineer, Technical Lead you will plan, coordinate, and lead the electrical installation scope throughout ship production, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, suppliers, and production teams.Your tasks will include, but are not limited to:
  • Defining and planning electrical installation methods from design through production, including installation sequencing, equipment installation, and coordination with relevant stakeholders
  • Participating in the production engineering process to support quality, safety, and efficiency
  • Supporting the development of electrical discipline project plans and resource estimates
  • Lead parts of the installations scope when in construction
  • Acting as the technical point of contact internally and with suppliers for electrical and instrumentation matters

title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
description:
About the positionThe Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC).The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions.The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.Key responsibilitiesStrategic leadership and governance

  • Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates.

  • Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability.

  • Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.

Management, organisation and budget

  • Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state.

  • Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices.

  • Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.

Operational responsibility

  • Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication.

  • Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.

About youTo succeed in this role, we expect that you:

  • Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage.

  • Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level.

  • Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions.

  • Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally.

  • Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.

In addition, you:

  • Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations.

  • Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries.

  • Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.

About the Danish Resilience AgencyThe Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure.We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment.About the NBCCThe NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity.The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats.Salary and terms of employmentSalary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness.Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment.The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension.The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen.To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk SamarbejdeIf the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee.Are you interested?Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th November 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education.For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257.All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background.Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy, with background in one or more of the following areas: philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, phenomenology.We are looking for a person with a relevant degree (M.A., MSc. etc.) in philosophy or a related field. Starting date is September 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fully funded, full-time, for three years. The PhD degree will be awarded by the Faculty of Health Sciences.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will be based in the research group of Applied and Interdisciplinary Phenomenology in the Department of Psychology, SDU, at the Odense campus. The research group develops, disseminates, and applies methods to support cutting-edge research into subjectivity and the nature of human experience. Current group members have backgrounds in philosophy, psychology, anthropology, neuroscience, environmental studies, and pain research.

The group directly supports the professional development of its members, most of whom are postdocs or PhD students. In addition to receiving support from the project team, the PhD student will be supported by the broader group to develop their research, presentation, and teaching skills, as well as other academic skills, including those required for organizing academic activities such as workshops and conferences and for successful grant-writing. The PhD student will therefore be provided with the requisite knowledge and skills for pursuing an academic career in Europe or abroad.

The PhD student will also be provided with a work computer and a dedicated workspace at the Department of Psychology.

 

Project description

The PhD student will be part of the project, Understanding Experiences of Mood Disturbances in Depression (DEPMOOD), led by Anthony Vincent Fernandez. The project is funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark and runs for four years, starting September 1st, 2026. The PhD student will join the project for the final three years, collaborating with the PI, a psychology postdoc, and several external partners in Europe and the US, including philosophers, clinical psychologists, and psychiatrists.

The aim of the project is to establish a taxonomy of the variety of mood disturbances experienced by people diagnosed with depression, providing more precise characterizations of symptoms than those currently offered by concepts such as “depressed mood” or “anhedonia”. The project combines philosophical and qualitative methods, and includes in-depth interviews with people diagnosed with depression. The PhD student will not be expected to carry out interviews, as these will be conducted by the postdoc and external project partners. The PhD student’s primary role will be to help analyze the interview data using a combination of qualitative and philosophical methods. Their PhD thesis will therefore be a theoretical contribution, but will build upon the project’s empirical dataset.

In addition to producing a thesis, the PhD student will be required to take a variety of short PhD courses, carry out an international research stay, and fulfil light teaching duties.

The PhD student will be provided with DKK 10,000 per year for travel. Additional funds may be available.

 

Qualifications

Before the start date of September 1st, 2027, the applicant should have a master’s degree in philosophy or a related field and total course credits equivalent to 300 ECTS. Typically, this is a total of at least five years of education combined between bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with 60 ECTS obtained for every full year of study.

The candidate should have a background in philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, and/or phenomenology. Familiarity with qualitative research methods (especially analysis methods) is an advantage, but by no means required.

The candidate should be proficient in English. Proficiency in Danish or another Scandinavian language may be an advantage, but is not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:Anthony Vincent Fernandez

Department of Psychology

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: afernandez@health.sdu.dk

Please note that while we are happy to provide answers to questions about the position and application process, direct feedback on application materials cannot be provided.

Applications must include (in English, or with a certified English translation):

 

  1. A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.

  2. Detailed CV, including personal contact information as well as any publications or presentations

  3. Certified copy of diploma and transcripts (Master’s degree in a relevant field). If the applicant is in the process of completing their master’s degree, they should provide transcripts along with a letter from their supervisor confirming expected completion of their degree before September 1st, 2027.

  4. Writing sample of maximum 10,000 words (e.g., publication, conference paper, selection from a master’s thesis). If the sample exceeds this length, please indicate which section should be read.

  5. A document listing 2-3 references, with contact information and a brief note about your relation to the reference. Note that reference letters will only be requested for candidates invited to interview. 

At this stage, no project proposal is required. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to prepare a brief project plan.

Please do not use generative AI in the formulation of any application materials. The purpose of these materials is to gain a clear sense of you and your abilities.

Shortlisting and interviews may be used in the assessment process. 

For purposes of evaluation and assessment, application materials may be shared with external members of the project team at Aarhus University and Amsterdam University Medical Center.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated

 

Closing date January 15th, 2027 

We expect to conduct interviews within two months of the application closing date.Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students. 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98   per year.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Assistant Professor in Global Health at The Research Unit of General Practice, University of Southern Denmark
description:
The Research Unit of General Practice at the Institute of Public Health, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year full time Assistant Professor position in Global Health. The position starts on April 1, 2027, and will terminate at the end of the appointment period unless otherwise agreed.

Beskrivelse til interne kandidater

The Research Unit of General Practice at the Institute of Public Health, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year full time Assistant Professor position in Global Health.

The position starts on April 1, 2027, and will terminate at the end of the appointment period unless otherwise agreed.

Job DescriptionThe position involves research in global health with a particular focus on strengthening primary healthcare systems for vulnerable and underserved populations in low- and middle-income countries. The successful candidate will contribute to the international research project STRENGTHENing Gender-Responsive Health Systems for Addressing Non-Communicable Diseases in Climate-Affected Fishing Communities in Western Kenya (STRENGTHEN) and other upcoming global health projects. The STRENGTHEN project aims to improve the prevention and management of NCDs in climate-affected fishing communities in Western Kenya by making the health systems even more gender-responsive. The project will generate evidence on how community health promoters (CHPs) provide NCD care in FEDCs affected by climate change. It will address five key health systems building blocks: health information systems, health workforce, health service, medical technology, and policy and governance. The work will involve conducting implementation and health services research, and collaborating with researchers, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and community stakeholders across different country settings. The position involves travel to Kenya for short periods.

We offer a challenging position in a stimulating research environment with excellent opportunities for collaboration within SDU and with international research partners.

Expectations of qualificationsThe successful applicant should have:

  • A PhD degree (or equivalent) in Global Health, Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Services Research, Implementation Science, or a related discipline

  • A strong background in health systems research, primary healthcare, chronic disease prevention and management, or health equity research in low- and middle-income countries

  • A strong academic record

  • Good collaboration and communication skills

  • Interest in co-supervising BSc, MSc and PhD students

Following qualifications are preferred:

  • Experience with mixed-methods research, including qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis

  • Experience with implementation science, intervention development, and evaluation of community-based health programmes

  • Experience with global health research conducted in low- and middle-income countries and/or humanitarian settings

  • Experience with stakeholder engagement and collaboration with healthcare providers, communities, and policymakers

  • Experience with writing research applications

  • Experience in teaching and education

Further informationFor further information please contact Prof. Jens Søndergaard, jsondergaard@health.sdu.dk, or Associate Prof. Trine Thilsing, tthilsing@health.sdu.dk 

Application deadline and interviewsThe application deadline is November15th 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

Terms of employment Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from 1. April 2027.

title: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

  • Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

  • Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

  • Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

  • Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

  • Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

  • Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

  • A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

  • First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

  • Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

  • Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

  • A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

  • The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

  • Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

  • Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

  • Practical experience with target trial emulation.

  • Experience in international research collaborations.

  • Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

  • a detailed description of research experience

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

title: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  - Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities The following qualifications are highly valued:  You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  Qualifications  - A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field- Experience with intervention and implementation research- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health- A strong profile within qualitative research- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research- Experience in national and international research collaboration- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation processShortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • Teaching portfolio

  • Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

  • Reference letters/references may also be included

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dkApplication deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.
