title: PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d) (Geophysiker/in)
description: PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d): Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 January2027:PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d):Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementitel (m/f/d)(Part-Time)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: PhD position (65%) / PostDoc (up to 60%)Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 4 years, until 31.12.20230Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.As part of the Centre, the group “Global Land Systems and Biodiversity” takes a system perspective on how production, trade and consumption of food and other biomass products affect ecosystems and people.The VEBITA project, conducted jointly by SGN, the Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE) brings together researchers and practice partners to work towards utilizing animal movement data for early-warning systems for nature conservation. By analyzing GPS and sensor data from animals with statistical and AI-based methods, VEBITA aims to detect how animal behaviors change in response to land use, climate change, habitat loss, infrastructure development, and other environmental pressures.The adverstised position focuses on the effects of livestock management on wildlife movements contributes a use-case for state-of-the art animal movement data. Currently, livestock keeping has the largest spatial footprint of all land uses and the global biomass of mammalian livestock exceeds that of all remaining wild mammals by an order of magnitude. How and where livestock are kept greatly impacts the movements of the remaining wild mammals.In this context, we seek to develop a refined biodiversity footprint approach that captures how different livestock management strategies impact movement of wild mammals and how management can be adapted to achieve more sustainable outcomes. This subproject is part of VEBITA’s transdisciplinary focus, and the design of the novel footprint approach will consider perspectives of different relevant societal stakeholder groups such as livestock farmers, conservationists, and regulators. Results and insights of this work will also feed back to international science-policy debates on how conservation and human activities can be aligned in the future.Your tasks- Advance existing biodiversity footprint approaches in the context of livestock production and wildlife movement- Classify global livestock management systems- Analyze global patterns of how livestock keeping influences movements of wild mammals- Actively engage in exchange and cooperation within VEBITA’s inter- and transdisciplinary project team- Participate in project meetings and contribute to project reporting- Publish results in international journals in cooperation with the project teamYour profile- MSc degree (or equivalent) for application for a PhD position or PhD degree for application as postdoctoral researcher in a relevant field, e.g., sustainability science, physical geography, ecology or another relevant field- Programming skills (R, Python or similar), familiarity in working with heterogenous datasets and their analysis- Excellent English language skills- Interest in working in an inter- and transdisciplinary project- Interest in applied science at the science-policy interfaceDesirable skills- Experience with stakeholder interactionsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application as a single PDF by 19 November 2026, stating the reference number Ref. #11-26021, including:- cover letter describing your motivation to apply for this position- detailed CV- contact details of two potential references- all academic credentials and certificatesPlease submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.If you have any specific questions about the position, please contact Prof. Dr. Thomas Kastner at thomas.kastner@senckenberg.de.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact xxxxx atvorname.nachname@senckenberg.deFor data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.Application documents will also be made available to members of the selection committee from Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE), solely for the purpose of assessing applications and selecting candidates.

title: Senior Product Analyst - Quick Commerce (Fixed-term) (Data-Analyst/in)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Senior Product AnalystStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. You'll drive data-informed decision-making across Local Shops, directly shaping how we scale and optimize our quick commerce offering.Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. title: 2 Postdoctoral Researchers (ecologists) (m/f/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description: Senckenberg – Leibniz Institution for Biodiversity and Earth System Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its Department of River Ecology and Conservation in Gelnhausen, starting as soon as possible2 Postdoctoral Researchers (ecologists) (m/f/d)(full-time / part-time)Location: GelnhausenEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options are availableType of contract: limited two years / an extension is be possibleRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) E 13Senckenberg is one of the world’s leading research institutions in the field of Biodiversity and Earth System Research, with eight research institutes and three natural history museums across Germany and scientists from over 40 nations. Our headquarter is located in the thriving commercial metropolis of Frankfurt in the heart of Germany, which also hosts one of our most famous facilities, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum. The location of the available position is in a Senckenberg institute about 40 kilometers east of Frankfurt in Gelnhausen, a historic town accessible via public transport (rail and bus).We are looking for enthusiastic ecologists with a background in broad-scale biodiversity change, community ecology, macroecology, metacommunities, and/or analysis of ecological time series.The two positions are embedded in one or more of the following projects:1. Synthesis Center on Freshwater Biodiversity Change in Europe The Synthesis Center brings together and supports a broad variety of researchers and practitioners investigating a broad variety of fundamental and applied ecological questions, with a particular focus on broad-scale and long-term biodiversity change, community ecology, freshwater ecology, time series analyses, multiple stressor impacts, and conservation (see doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06400-1 for an example). Data for > 30,000 freshwater biodiversity time series across 30 European countries have already been compiled from rivers and lakes, covering invertebrates, fish, macrophytes, diatoms, and benthic algae, in collaboration with a large pan-European network of > 200 researchers. Positions involved in this project are expected to pursue similar questions using the already available data.2. EU Horizon Europe project BEAGLE (started on 1st October 2026)BEAGLE (Biodiversity methods for advanced monitoring at large scales) is an EU-funded project using new technology to enhance biodiversity monitoring across terrestrial, freshwater, and marine environments. Specifically, the project uses sensors, environmental DNA (eDNA) and AI, as well as citizen science to collect large-scale and high-quality biodiversity data across a consortium of 17 partners. Positions involved in this project will focus on several tasks, including European-scale biodiversity data mobilization activities (e.g., tracking down datasets and preparing them for use), and the learning and deployment of field-based methods for data collection (e.g., Malaise traps). Participating researchers will gain experience in broad-scale biodiversity data collection and management, biodiversity monitoring, and participation in European-scale research networks.Your tasks• Contributing scientifically to one or more of the above-described projects (you can indicate a preference in your application if you have one)• Analyzing spatial and temporal biodiversity data, and accompanied environmental data, to elucidate spatial patterns and temporal trends and drivers thereof• Preparing scientific manuscripts• Attending project meetings and preparing project reports• Mentoring graduate students• Giving oral presentations at national and international conferences• Attending virtual and physical project meetingsYour profile• PhD in Ecology or a related field• Solid background in fields related to the above expected tasks for a given project or projects.• Advanced skills in statistical analyses, using R• Skills in project management and report writing are preferred but not essential• Strong publication record for your current career level• Excellent written and oral communication and project presentation skills in EnglishWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter outlining your suitability for the post, a detailed CV, contact details of 2 references, a list of publications and acquired funding electronically (as a single PDF) stating the **reference #04-26004 by November 22nd, 2026 **using the application form on our website https://www.senckenberg.de/de/karriere/ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt a.M.If you have any specific questions about this role position, please contact Prof. Dr. Peter Haase at peter.haase@senckenberg.de.

title: PostDoc position (m/f/d) in  Data-Driven Social-Ecological Research (Umweltwissenschaftler/in)
description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as soon as possible:PostDoc (m/f/d) in Data-Driven Social Ecological Research(Full-Time / Part-Time** **options available)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: Full-Time; Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 3 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.SBiK-F has strong cooperations with the Institute for social-ecological research (ISOE) and the position will work closely with both institutions.The position develops quantitative approaches to (1) better characterize and measure human–nature interactions, or (2) use these analyses to identify leverage points for more effective stewardship or monitoring of nature under climate change.Your tasks- Develop quantitative approaches to measure and analyze human–nature interactions- Integrate multiple data streams (ecological, social, remote-sensing, citizen-science) into coherent models of social-ecological system dynamics- Identify leverage points where intervention or monitoring most effectively supports biodiversity- Advance biodiversity or stewardship monitoring frameworks to better incorporate social dimensions- Publish in leading international journals- Contribute to and connect with ongoing research at SBiK-F- Collaborate across the natural- and social-science groups at Senckenberg, ISOE, and partner institutionsYour profile- PhD in ecology, environmental science, quantitative social science, or a related field- Demonstrated experience working with empirical ecological data and preferably also social data- Strong proficiency in R (and/or comparable statistical/programming environments)- Excellent quantitative and statistical skills- Strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals- Fluency in written and spoken EnglishDesirable skills- Experience with integrating heterogeneous data streams (eg. ecological, social, remote sensing or citizen science data)- Familiarity with AI/ML methods- Track record of interdisciplinary collaboration across natural and social sciences- Experience in quantitative social science methods and working with social or socio-economic data- Experience in acquiring third-party funding- Familiarity with trait-based approaches to social-ecological questions- Familiarity with adaptive capacity and resilience of social-ecological systems- Familiarity with impacts of climate change on the interactions between biodiversity and societyWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV with full publication list, copies of certificates and diplomas, along with the names of two referees), electronically (as a single PDF) stating the reference: #11-26026 by 29.11.2026.Please submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.Please be aware, application documents will also be made available to members of the selection committee from the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE), solely for the purpose of assessing applications and selecting candidates.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Thomas Müller atThomas Müller.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Sociology. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Chair of Micro-Sociology and Technosocial Interaction.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the fields of Applied Linguistics and Digital Humanities, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Discursive negotiations, conceptualisations and metaphorisations of energy relations and energy transformations in various social domains (politics, the economy, technological development, civil society, etc.) and media contexts, including multimodal aspects- Formats, practices and impacts of science communication (analogue and digital) relating to energy-related researchTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the disciplines of Applied Linguistics or Digital Humanities. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in German Studies, Linguistics, Digital Humanities or a comparable discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the linguistic, cultural or media studies analysis of discourses on environmental, technological or energy-related issues. Experience with digital research methods (such as corpus linguistics, text mining and network analysis) would be an advantage. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Linguistics, Literature and Cultural Studies, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Sociology. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Chair of Micro-Sociology and Technosocial Interaction.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Sociology, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- The (conflict-ridden) negotiation of imaginaries, infrastructures, institutional frameworks, and/or externalities (e.g., emissions, waste, waste heat) associated with energy production and supply across a wide variety of practices, communities, networks, organizations, markets, fields, and/or assemblagesTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Sociology or a comparable field in the social sciences, as well as relevant previous experience in the sociological analysis of the environment, technology, or energy, and/or in the field of Science and Technology Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatoryWe offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application: Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-008, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

title: Strategic Procurement Manager - Semiconductor Materials (f/m/d) (Category-Manager/in)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategische/r Einkäufer/in; Technische/r Einkäufer/inStellenbeschreibung:About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.About our technologyThe semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.The RoleBlack Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier management activities for materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:- Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.- Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.- Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.- Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.- Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.- Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.Your Profile- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.- 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.- Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.- Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.- Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; German language skills are considered an advantage.- Willing to work on-site at our Aachen office at least once a week.Our work culturePeople Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what mattersLet’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal developmentYour Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and futureWe Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forwardWe connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connectIf your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Read more about our privacy policy here. (https://www.blacksemi.com/privacy-policy)Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 70%

title: (Senior) Product Manager - (Logistics, Customer Choice) (Product Owner)
description: Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionWe are on the lookout for a (Senior) Product Manager in Logistics Customer Choice to own the demand management solutions that keep ordering smooth when delivery capacity is stretched. You'll work hands-on with Engineering and Data Science to turn real-time fleet saturation signals into product decisions that lift peak-time conversion and reduce cancellations. You'll be accountable for execution as much as strategy, bringing Operations, regional teams, and engineers along as features go live.We are building the Choice products that decide which options customers see, balancing real-time fleet saturation with customer intent so logistical saturation doesn't get in the way of ordering.In our Logistics Team, you'll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.- Own the roadmap for demand management solutions that balance fleet capacity with customer ordering.- Take features from idea to launch with Engineering, writing clear requirements and prioritizing the backlog.- Partner with Data Science to shape and evaluate models and AI-driven configurations that replace manual operational settings.- Run experiments and track conversion, cancellation, and fleet saturation metrics to decide what ships next.- Align Operations, regional product teams, and engineers on priorities, trade-offs, and timelines throughout delivery.- Coordinate with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure the services we use are being consumed and to understand the end-to-end impact.Qualifications- 3-5 years of product management experience, ideally in marketplace, logistics, or e-commerce environments.- A track record of managing stakeholders through execution and aligning diverse teams on complex initiatives.- Hands-on ownership: you're comfortable working through details with engineers, including APIs and system behavior.- Comfort using data to define success measures and assess impact.- Experience working with data scientists, plus a working understanding of ML concepts and experimentation frameworks.- Ability to manage several competing priorities when operational conditions change quickly.Nice to have- Experience in logistics, delivery, or other supply-and-demand balancing problems.- Experience building internal tools for operations teams.- Exposure to rules engines, ranking, or personalization systems.- Experience launching AI-driven product features.Additional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. title: Field Service Specialist
description: Location: Europe – preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania.DTE is a fast-growing deep-tech company transforming how the metals industry controls and optimises its production. Our real-time melt chemistry technology gives aluminium producers immediate insight into their process, unlocking operational efficiency, higher yields and more sustainable production.As DTE expands its international operations, we are looking for a Field Service Specialist based in Europe to support future customer deployments and help establish our field service capabilities in the region.This is an opportunity to join a growing international team, work hands-on with innovative industrial technology and play an important role in building DTE's presence in the European market.Position SummaryThe Field Service Specialist will be part of DTE's Service, Production and Delivery team, supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of DTE's industrial analytical equipment as new customer deployments are established.You will work closely with customers during installation, start-up and service visits, configuring equipment to meet operational requirements, training operators and providing remote and on-site technical support.The role also involves close collaboration with DTE's Engineering and Service teams in Iceland and internationally, contributing practical field experience to product improvements and the development of service procedures.We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands demanding industrial environments and takes ownership of solving technical challenges.This is a hands-on technical role in demanding industrial environments involving heat, noise, dust and heavy machinery, requiring a strong commitment to safety, quality and reliable operation.Key ResponsibilitiesInstall, commission and service DTE's analytical equipment at customer sites as new deployments are established.Ensure installations and service work meet DTE's standards for quality, safety and reliability.Configure equipment, perform functional testing and train customer operators.Troubleshoot, maintain and repair equipment, providing both remote and on-site technical support.Assess customer site readiness ahead of installation, including power, utilities, access, lifting arrangements and safety requirements.Participate in an on-call rota for technical support as required.Collaborate with DTE's Engineering and Service teams to identify technical issues, implement improvements and support product development.Contribute to the development of service procedures, checklists, spare parts lists and troubleshooting documentation.Help establish and develop DTE's field service capabilities in Europe as the company expands into the region.Qualifications, Knowledge & ExperienceAt least 3 years of experience in field service, equipment assembly or technical support involving electronic or industrial equipment.A degree or vocational qualification in engineering, electronics, electrical technology or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.Experience troubleshooting automated control systems and industrial equipment.Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage technical challenges in the field.Comfortable working in demanding industrial environments, including foundries and aluminium production facilities.Strong commitment to safety, quality and customer service.Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.Knowledge of Polish, Czech, Romanian, German, Spanish, or other European languages is an advantage.Valid driving licence and passport.Legal authorisation to work or provide services in the country of residence.Experience in the metals industry, foundries or industrial automation, as well as electrical qualifications or certifications, would be an advantage.Location & TravelEmployment Type: We are open to both direct employment and independent contractor arrangements, depending on the candidate's location, experience and the most suitable contractual setup.Location: Preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania. This is a home-based field service position field service position, requiring regular international travel to support customer deployments, installations, training and technical service activities. The role is expected to involve approximately 50% travel, depending on project schedules and customer requirements. Travel will support DTE's international operations and future customer deployments in Europe, with visits to DTE headquarters in Iceland for training, product familiarisation and collaboration with Engineering and other teams.The successful candidate should live within convenient driving distance of a major international airport.For applications & inquiries send to: agusta@dte.aiLast application date is October 31st, 2026.Why DTE?We are past proving that the technology works. DTE's systems are already operating in production environments, and we are now scaling from individual installations to plant-wide deployments.We are solving a fundamental blind spot in one of the world's largest industries: metals producers cannot optimise what they cannot measure in real time.Our technology provides the foundation for real-time process control, higher recycling rates, lower emissions and the future of autonomous metals manufacturing.As we expand into Europe, you will have the opportunity to help build our regional service capabilities from the ground up, while working closely with an experienced international team.Our core values are purpose, excellence and empowerment. We look for people who are driven, resilient and motivated by building technology with real industrial impact.We encourage people of all genders to apply. DTE is committed to being an inclusive workplace where employees feel empowered, supported and able to do their best work. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Assistant driller
description: Seeking an assistant drillerIceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.Key Responsibilities:• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.• Assisting with cementing.• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.Qualifications & Requirements:• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.Employer can assist with housing.Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Panel Beater
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. JTK Remapping are seeking a Panel Beater for their business at Youghal Road, Dungarvan, Co. Qualifications and Experience
A minimum of 1 -3 years in panel beating essential

Remuneration is €36605 per annum based on 39 hours per week. If you feel you have the relevant experience please apply with your CV to Adriana@protentislresources.com

title: Construction -  Head of Mechanical Design
description:

The Head of Mechanical Design is a senior strategic leader within Glanua, responsible for shaping and delivering Glanua’s global mechanical design strategy across the group. This position provides clear strategic direction, ensuring design solutions are innovative, sustainable, commercially viable, and aligned with the company’s growth objectives. Acting as a visible leader, the role fosters a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance, while embedding best practices in design, digitalisation, and sustainability.

The Head of Mechanical Design will act as technical authority and oversee multiple engineering design teams, manage sub-consultant relationships, and ensure regulatory, safety, and quality standards are consistently met. They will champion modern methods of construction, promote design standardisation, and drive continuous improvement to enhance efficiency, reduce risk, and deliver lifecycle value for clients.

As a trusted partner to clients, stakeholders, and internal delivery teams, the role combines technical excellence with strong commercial and risk management oversight. It also plays a critical part in talent development, succession planning, and resource optimisation, building the strength and resilience of design teams for long-term success.

Ultimately, this role ensures Glanua maintains its reputation for delivering robust, technology driven, and sustainable engineering solutions that meet client needs and contribute to the company’s strategic growth.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Governance

·        Act as the senior technical authority for Mechanical Design function across the Glanua Group of companies

·        Develop and maintain discipline standards, specifications, procedures, design guidance and technical assurance requirements.

·        Ensure designs comply with relevant legislation, standards, client requirements and Glanua’s Engineering Management System.

·        Provide technical direction on complex, high-risk or non-standard mechanical and piping issues.

·        Define appropriate checking, verification and approval requirements and ensure technical risks are appropriately escalated.

·        Promote standardisation, repeatable solutions, modularisation and off site construction methods where

Qualifications and Experience:

·        Degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

·        Significant Mechanical & Piping engineering and design experience, including experience in a leadership or technical authority role.

·        Strong knowledge of mechanical equipment, piping systems, engineering standards and multidisciplinary design interfaces.

·        Experience working across the design and delivery lifecycle within a design-build, EPC or similar environment.

·        Experience of engineering assurance, design risk management and technical governance.

title: Construction - Electrical Project Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   This role is predominately site based in the Munster area, reporting into the regional office in Cork.

For for the initial phase you will be based on the Eli Lilly Limerick site for the next 6 to 8 months.



You will be dedicated to delivering electrical installations for the Irish, and UK, water and wastewater sectors, both municipal and industrial. In this role you will be reporting to the relevant Project Manager or Electrical Department Manager) depending on the project) and will be responsible for all elements of the electrical installation and delivery for, greenfield design and build, or brownfield refurbishment of water and wastewater treatment plants and associated equipment. Prior to design completion you will assess designs for constructability and completeness.

Due the continuous expansion of Glanua you may also be required to work on designs or delivery for other related industries. 

In this role you will actively promote and advocate the culture and ethos of Glanua and leverage on its unique solutions based and design focus to deliver innovative, sustainable and efficient design to the market.

You will work in a one-team culture while actively contributing to your own skills and experience. In this role, you will provide technical expertise in the implementation of the Electrical Design and Construction.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

The main duties and responsibilities of the Project Manager (Electrical) are outlined as follows:

·  Work as part of a team in the delivery of one or more projects at any one time, embracing the ethos of a “one team” culture.

·  Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site.

·  Be familiar with the HSQE management system and procedures in conjunction with the current statutory requirements

· Work on assigned projects to manage the delivery of the electrical and installation scope including design and procurement elements; installation supervision, commissioning and handover.

·  In conjunction with an electrical design engineer, design works include the compilation and review of M&I Listings, general services design, cable sizing/cable schedules, review I/O of listings, review of control panel drawings schematics, MIC load calculations, generator sizing/review, MV design review, etc.

·  Procurement of packages such as control panels, automation hardware/software, starters, electrical installation works, MV works and lightning protection.

·  Need to be familiar with programme and budgets for the project, fully understanding the impact any overruns shall have on the project

·  Ensure project is delivered in-line with quality procedures and that all Factory Acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), inspection and test records (ITRs), insulation resistance checks, I/O point-to-point checks, rotation checks and commissioning of the works are completed in-line with the quality plan

Key Role Responsibilities & Functions:
•	To fabricate, assemble, install and repair boilers, pressure vessels, tanks and other heavy steel structures, working from drawings and specifications to the required quality and safety standards.

•	Cut, shape, fit and weld steel plate, tube and pipework

•	Relevant Welding certification
•	Ability to work from drawings and to tight tolerances
•	Experience in plate and pipe welding in multiple positions in tube-to-tubesheet welding
•	Able to read and work from complex drawings, with accurate use of measuring and setting-out equipment
•	Experience of shutdowns, turnarounds and boiler outage work

description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. In this fulltime role, you will be supporting Individuals with complex communication needs and a range of hearing and/or sight loss, to live self-directed lives in homes in the community. In some cases, the Individuals you support may have physical and cognitive difficulties and behaviours that challenge. 
Key Responsibilities 
Facilitate and promote a person-centred approach, appropriate to the needs and wishes of the Service User
Work with Service Users, to enable them live in a community of their choosing, facilitating their ongoing involvement in their interests and hobbies ensuring access to local resources
Work with Service Users in a way that promotes safeguarding, equality, dignity, diversity and their rights 
Supporting Service Users in directing their own lives, ensuring positive risk taking, in an environment that reflects the comforts of home
Supporting Service Users to enjoy the good things in life, make sense of their environment, learn new skills and maximise their independence
Assist with cooking, cleaning, shopping and general domestic tasks in the Service User’s home  
Understand and facilitate Service User’s needs, using their preferred communication system
Establish, through continuity of work with Service Users, trusting professional relationships 
Ensure respect of the Service User’s will and preference to take on new tasks ensuring a positive risk assessment is carried out 
Provide assistance with aspects of personal care, people handling, ensuring dignity, safe practices for Service User’s  
Accompany Service Users to appointments and other events 
Act as advocate for Service users, who may have difficulty in expressing their needs
Support Service User’s to have meaningful relationships, keep in contact with family and friends and to develop their social networks if they choose to. Assist with keyworking
Adopt a positive behaviour support approach to respond effectively to any potentially challenging situations
Adhere to all ASC Policies, Employee Handbook and work practices  
Adhere to all relevant national policies, including (but not limited to) HIQA Standards, HSE Policies, safeguarding   
Adhere to procedures to maintain the Service User’s home to the appropriate standards  
Adhere to Health & Safety standards and ensure that the health and safety of each Service user is central
Maintain a high level of infection prevention and control within the Service User’s home   
Report any health and safety issues to the Health and Safety officer 
Ask questions to check when unsure of protocols, share information with the team that has a direct impact on Service users, be clear and factual in communications
Attend Team Meeting Complete daily logs and show  respect to other team members
Reach out to more experienced RSWs and learn from them 
Work collaboratively and supportively with the multi-disciplinary team 
Undertake duties as may be assigned by the Manager or Team Leader to support the care of Service users.

title: Associate Professor in Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Society
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. The School of Medicine seeks to appoint a 1.0 FTE Associate Professor in Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Society to provide academic leadership at a moment of profound technological transformation in healthcare and higher education.

This is a strategic joint appointment between the School of Medicine and the University. The postholder will devote approximately half of their activity to establishing institutional capability in Digital Health, AI and Connected Health within medicine. The other half will be dedicated to a new university-wide initiative, currently in development, that will explore how artificial intelligence may fundamentally reshape learning, universities, knowledge creation and professional formation. The postholder will be expected to play a formative role in shaping this initiative from its earliest stages.
 
Post status: Specific Purpose Contract
This employment is not offered on an indefinite duration basis as the appointment is required to deliver a defined, specific and time-limited, programme to establish a university-wide ecosystem for responsible AI innovation in medicine, education and research. When the specific programme of work is completed, there will no longer be a need for the role.
 
Hours of Post: Hours of work for academic staff are those as prescribed under Public Service Agreements. For further information please follow this link:  http://www.tcd.ie/hr/assets/pdf/academic-hours-public-service-agreement.pdf 

Salary: Appointment will be made on Associate Professor Salary Scale commensurate with qualifications / experience and in line with Public Sector Pay Policy [€93,914 - €121,273 per annum]   https://www.tcd.ie/hr/assets/pdf/monthly-academic.pdf
 
How to apply: Applicants should submit:
1. Cover Letter (maximum one page)
2. Curriculum Vitae
3. Teaching Statement (maximum two pages)
4. Research and Scholarship Statement (maximum two pages)
5. Vision Statement outlining how they would contribute to building capacity in Connected Health, Digital Health and AI Literacy within Trinity College Dublin (maximum two pages)

Applications are only accepted via the Trinity College Dublin vacancy page. 

Candidates who do not submit the above application documents will not be considered for shortlisting.

Any applications which are still in progress at the closing time on the specified closing date will be cancelled automatically by the system.
 
Please see the Job Description below for this position.
 
Informal enquiries about this post should be made to Colin Doherty, Professor Consultant, Clinical Medicine, E: CDOHERT@tcd.ie

At Trinity, we are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome applications from all individuals, including those with disabilities, those who have followed non-traditional career paths, and those who have taken time out for reasons such as family or caring responsibilities.

title: Special Care Worker Special Care Services - Ballydowd & Crannóg Nua Dublin
description:

The policy of Tusla Child and Family Agency is to enable children / young people to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. The Social Care Worker will provide care, protection, and support to vulnerable or dependent clients, individually or in groups, in conjunction with the wider multidisciplinary team and other relevant agencies. The primary aim is to provide intervention necessary to address the child / young person’s issues or the issues that are preventing them from living at home or in relative / foster care. S/he will ensure the welfare of those under his/her care and will act as an advocate as appropriate.
 Social Care Workers in a Residential setting work as part of a multidisciplinary team to provide care to service users. Children / young people may be referred to a residential setting for a number of reasons by the Social Work department e.g. family breakdown / separation, history of neglect, sexual / physical abuse, addiction or mental health issues. Residential care aims to provide a therapeutic care placement to service users who most often present with emotional or behavioural difficulties and cannot live with their own families. Applicants must by the closing date of application have the following:

-	Be registered in the Social Care Worker Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained at CORU (or have entitlement to be registered and obtain registration prior to appointment).

             And
-	Maintain live annual registration on the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board at CORU.
or 

*Hold one of the following qualifications and be committed to a pathway towards Social Care education: 

-	Youth and Community work qualification
-	BA (Hons) Youth and Community Development
-	BA (Hons) Psychology
-	Addiction Studies (Level 7)
-	BA (Hons) Counselling and Addiction Studies
-	Disability Diploma (Primary Care)
-	Degree in Social Science (minimum Level 7) 
or equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction

Experience with Fabric Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Warehouses and Notebooks is required.• Strong SQL, Python and PySpark skills for data ingestion, transformation and analysis.• Experience developing end-to-end data pipelines and implementing medallion architecture.• Strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling, including Kimball standards.• Experience designing and building Power BI semantic models.• Practical experience with Git integration, version control and CI/CD pipelines for data projects.• Experience implementing data quality frameworks, reconciliation processes and testing methodologies.• Ability to produce clear solution designs, source-to-target mappings and technical documentation.• Confidence working directly with clients on requirements, technical decisions and delivery matters.• Experience reviewing technical outputs and coordinating the work of other delivery team members.• Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving and organisational skills.Desirable Experience• Experience with Databricks, Azure Synapse or other Azure data services alongside Microsoft Fabric.• Previous consulting or client-delivery experience.• Relevant Microsoft certifications, particularly DP-700 or DP-600. DP-203 is also valued.• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)• Accurate, complete and technically sound deliverables.• Delivery against agreed milestones and project commitments.• Positive client feedback on technical execution, communication and solution reliability.• Client renewal and commercial growth• High standards of code quality, governance, version control and documentation.• Effective coordination and support of project team members.• Continued development of Microsoft Fabric expertise and relevant certifications.• Contribution to pre-sales activity and identification of further value for existing clients.What we offer:• Competitive salary.• 25 days’ annual leave per year.• Pension and healthcare, subject to successful completion of the probationary period.• Dedicated learning and development days.• Flexible working arrangements.• Team-building days and a collaborative team culture.For more information, please contact careers@theinformationlab.ie

title: Experienced Grounds Maintenance Operative
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   About the job
We are looking for a hardworking, reliable and practical person to join us in carrying out garden maintenance and lawn care throughout Mid-Kerry and Killarney.
This is a hands-on, outdoor role for someone who enjoys physical work, takes pride in doing a good job and is comfortable working in changeable Irish weather.
Some previous gardening or grounds maintenance experience is essential, but we are happy to train the right person who has a positive attitude, is willing to learn and takes their responsibilities seriously.
You will work at different properties throughout the area, helping to maintain gardens and outdoor spaces to a high standard.

Main duties;
Lawn mowing, strimming and general lawn care.
Hedge trimming, pruning and weeding.
General garden maintenance and seasonal work.
Safe use and care of gardening machinery.
Keeping gardens and work areas tidy.
Working efficiently and taking pride in the quality of your work.
The person we're looking for

The ideal candidate will be:
Reliable, punctual and hardworking.
Experienced in basic gardening, lawn care or similar outdoor work.
Physically fit and comfortable with practical, outdoor work.
Happy to work in rain, cold and changeable weather when conditions are safe.
Willing to learn new skills and operate machinery safely.
Attentive to detail and committed to doing a good job.
Able to work well with others and follow instructions.
A full driving licence is an advantage.

Working hours and weather;
This is a full-time position, with a typical working week of approximately 39 hours, depending on workload and weather conditions.
Hours may vary from week to week, and working hours may reduce during the winter months when weather conditions are unpredictable.
We work outdoors throughout the year where conditions allow. However, we do not work during storms or flooding, and work may be postponed when conditions are unsafe.
Flexibility and an understanding of the seasonal nature of gardening work are important.

Travel and equipment;
Work takes place at different locations throughout Mid-Kerry and Killarney. We meet at an agreed base and travel to the day's jobs together.
All main gardening machinery and equipment are supplied by the business. You do not need to purchase or bring your own lawnmower, strimmer, hedge trimmer or other main machinery.
We will explain any requirements for suitable work clothing and footwear before you start.

What we offer;
Full-time outdoor work.
Main gardening machinery and equipment provided.
The opportunity to develop your gardening and grounds maintenance skills.
Hands-on training for the right candidate.
A varied role working at different properties throughout the area.
Pay will be discussed based on experience and suitability for the role.

How to apply
Please send us your CV and a short description of your gardening, grounds maintenance or other practical outdoor work experience.
We are looking for someone dependable who takes pride in their work.

The role can be tailored to your experience and career goals, whether you wish to broaden your consultancy experience across tax, focus on compliance or develop a specialist area.

Experience in TP documentation, benchmarking, financial modelling and technical report writing. Exposure to audits, dispute resolution or advisory projects (e.g. supply chain, IP or restructuring) is advantageous.

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and economic data.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.

Are you a purpose driven individual who is passionate about making a difference and helping some of society’s most vulnerable children? At Barnardos, we pride ourselves on delivering impactful services that make a difference to the lives of children and families across Ireland. 

We believe that childhood lasts a lifetime. As trauma informed specialists our core purpose is to provide the necessary support for children to overcome childhood adversity, embedding a trauma informed ethos and practice into every service we provide. 

What we can offer you?

As a Programme Assistant we appreciate the value of your time when providing essential support to our services, that’s why we have the necessary support structures and network in place that will allow you to make a real impact on the lives of children across Ireland. We also offer the following:

Barnardos offers a competitive salary – recognising the experience you bring to the role

Provide a safe and appropriate environment for children to participate in the service.
Ensure all children attending the service receive an appropriate level of supervision.

Experience or understanding of working with vulnerable children and families.

Relevant voluntary work/work experience may be considered

Recognised qualification (minimum Level 5 on the QQI/ FETAC) that is approved under the Early Years’ (Pre-school) Regulations.
