title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
description: Per solida realtà operante nell'industria edile, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Responsabile di Commessa. La persona avrà la responsabilità di seguire la commessa 'end-to-end' sul campo, garantendo che attività, squadre e fornitori lavorino in modo coordinato, mantenendo una relazione efficace con il cliente. Obiettivo del ruolo Gestire operativamente una o più commesse assicurando l'avanzamento regolare dei lavori e un controllo puntuale su programmazione, risorse, varianti, consegne e marginalità, con approccio pratico e orientamento al risultato. Attività principali Programmare commesse e cantieri: pianificare l'alternanza dei lavori nel medio-lungo periodo in funzione di scadenze contrattuali e durata dei cantieri. Organizzare le attività di apertura del cantiere fino alla chiusura, definendo attività giornaliere e settimanali, monitorando lo stato avanzamento lavori. Gestire operatività, standard e comportamenti, lavorando su efficienza, metodo e rispetto delle procedure con squadre e subappaltatori. Raccogliere esigenze e gestire criticità in modo concreto (es. ripianificazione dell'ordine di montaggio senza perdere il controllo su tempi e costi). Controllo tempi/contratti/spedizioni: presidiare consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra, assicurando coerenza tra accordi e operatività. Controllo economico di commessa: supportare stime e consuntivi, contribuendo alla tutela della marginalità e alla gestione economica. Collaborazione con uffici interni (tecnico, produzione, logistica) per garantire la continuità delle attività e il corretto flusso di arrivo dei materiali sui cantieri. Requisiti Laurea in Ingegneria/Architettura o Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). Esperienza indicativa di ~10 anni su cantieri industriali con ruoli di responsabilità (capocantiere / responsabile operativo / responsabile di commessa). Capacità di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte sui cantieri (Italia settentrionale) Leadership 'sul campo', attenzione a regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottime doti relazionali: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione e problem solving. Affidabilità, pragmatismo e forte orientamento a tempi e consegne. Sede di lavoro: provincia di Cuneo e cantieri (Italia settentrionale) RAL indicativa: 40.000-50.000 €, commisurata all'esperienza Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: Database and network professionals
description: Per importante struttura sanitaria, stiamo cercando un/una: Senior IT Systems Specialist - Site Ownership La risorsa sarà l'unico presidio ICT interno della sede: garantirà continuità operativa e sicurezza dei servizi IT, gestendo in prima persona le attività tecniche e coordinando i fornitori, contribuendo anche a dare un indirizzo su priorità e roadmap locale in raccordo con Direzione e IT di gruppo. Responsabilità Presidio operativo IT di sede: gestione e supporto su postazioni, rete/Wi-Fi, stampanti/periferiche, sale e ambulatori; troubleshooting di 1°/2° livello, gestione ticket ed escalation. Sistemi informativi sanitari: configurazione, manutenzione e monitoraggio di applicativi (es. cartella clinica elettronica, prenotazioni/CUP, telemedicina e integrazioni correlate). Vendor management: punto di contatto per fornitori IT (assistenza applicativa/infrastrutturale), pianificazione interventi, verifica deliverable e qualità del servizio (SLA/KPI), escalation. Continuità di servizio: monitoraggio servizi critici, backup/restore, gestione incident e piani di ripristino in coordinamento con IT centrale. Sicurezza e compliance: applicazione delle policy e supporto a audit/controlli (GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2 e linee guida interne), gestione accessi/utenze e aggiornamenti in raccordo con il gruppo. Indirizzo e miglioramento: raccolta esigenze dei reparti, proposta di priorità e interventi (quick win + strutturali), ottimizzazione dei flussi digitali clinico-amministrativi, supporto al change e formazione utenti. Requisiti Esperienza in ruoli IT con responsabilità end-to-end su sede/plant o contesti regolati; preferibile esposizione a healthcare. Conoscenza delle principali infrastrutture ICT e networking (es. Fortinet/Cisco/Aruba/Watchguard o equivalenti). Conoscenza di sistemi di Virtualizzazione e backup (es. VMware/Proxmox, Veeam o equivalenti). Conoscenza database (SQL e principali RDBMS: Oracle/PostgreSQL, ecc.) a livello operativo. Autonomia, capacità di prioritizzazione, comunicazione efficace con utenti e Direzione; gestione di più attività in parallelo. Plus Esperienza con sistemi sanitari (es. H2O, Dedalus, TuoTempo o equivalenti) e integrazioni. Certificazioni (Microsoft, VMware, Fortinet, ITIL o simili). Esperienza su telemedicina e/o iniziative di cybersecurity in sanità. description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per conto di EA srl, realtà di riferimento nella progettazione, realizzazione e manutenzione di infrastrutture energetiche complesse e sistemi di automazione, selezioniamo un/una SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER - BU CONSTRUCTION EA srl opera come partner tecnico riconosciuto da primari player istituzionali (Enel, Terna, grandi produttori di energia) e si distingue per la capacità di offrire soluzioni 'chiavi in mano' altamente personalizzate. Il ruolo Sarai la figura chiave nella gestione strategica e operativa di commesse complesse (stazioni elettriche AT di allaccio, impianti idroelettrici, revamping tecnologici, grandi contratti O&M), con responsabilità su tempi, costi, qualità e sicurezza. Avrai un impatto diretto nel prevenire criticità di cantiere, migliorare il coordinamento e consolidare la relazione con clienti istituzionali. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: ricercatore universitario/ricercatrice universitaria
description: Grafton LifeScience - Valorizziamo il tuo potenziale nel mondo LifeScience Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, dedicati a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito R&D, Clinical Research, Regulatory, Quality e Operation per il settore Farmaceutico e Medicale. Lavoriamo per accompagnare ogni persona verso le mansioni e i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le sue competenze e aspettative. Per il Gruppo Sterling, sede di Malta, ricerchiamo un/una QP & QA Manager con solida esperienza in ambito GMP, a supporto del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del Sistema Qualità aziendale. Costituisce requisito essenziale il possesso dei requisiti di QP eligibility secondo la normativa vigente applicabile (EU/Malta). Perché Sterling e perché Malta? - Internazionalità che arricchisce: un team di 8 nazionalità diverse, dove ogni giorno si impara a leggere situazioni nuove e a crescere anche sul piano personale. - Crescita reale e visibilità: il talento viene riconosciuto, la fiducia è concreta. Chi dimostra determinazione costruisce un percorso rapido e solido. - Formazione continua: programmi pensati per sviluppare competenze tecniche e soft skills, con HR e management sempre presenti. - Esperienza internazionale e qualità della vita: Malta è vicina a casa ma immersa in un contesto globale. Lavorare qui significa investire su se stessi, in un ambiente dinamico che stimola apertura mentale e capacità di adattamento. title: Service Engineer

description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. Se opastaa työympäristön peruskäytöstä aina vaativiin yritysrahoituksen tilanteisiin.Opiskelet omaan tahtiisi, harjoittelet käytännön tilanteita ja osoitat osaamisesi osaamiskokeilla. Etenemisestä saat osaamismerkkejä. **Harjoituksia voit uusia rajattomasti.****Mitä teet Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijana?**- hankit yritysasiakkaita ja avaat keskustelun yrittäjien kanssa heidän hankkeistaan - kartoitat rahoitustarpeen ja kokoat tilinpäätös- ja tapaamistiedot - tarkistat rahoitusanalyysin ja käyt Asiakasraportin läpi asiakkaan kanssa - valmistelet Rahoittajapaketin ja huolehdit sovituista jatkotoimista - pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla hankkeen loppuun saakka **Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti.** Ymmärrät asiakkaan tilanteen ja rakennat sille oikean rahoitusratkaisun. **Trusty Finance on yritykselle maksuton**, mikä madaltaa kynnystä aloittaa keskustelu.**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Voit tulla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnin, yritysasiakastyön, pankin, rahoituksen tai taloushallinnon parista. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. Voit toimia oman yrityksen kautta tai kevytyrittäjänä, tai voit perustaa yrityksen aloituksen yhteydessä. **Yhteistyö edellyttää Y-tunnusta.** Voit hakea myös, jos olet valmis hankkimaan sen ennen aloittamista.**Ansainta perustuu toteutuneisiin rahoituksiin**Ansaitset provisiota toteutuneista rahoituksista. Aktiivisella tekemisellä ansaintatavoite on **noin 2 000–10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**, ja kokeneilla tekijöillä **yli 10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**. **Palkkiokattoa ei ole.**Kyse on yrittäjän provisiotulosta, ei kiinteästä palkasta eikä taatusta ansiosta. Ansainta riippuu toteutuneista rahoituksista, ja käteen jäävään tuloon vaikuttavat omat yrityskulut ja verot.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- **Trusty Finance Broker** -työympäristön koko asiakastyöhön - **FSG Trusty Finance Akatemian**, jossa osaamisesi kasvaa vaihe vaiheelta - **laajan suomalaisten ja pohjoismaisten rahoittajien verkoston** - oman trustyfinance.fi-sähköpostiosoitteen - perehdytyksen ja tuen perustajatiimiltä - mahdollisuuden edetä vaativampiin asiakassuhteisiin ja suurempiin rahoitushankkeisiin FSG Financial Services Groupin perustajatiimillä on yhteensä **yli 95 vuotta kokemusta** rahoituksesta, varainhoidosta ja teknologiasta. Tämä kokemus on tukenasi alusta alkaen.**Mitä tarvitset aloittaaksesi?**- oman tietokoneen, puhelimen ja internetyhteyden - sujuvan suomen kielen taidon ja ammattimaisen otteen asiakasviestintään - Y-tunnuksen tai valmiuden hankkia se ennen yhteistyön alkua **Hae Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijaksi**Haluatko ottaa vastuun koko rahoitushankkeesta ja rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi uuden työympäristön tuella? title: Payroll Manager - Luxembourg & International H/F
description: Description du poste Vos responsabilités En tant que Payroll Manager, vous pilotez l'ensemble des sujets liés à la paie et assurez notamment : La supervision du processus de paie au Luxembourg et dans plusieurs juridictions internationales ; La coordination et le pilotage des prestataires Payroll externes ; La préparation, la collecte et le contrôle rigoureux des éléments variables et données nécessaires à l'établissement des paies ; La vérification approfondie des outputs produits par les providers avant validation ; La gestion des situations complexes ou particulier/ières ayant un impact sur la rémunération et la paie ; Le suivi des entrées, sorties, absences, congés, avantages, bonus et autres éléments ayant une incidence Payroll ; Le suivi des obligations sociales, fiscales et réglementaires liées à la paie, en collaboration avec les experts et prestataires concernés ; La gestion et la résolution des écarts, anomalies ou problématiques Payroll ; Le suivi des déclarations, échéances et obligations associées ; La coordination avec les équipes HR, Finance et les différentes parties prenant/antes internes et externes ; Le suivi de la performance des prestataires et la sécurisation des SLA ; La documentation et l'amélioration continue des processus, contrôles et procédures Payroll ; La participation aux audits et aux différents contrôles internes ou externes ; Une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions légales et réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter la paie. Au-delà du cycle mensuel, vous êtes la personne de référence sur l'ensemble des problématiques Payroll et êtes capable d'identifier un risque, d'analyser une situation complexe et d'en sécuriser le traitement. Profil recherché Nous recherchons avant tout une expertise Payroll solide et éprouvée. Vous disposez : D'au moins  années d'expérience dans le domaine de la paie, acquises dans des environnements structurés et exigeants ; D'une excellente maîtrise de la paie luxembourgeoise, de ses mécanismes et de son environnement réglementaire ; D'une expérience dans la gestion ou la supervision de paies dans plusieurs pays ; D'une expérience significative dans un modèle de paie externalisée, avec pilotage de providers ; D'une capacité à challenger un prestataire et à contrôler la qualité et la cohérence des données produites ; D'une excellente compréhension des interactions entre Payroll, HR, Finance, fiscalité et législation sociale ; D'un anglais courant, indispensable pour évoluer quotidien/iennement dans un environnement international. La connaissance du secteur financier constitue un atout . Ce qui fera réellement la différence La technicité Payroll est indispensable, mais elle ne suffira pas. Nous recherchons une personnalité reconnue pour son extrême rigueur, sa fiabilité et son sens du détail. Vous êtes à l'aise avec des données sensibles, savez travailler avec des échéances incompressibles et conservez un niveau d'exigence élevé, y compris dans des environnements complexes. Vous aimez comprendre ce qui se trouve derrier/ière les chiffres, identifier les incohérences et vous assurer qu'aucun sujet ne reste sans réponse. Autonome et structuré(e), vous savez également coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs et prestataires, poser le bon niveau d'exigence et prendre pleinement la responsabilité de votre périmètre. Pourquoi rejoindre cette organisation ? Vous rejoignez un environnement international dans lequel la fonction Payroll occupe une place stratégique et nécessite un niveau élevé de fiabilité, de confidentialité et d'expertise. Le poste offre un périmètre à la fois luxembourgeois et international, une réelle autonomie ainsi qu'une forte exposition auprès des différentes fonctions de l'organisation. Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil ? Nous serons ravis d'échanger avec vous en toute confidentialité. Votre expérience candidat avec People Solutions by Arhis Pour garantir que votre profil corresponde à nos postes, nous vous accompagnons à travers un processus de recrutement complet, comprenant des entretiens individuels, des assessment centers, des questionnaires de personnalité et de motivation, ainsi que des sessions de coaching réalisées par des coachs certifiés au sein de notre équipe. Soyez assuré que nous examinons minutieur/eusement toutes les candidatures reçues, y compris celles confirmées automatiquement lors de la réception. Votre profil sera évalué par un consultant spécialisé dans votre domaine d'expertise. Nous sommes à l'écoute de vos besoins, nous vous tenons informé et vous conseillons tout au long du processus de recrutement jusqu'à votre intégration chez notre client. Nous nous engageons à vous offrir notre expertise afin de garantir le succès de votre futur projet professionnel. www.peoplesolutionsbyarhis.lu

title: Payroll Expert (m/f)
description: Payroll Expert @BDO LuxembourgBDO Luxembourg is looking for a Payroll Expert!Who are we?BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.What will you do? This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Level  Senior Associate – Corporate Secretarial Services (m/f)
description: Description:Level  Senior Associate – Corporate Secretarial ServicesCo-Sec - Centre of Excellence - CD0404 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)About Waystone  Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. This role is responsible for working on a single client relationship, with a complex portfolio of underlying client entities (ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, overseeing corporate documentation and supporting board governance processes), assisting with the delivery of services within a team, managing multiple underlying client relationships and reviewing work produced by others within the teams servicing this single client and its underlying relationships. Key responsibilities include maintaining statutory records, managing company lifecycle events and operations. The role also involves client relationship management and contributing to strategic initiatives such as project work and process improvement. Strong organizational, communication and regulatory knowledge are essential for success in this position. Key responsibilities:• Manage a complex portfolio of underlying clients, within a single client relationship.• Manage operations for that portfolio, ensuring delivery within the team's specified timeframes and procedures;• Compile management information, team performance and KPI tracking for management;• Maintain and update client files and corporate records in accordance with regulatory and internal standards;• Provide guidance, training and mentorship to team members and members of the wider Corporate Secretarial Services team, if required;• Manage administrative tasks including regulatory filings, RBE register updates, RCS deposits, document execution and safekeeping and legalisation processes;• Support company lifecycle events such as formations, dissolutions and annual obligations (AGMs, EGM) as well as ad-hoc corporate secretarial matters (e.g., changes to directors, registered office and share capital);• Take full ownership of delegated tasks and contribute actively to team success;• Demonstrate deep knowledge of fund corporate governance and regulatory filing requirements, staying informed of relevant changes;• Draft, finalise, manage and/ or review resolutions and other corporate documentation;• Prioritise workload effectively, identifying and escalating scheduling conflicts or delays as needed;• Exhibit strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills;• Be flexible and willing to take on additional responsibilities as required;• Support board support activities, including meeting organisation, coordination with attendees, preparation, distribution and/or review of materials, drafting and/or review of minutes and managing post-meeting actions;• Assist with the drafting of processes and procedures, as necessary.• Provide support to colleagues when capacity allows and communicate availability to management;• Assist with inbox monitoring and task processing during team absences;• Ensure timely follow-up with relationship managers and board members for documentation turnaround;• Professionally and independently liaise with fund service providers;• Maintain accurate company registers;• Adhere to current Waystone policies and procedures;• Support recruitment efforts for the team;• Contribute to invoicing and fee-related activities;• Assist with, or in some instances, manage projects impacting team title: Senior Relationship Manager - Private Banking - Belgian Market (m/f)
description: Senior Relationship Manager - Private Banking - Belgian Market (M/F)Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations. Your next challenge:You will be responsible for acquiring and building relationships with new clients and intermediaries from Belgium. The position is based in Luxembourg. What will you do? • Join a multidisciplinary team and participate in a growth strategy in a core market.• Develop your business plan and use all the capabilities that BIL offers to gradually create your own client portfolio.• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences) as needed to develop your own portfolio.• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new clients.• Build and establish long-term, trusting client relationships.• Maintain an in-depth knowledge of current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate potential business opportunities for clients.• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads and ensure excellent after-sales service to guarantee client satisfaction.• Use the internal CRM to track your business development activities.Your skills: You have: • A proven track record in Wealth Management, as a Relationship Manager  • A strong network of private customers and financial intermediaries in Belgium • An excellent knowledge of the products and services that Belgian private customers and financial intermediaries typically require (asset management, wealth planning, financing solutions) • Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships • Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals • A high level of integrity and ethics • A relevant University background in Finance• CFA / CAIA / CISI or other related financial certifications are seen as an advantageYou are: • Fluent in Dutch and English, French is seen as an advantage • Strongly client- and results-oriented • Rigorous, organized and methodical in customer approach actions • Motivated to be part of a team • Willing and able to travel.BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience. BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all. NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled.

title: Senior Valuation Officer (m/f)
description: About Waystone Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years' experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansionJOB PURPOSE The Senior Valuation Officer plays a key role in overseeing and supporting the valuation framework for UCITS and AIF structures managed or supervised by Waystone. In addition to providing high-quality valuation oversight and technical expertise, the role contributes actively to the commercial enablement of the Waystone service by supporting client engagement, model design, and the articulation of Waystone's valuation capabilities to internal and external stakeholders. The role operates at the intersection of technical valuation, regulatory compliance, and client-facing service delivery.ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES • Assist in leading and overseeing the valuation process for a portfolio of alternative investment funds, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with relevant regulations and internal policies.• Act as a senior valuation subject-matter expert in support of client, commercial, and product initiatives, including RFPs, client due diligence, and service design discussions.• Participate in client and prospect discussions to explain valuation frameworks, governance, and methodologies in a clear, structured, and credible manner.• Support the onboarding of new funds and mandates, including documenting, reviewing, and validating valuation frameworks, methodologies, and governance arrangements in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders.• Contribute to the enhancement and ongoing maintenance of valuation policies, procedures, and internal controls in line with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.• Monitor regulatory developments affecting valuation activities and industry standards and contribute to impact assessments and implementation actions.• Conduct valuation analyses across a broad range of asset classes, including liquid instruments, complex financial instruments, and illiquid assets, and support the preparation of valuation reports and committee materials for internal and external stakeholders.• Coordinate and support valuation-related audits, regulatory queries, and due diligence exercises carried out by auditors, regulators, depositaries, and investors, in support of the Head of Valuation.• Identify and support opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and enhancement of valuation methodologies to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability of the valuation function.• Collaborate with internal commercial, client service, and product teams to ensure valuation considerations are appropriately articulated.• Promote a culture of quality, accountability, regulatory awareness, and commercial mindset.• Act as a trusted internal point of reference on valuation-related topics across the organisation.REQUIREMENTS • You hold a University Master's degree in Economics, Finance or Mathematics. A specialization in quantitative economics will be considered as an advantage.• 7+ years experience in valuation within the asset management industry is preferred, with a focus on alternative investment funds.• Strong understanding of valuation principles, methodologies, and techniques for a wide range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, derivatives, and alternative investments.• Strong knowledge of quantitative finance, risk management methods and financial instruments.• Profound knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to valuation of AIFMDs and UCITS.• Professional certification preferred, CFA, FRM CAIA, CFI certifications or any valuation certificate.• Good analytical, organizational, writing and communication skills.• Able to work both independently. Recognized team player.• Fluent in English; any other language will be considered as an asset.

description: SD-26154-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN LAND SURFACE MODELLING OF FOREST ECOSYSTEMSFixed term contract | Belvaux | 12 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/How will you contribute?The researcher will participate in two complementary projects focused on modelling forest ecosystem responses across seasonal to decadal timescales: SORTIE (Seasonal Forecast of Forest Status in Luxembourg), funded by the National Collaboration Program (NCP) of the Copernicus Climate Change Services, and HiDRATE (Integrating High resolution Data from Remote sensing And land surface models for Transpiration and Evaporation mapping), funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR). The overarching objective is to quantify the predictive capabilities of land surface models in capturing forest ecosystem responses under stress and to translate their outputs into diagnostic indicators. To address these challenges, both projects will jointly employ the latest version of the Community Terrestrial Systems Model (CTSM), multiple in situ measurements (e.g., sap flow, eddy-covariance fluxes, dendrometers), various Earth Observation (EO) data streams, and climate information across multiple temporal scales. The selected candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling group of the Environmental Sensing and Modelling unit and will collaborate closely with the national project partner MeteoLux and the international project partner CESBIO.The selected candidate will play a central role in both projects and their scientific outputs. The primary mission is to: (1) implement the CTSM model across multiple forest monitoring sites; (2) develop a robust analytical framework to assess model sensitivity to environmental drivers using in situ and EO data; and (3) synthesize model outputs into diagnostic indicators that integrate meteorological conditions, forest fluxes, phenological dynamics, biomass productivity, and forest health status. To accomplish these objectives, the candidate will apply advanced statistical methods and leverage high-performance computing (HPC) resources. The candidate will actively contribute to the dissemination, valorisation and transfer of project results. This will include presenting findings at national and international scientific conferences, publishing in reputable peer-reviewed journals, and communicating outcomes to relevant stakeholders. title: Telecoms Software Engineer (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Telecom Software EngineerWith our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in satellite IoT connectivity and next-generation non-terrestrial network (NTN) services. As the first company to seamlessly integrate standardized cellular technology with satellites, OQ Technology is transforming how connected devices communicate beyond the reach of terrestrial networks.Our technology enables secure, scalable connectivity for industries including Oil & Gas, Utilities, Mining, Agriculture, Maritime, Logistics, Transport, and Environmental Monitoring, helping organizations monitor and manage critical assets anywhere in the world. We are now extending this capability to 5G NR-NTN direct-to-device (D2D) services, connecting commercial smartphones and dedicated terminals directly to satellites.As we continue to develop our 5G NR-NTN D2D missions, we are looking for an experienced Telecom Software Engineer to join our Telecom Team at our facility in Luxembourg, reporting to the Team Lead. You will develop, integrate and test the OQ 5G gNodeB protocol stack adapted to run onboard our satellites, working across 3GPP specification study, NTN adaptation of L2 and L3, C/C++ implementation, and porting to space-representative processing platforms. You will validate your work hands-on in our telecom lab against commercial smartphones and D2D terminals, and collaborate closely with a multi-disciplinary team spanning the 5G Core, user equipment, and the satellite payload.Job Location:  LUXEMBOURGStarting Date:  Start ImmediatelyJob Type:  UNLIMITEDTasks:  The tasks below are representative and not exhaustive. The Company may assign the post holder to other tasks where it considers this in its interests.General and Teamwork• Contribute to OQ's 5G NR-NTN D2D projects, delivering assigned tasks to the agreed schedule and quality.• Carry out hands-on experiments in the Telecom Lab to test and validate new implementations and theoretical concepts.• Take part in Telecom Team brainstorming sessions and technical discussions, and share relevant findings with the team.• Report task progress and completion status to the Team Lead at regular intervals.• Support colleagues on other project tasks and on hands-on troubleshooting.• Take on additional work on the 3GPP NTN NB-IoT protocol stack, eNodeB and UE sides, including end-to-end and interoperability testing with third-party and commercial devices.Technical• Review mission and project documentation to understand scope, objectives and technical baseline, including statements of work, proposals, 3GPP discussion notes and progress reports.• Study the NR-NTN direct-to-device problem across the use cases, protocol layers and procedures each mission depends on, including services such as SMS over NAS and emergency broadcast, the L2 and L3 adaptations NTN requires, TDD DL-UL pattern design, initial access and system information acquisition, and the effects of long propagation delay and Doppler shift on the link.• Review the relevant 3GPP specifications to extract requirements, confirm compliance and identify technical constraints.• Build working knowledge of the open-source gNodeB stack: code structure, software architecture, build, installation, configuration and execution.• Port and adapt the stack to onboard processing environments, covering cross-compilation, embedded Linux targets, real-time performance, CPU and memory budgets, and interfaces to the FPGA/SDR physical layer.• Develop new C/C++ code blocks from the preceding studies, and carry out unit, functional and end-to-end testing in the lab on representative hardware.• Gain knowledge of the other system elements: the 5G Core Network (5GC), the UE (commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals), and the satellite platform (onboard processing units, FPGA, SDR and RF front-end).• Maintain continuous documentation of research, analysis, requirements, design, proposed solutions and evaluation results.• Commit work to the project GitLab repositories under version control on a continuous basis.• Raise concerns, open questions, risks and critical issues with the team as soon as they are identified.RequirementsEssential• MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.• Minimum five years of professional software development experience in telecoms or embedded systems.• Commercial experience in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux, in a real-time or embedded context, including multithreaded and latency-sensitive code.• CMake-based build systems.• Working knowledge of 5G NR Higher L1 and L2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC) and of the cell search, system information and random-access procedures.• Ability to read 3GPP specifications and translate them into design and code.• Automated unit and integration testing with GoogleTest/GoogleMock or Catch2, run through CTest within GitLab CI, with JUnit XML test reports and code coverage (gcov, lcov or gcovr) published to merge requests.• GitLab workflows: merge requests, code review, and CI/CD pipelines using containerised (Docker) build and test runners.• Debugging and runtime analysis with GDB and sanitisers (AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer).• Protocol and log analysis using Wireshark and UE or terminal diagnostic tools.• Professional written and spoken English.Desirable• Experience with open-source RAN stacks (for example srsRAN or OpenAirInterface).• Familiarity with 3GPP Release 17 and later NTN features.• MAC scheduler, carrier aggregation or TDD pattern design experience.• Embedded Linux build systems (Yocto, Buildroot) and cross-compilation for ARM targets.• Static analysis tools (clang-tidy, cppcheck) and performance profiling (perf, Valgrind).• SDR platforms (for example USRP) and FPGA-to-software PHY interfaces.• Understanding of satellite systems and orbital effects on the radio link.• Exposure to ECSS software standards (ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-ST-80C).• NB-IoT or NB-IoT NTN protocol experience.• Integration and verification, field testing or interoperability testing with commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals.• Python for test automation (for example pytest).Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.Benefits• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary - an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.• Regular company events and team activities.Études:  Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:  MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - I gaming - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en administrativ kundeservicemedarbejder?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Online banking - Vil du være med til at lede og udvikle et team, der skaber fremragende kundeoplevelser?
description:
Vil du være med til at lede og udvikle et team, der skaber fremragende kundeoplevelser i en international finansiel virksomhed, hvor performance, kvalitet og udvikling går hånd i hånd?

Trives du i en rolle, hvor du kombinerer ledelse, salg og collections med tæt samarbejde på tværs af afdelinger? Så kan denne stilling være det næste skridt i din karriere.

Virksomheden er et privat, internationalt kreditinstitut med hovedkontor i Malta, som opererer under og efterlever EU's bankregulatoriske rammeværk og er licenseret af den maltesiske finanstilsynsmyndighed (MFSA). Virksomheden tilbyder produkter inden for både kort/lagrede værdier og mikrolån på tværs af flere europæiske markeder. Hovedkontoret ligger et sted med over 300 solskinsdage om året, og her arbejder omkring 250 medarbejdere fordelt på 16 forskellige nationaliteter i afdelinger som finans, debitorstyring, drift, HR, salg, IT og betalinger.

Som Team Leader bliver du en del af et voksende lånemarked, hvor du får ansvaret for at lede det danske Sales & Collections-team på under 10 agenter. Du bliver en vigtig del af et multinationalt miljø, hvor du både kan udvikle dine ledelseskompetencer og opleve alt, hvad Malta har at byde på.

Hvad laver en Team Leader for Sales & Collections?I denne rolle bliver du ansvarlig for at lede, coache og udvikle dit team med fokus på performance, kvalitet og kundeoplevelse. Du driver salgsresultater, kunde-onboarding og dokumentverificering i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens politikker, og du ejer centrale KPI'er som konverteringsrater, misligholdelsesrater og collections-resultater.

Du overvåger daglige aktiviteter, mål og deadlines på tværs af både salg og collections, og du samarbejder tæt med andre afdelinger for at sikre transparente og effektive processer, samtidig med at du sikrer overholdelse af virksomhedens etiske retningslinjer og compliance-standarder.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingenSom Team Leader får du mulighed for at understøtte udviklingen af collections-strategier og sikre en fair og kundeorienteret tilgang i alt, hvad teamet foretager sig. Du bliver en del af en kultur, hvor der er fokus på vækst, samarbejde og at forbedre processer løbende – og hvor din erfaring som leder kan gøre en reel forskel.

Dit ansvar:

  • Lede, coache og udvikle det danske Sales & Collections-team med fokus på performance, kvalitet og kundeoplevelse

  • Drive salgsresultater, kunde-onboarding og dokumentverificering i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens politikker og procedurer

  • Eje centrale KPI'er for salg og collections, herunder konverteringsrater, misligholdelsesrater, kontaktkvalitet og collections-resultater

  • Understøtte udvikling og eksekvering af collections-strategier med fokus på fair og kundeorienteret behandling

  • Overvåge daglige aktiviteter, mål og deadlines på tværs af salg og collections, og handle når resultater skal forbedres

  • Samarbejde tæt med andre afdelinger for at sikre transparent og effektivt samarbejde

  • Sikre overholdelse af virksomhedens etiske retningslinjer, compliance-standarder og relaterede politikker

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Tidligere ledelseserfaring, gerne inden for salg, collections, kundeservice, finansielle services eller et performance-drevet miljø

  • Flydende engelsk; danskkundskaber er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Evne til at motivere, coache og lede et mindre team på tværs af salg og collections

  • Kommerciel tilgang med forståelse for KPI'er, mål og performanceopfølgning

  • Kundeorienteret tilgang med selvsikkerhed til at håndtere følsomme kundesituationer professionelt

  • Gode computerkundskaber, herunder Microsoft Office; erfaring med kundedatabaser er en fordel

  • Detaljeorienteret, initiativrig og med høje arbejdsstandarder

  • Lyst til at lære, forbedre processer og vokse sammen med det danske marked

Løn og benefits:

  • Årlig løn på 35-40.000 Euro / Brutto plus 10% i bonus

  • Tæt tværfagligt samarbejde uden faglige skel – der er mange muligheder både inden for og uden for din nuværende rolle

  • God kaffe og ugentlige fredagsøl

  • Stort fokus på vækst, udvikling og fejring af succeser

  • Et inkluderende, multikulturelt og mangfoldigt arbejdsmiljø med mange nationaliteter repræsenteret

  • Arbejde fra hovedkontoret i Malta, hvor omkring 250 medarbejdere fra 16 nationaliteter er samlet

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

At tage til Malta for at arbejde med kundesupport og kan være en fantastisk karrieremulighed med både professionelle og livsstilsmæssige fordele. Her er nogle af de vigtigste grunde til at overveje det:

Karrieremæssige fordele

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for finans-, tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder

  • Ledelseserfaring i et voksende marked – en vigtig del af den finansielle verden, hvor erfaring kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller inden for finans, compliance og kundeservice

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – du opbygger kompetencer inden for coaching, performanceledelse og problemløsning, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – der er fokus på intern udvikling, så du kan avancere i din rolle

Livet på Malta

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

description: TAKEN EN VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN- Geef boeiende fitnessinstructie en groepslessen die leden van alle niveaus motiveren- Zorg voor de dagelijkse gang van zaken in de fitnessfaciliteit en een soepele, efficiënte dienstverlening- Ondersteun en motiveer klanten, alleen of in groepen, bij het opbouwen van gezonde, actieve gewoontes- Werk flexibel op locaties in de regio en pas je elke week aan een nieuw rooster aanWAT JIJ MEEBRENGT- Oprechte passie voor fitness en het helpen van mensen bij het opbouwen van gezondere gewoontes- Zelfverzekerde, energieke communicator die zowel individuen als groepen kan motiveren- Flexibel en aanpasbaar, en op je gemak bij wisselende werktijden op meerdere locaties- Betrouwbaar en zelfstandig, en op je gemak bij het werken met minimaal toezichtTwee merken. Één team. ROVA Health is wat er gebeurt wanneer twee gevestigde namen in gezondheid en welzijn niet langer naast elkaar, maar samen verder gaan. Gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw erfgoed van Westfield Health Group en gedreven door de overtuiging dat de manier waarop mensen leven, werken en herstellen fundamenteel is veranderd - wij bestaan om daar iets aan te doen. Dit is een platform met een doel, gebouwd door mensen die het graag goed doen. Als je bij ons komt werken, begin je niet zomaar een nieuwe baan. description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career. Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

title: Samarbeidsområde Nord, bestående av menighetene i Ålesund, Trondheim og Tromsø, søker en administrasjonsleder i fast 100% stilling
description:
Samarbeidsområde Nord, bestående av menighetene i Ålesund, Trondheim og Tromsø, søker en administrasjonsleder i 100% fast stilling.

Administrasjonslederen vil bistå de tre menighetene med den daglige driften. Dette omfatter arkivering, innkjøp, rapportering, regnskapsføring og andre oppgaver man får delegert fra sokneprestene.

Arbeidssted vil være Døves menighet Trondheim, med kontorplass i Klostergata 60. Det forutsettes at du har anledning til å reise til de andre menighetene ved behov.

Alle menighetene har egne sokneprester og trosopplærere. Døves menighet Ålesund holder til i Voldsdalen kirke. Døves menighet Trondheim holder til i døvekirken i Trondheim, med kontorlokaler i Klostergata 60. Døves menighet Tromsø holder til i Kroken kirke i Tromsø.

Døvekirken er for tiden organisert med en samlet, enhetlig ledelse der sokneprestene har det daglige lederansvaret lokalt, mens administrative oppgaver er delegert til administrasjonsledere. Nasjonalt er Døvekirken organisert under Døves kirkeråd, og har prosten for Døvekirken som daglig leder. Døveprostiet er landsdekkende, og ligger under tilsyn av Oslo biskop. Forsøksprosjektet skal etter hvert avsluttes, og endringer som følge av dette kan påvirke stillingens innhold og omfang.

Døvekirken følger Den norske kirkes strategi med visjonen "Mer himmel på jord", og Døves kirkeråds konkretiseringer og tilpasninger av denne.

Tegnspråkkompetanse og tilknytting til døves kultur og identitet vektlegges. Døve oppfordres til å søke. Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Tilsettingen skjer på de vilkårene som til enhver tid gjelder, og den som tilsettes må rette seg etter endringer i lover, tariffavtaler og reglement samt avgjørelser som kan påvirke stillingens oppgaver og kontorsted.

Arbeidsoppgaver

· Økonomi og administrasjon

· Arkivering

· IKT

· Daglig drift og vedlikehold av kirke, bygg og kontor

· Legge til rette for gode administrative rutiner

· Følge opp delegerte oppgaver fra daglig leder

· Samarbeide med daglig leder, stab og menighetsråd

Kvalifikasjoner

· Relevant utdanning på høyskolenivå

· Erfaring med bruk av IT-, regnskap- og arkivsystemer

· Tidligere erfaring fra administrativt arbeid, fortrinnsvis i kirken

· Tegnspråkkompetanse og kjennskap til døves kultur og identitet

Personlige egenskaper

· Ønske om å skape mer himmel på jord for døve, døvblinde og tegnspråklige

· God rolleforståelse, med evne til å samarbeide med tre daglige ledere

· Gode regnskaps- og arkivrutiner

· Vilje til å holde seg oppdatert om gjeldende rutiner, vedtak og praksiser innad i Den norske kirke - for eksempel stå for etiske innkjøp

· Skal ta initiativ og arbeide selvstendig

· Skal være en administrativ ressurs i stabene

· God til å kommunisere

Vi tilbyr

· Lønn etter kvalifikasjon, ansiennitet og avtale i henhold til Hovedtariffavtalen for Den norske kirke

· Medlemskap i KLP

· Et godt stabsfellesskap, med samlinger, kurs og stor mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag

· Gode utviklingsmuligheter for den rette personen

· Muligheten til å reise og bli bedre kjent med Den norske kirke generelt og Døvekirken spesielt

· Kontorplass i tilknytning til Døves menighet i Trondheim

Tilsetning etter avtale.

Den som tilsettes må være medlem av Den norske kirke eller et kirkesamfunn Den norske kirke har avtale med. Søkerlisten kan bli offentliggjort, selv om søker ber om ikke å bli ført opp i offentlig søkerliste.

Oslo bispedømme skal være en arbeidsplass med rom og respekt for mangfold, uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønnsidentitet, funksjonsevne eller legning. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

Hjemmeside

https://www.dovekirken.no

Facebook

https://www.facebook.com/dovekirken

Den landsdekkende Døvekirken er en del av Oslo bispedømme. Vårt arbeidsspråk er norsk tegnspråk og vi står for Den norske kirkes tilbud til døve, døvblinde, tegnspråklige og deres familier. Vi har menigheter i Oslo, Sandefjord, Stavanger, Bergen, Ålesund, Trondheim og Tromsø, og et menighetsutvalg i Kristiansand.

title: Product-Minded Software Engineer (.NET/C#)
description:
About Photoncycle

Photoncycle is reimagining the energy landscape by delivering energy as a service. We build, install, own, and operate distributed energy storage systems, together with the digital infrastructure needed to scale as an aggregator and electricity provider across European markets.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems combine solar energy, long-duration storage, and energy trading, so households can use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy for households.

Our software platform is critical to that mission. It supports the digital services, fleet operations, and market capabilities required to operate Photoncycle systems safely, efficiently, and at scale.

We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures, and joined by Lifeline Ventures, Luminar Ventures, Momentum Partners, and Eviny Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

The Role

We are looking for a Product-Minded Software Engineer to help design and implement core backend software for Photoncycle’s next-generation energy platform. You’ll start by contributing to the team building our core energy platform software, and grow into adjacent product and business domains as the platform expands.

This role is primarily focused on backend development in C#/.NET. You’ll help build the software that represents, monitors, and interacts with deployed Photoncycle systems in the field, including telemetry, communication with units, operational health checks, and diagnostic data retrieval.

Much of this space is still unbuilt. You'll spend as much time prototyping, exploring, and testing ideas as shipping finished features. Enjoying the process of figuring out the right model before the answer is obvious is a core part of the job, not a detour from it.

As Photoncycle scales, you can also expect to contribute to broader platform capabilities such as fleet operations, customer and operator workflows, market-facing services, and integrations across the business.

This is a hands-on engineering role for a person, who is curious about the business, the users, and the operational reality behind the software. You don’t need to have it all figured out from day one; we value motivation, curiosity, holistic thinking, and the ability to connect what you're building to what the company and the customer actually need, not just the ticket in front of you. You will work closely with control system engineers, operations, product stakeholders, and other software developers to turn ambiguous real-world problems into reliable software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to backend services for our core energy platform using C#/.NET.

  • Build reliable telemetry, command, health-check, and diagnostic workflows for deployed Photoncycle units.

  • Help model equipment state, configuration, and lifecycle as a foundation for future platform capabilities.

  • Design clear domain models, APIs, and data flows that support operators, engineers, customers, and market-facing services.

  • Contribute to adjacent platform domains as the product matures, including fleet operations, customer-facing services, market capabilities, and business integrations.

  • Work with control system, operations, and product stakeholders to make pragmatic tradeoffs and validate features in real operational use.

What We’re Looking For

Must-have experience

  • Backend development experience with C# and .NET.

  • Experience designing and implementing production software with clear domain boundaries, robust data flows, and maintainable architecture.

  • Experience working with relational databases and event-driven or message-based systems, for example Postgres and RabbitMQ.

  • Ability to reason for reliability, observability, and failure modes in production.

  • Product mindset: curiosity about the “why”, interest in business and user outcomes, and willingness to challenge or refine requirements.

  • Comfortable working with stakeholders such as control system engineers, operations, and customer-facing teams.

  • Ability to turn unclear operational needs into concrete, incremental software deliveries and equally comfortable exploring open-ended problems where the right answer isn't known yet.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with industrial systems, IoT, energy systems, telemetry platforms, or equipment monitoring.

  • Experience with DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, modular monoliths, or event-driven integration.

  • Exposure to software that interacts with physical assets or field-deployed devices.

  • Experience with security-sensitive communication patterns, Zero-Trust networking, or authenticated device communication.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

We welcome applicants across experience levels, from motivated junior and mid-level engineers to more senior profiles. If you bring solid engineering fundamentals and genuine curiosity for this domain, we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every item above exactly.

What Success Looks Like for the Team You’ll Join

  • Photoncycle has a reliable software foundation for understanding and operating deployed equipment, and a platform that can expand into adjacent business domains.

  • Engineers and operators can see system state, investigate issues, and trigger safe actions with confidence.

  • Telemetry, events, commands, and diagnostic workflows are modeled clearly and can scale with the fleet.

  • The team makes better product and engineering decisions by bringing tradeoffs, data, and operational context into the discussion, and you’ll be part of making that happen.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to build foundational software for a high-impact climate technology company.

  • A central role in shaping the software that connects Photoncycle’s physical systems, customers, operations, and market activities to its digital platform.

  • A collaborative, mission-driven engineering culture with significant ownership.

  • A conveniently-located office in Forskningsparken, easily reachable by T-bane, with strong amenities and social activities.

  • A flexible work culture that encourages in-person collaboration, with one designated focus day per week for remote work.

Photoncycle is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store this energy next to house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems combine solar energy, long-duration storage, and energy trading, so households can use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy for households. We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

title: Head of Sales (Nordics)
description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Norwegian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity - Head of Sales, Nordics

You’ve led sales teams selling to kommuner and other public sector clients. You know how to multi-thread across multiple stakeholders, navigate decision and budget processes, and like being hands-on the most important of deals. Now you want a new challenge with a strong team to develop, and a solution customers actually need and want.

The Nordics are our home market - with some of our best market penetration, where customers rarely churn, yet with lots of market opportunity still to capture. We’re looking for someone who will lead from the front and help a small team across Norway, Sweden and Denmark drive our growth.

What your week looks like

  • Joining your Account Managers in their customer meetings and helping them close.

  • Deal reviews and pipeline check-ins with the team.

  • Working with Marketing, Product and Customer Success on what’s coming next.

  • Attending and speaking at industry events where our customers are.

What you’ll own

  • Your own portfolio of key municipal and education accounts, from first meeting to signed agreement.

  • The move from single-school sales to framework agreements with kommuner and education authorities.

  • The team’s results across three markets that each need their own plan.

  • Where we focus: which segments, territories and accounts are worth the push.

  • A pipeline and forecast in HubSpot that you’re happy to stand behind.

You are probably someone who

  • Has a track record leading B2B/B2G sales teams - ideally has sold to Norwegian kommuner or other public sector clients, and knows how budgets, politics and procurement work. Experience from other Nordic countries or the Baltics is a plus.

  • Until recently carried a quota, and/or has remained heavily involved in shaping and closing deals yourself.

  • Has led and coached account managers, and knows that different people need different support to improve and perform their best.

  • Understands the importance of sales methodologies, whether that’s MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger or similar.

  • Is data driven and uses CRM (HubSPot a plus) to understand trends and drive performance.

  • Speaks fluent Norwegian and English. Swedish or Danish is a bonus.

  • Is based in Oslo and happy with a hybrid setup.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report to our CCO, Sanjeev, who is based in London and previously led Vodafone business units across Africa and Europe. From our Oslo HQ you’ll work closely with our CEO, Morten, a former McKinsey Partner, and an experienced Leadership Team.

What’s in it for you

  • Real earning potential. We offer uncapped commission beyond OTE. The need is high and the solution proven - it now requires someone to drive systematic execution.

  • A solution that sells. It’s unique, backed by evidence of impact and significantly more cost-effective compared to alternatives. Our churn is very low - the solution works and customers love it.

  • Something to build on. You’re taking over a successful team that now needs taking up to the next level.

  • A place people like working. Our engagement scores are above benchmark, and we have structured onboarding with a buddy, an annual company trip and great collaboration across teams.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Flexible hours around a 10:00–15:00 core, with the option to work remotely.

  • Central office in Oslo.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel insurance for you and your immediate family.

  • Mobile phone and internet subscription.

Location

This role is based in our Oslo HQ office, with regular travel across Norway, Sweden and Denmark to support your team in the field.

We believe in-person leadership matters, so we work a flexible hybrid model built around real collaboration.

How to Apply

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you’d like, you can also include a short video (in English) as part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!

If you're looking for a leadership role where the demand is already proven and the job is to build on that - not create it from scratch - we'd love to hear from you.

🎥 You can watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You can explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies and consultants to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!
