title: Personal Trainers Wanted Across Norway
description:
We’re Hiring Personal Trainers at Multiple SATS Clubs Across Norway!

SATS is taking the personal training profession to the next level! We are proud to offer newly hired Personal Trainers greater security and closer support than ever before. We are now looking for passionate individuals who are driven to improve the health and well-being of people across Norway, backed by the best support system in the industry.

SATS operates fitness clubs in several of Norway’s largest cities, and we are currently recruiting Personal Trainers for multiple locations in Greater Oslo, Bærum, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand, Drammen, Porsgrunn, Sarpsborg, Skien, Stavanger, and Tromsø.

Please indicate in your application which location or region you would prefer to work in.

Are you passionate about inspiring others to live healthier lives and helping members achieve their goals? Would you like to work in a professional, energetic environment alongside knowledgeable and inspiring colleagues, while developing both personally and professionally? Then we would love to hear from you!

💙 How You Can Make a Difference

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will play an important role in the lives of our members. For many, working with a Personal Trainer is the key to achieving lasting results, whether that means improving their lifestyle, reaching specific fitness goals, or building sustainable training habits.

You will work closely with members from the very first meeting, conducting thorough needs assessments and using your expertise to create realistic, motivating, and individualized training and nutrition plans that help them achieve their goals.

You are a positive motivator, a proactive team player, and someone who contributes beyond your own responsibilities. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure that the club delivers an exceptional experience in every area while continuously developing and improving.

🤩 Does This Sound Like You?

  • You have at least one year of Personal Trainer education (equivalent to 60 ECTS credits or similar). PT certifications that do not award academic credits but are equivalent in scope to a one-year program are also accepted. (Please upload documentation of completed and/or ongoing studies as part of your application.)

  • Alternatively, you have other education relevant to the PT profession, such as a bachelor’s degree in sports science, physiotherapy, psychology, coaching, or a related field. (All candidates, regardless of educational background, must complete a thorough interview process, including a practical audition.)

  • You have strong work capacity and see yourself delivering approximately 80 to 100 hours per month as an established Personal Trainer.

  • You are passionate about creating unique training experiences based on concrete and individual goals.

  • You enjoy sales and take responsibility for developing and growing your own client portfolio.

  • You are confident and skilled at building and maintaining strong relationships.

  • You are positive, inclusive, and approachable.

  • You work independently and take initiative.

  • You are committed to following procedures and respecting rules and guidelines.

🤝 Why Join the SATS Team?

  • SATS offers an introductory salary during your start-up period.

  • Close mentoring and support from experienced leaders and PT Managers.

  • You will become part of a competent and professional team that supports and motivates one another to succeed.

  • Access to a large membership base, providing unique opportunities to build your client portfolio.

  • The chance to work with an exciting and continuously evolving product.

  • Excellent development opportunities through our internal education platform, SATS Academy.

  • Guaranteed minimum income protection following maternity/paternity leave and/or periods of illness.

  • Free training at all SATS clubs across the Nordic region.

  • Employee benefits and discounts through our partner network.

  • As a new PT at SATS, you will participate in our introductory program, PT Trial Session. Personal Trainers help members get started with exercise and establish healthy training habits. Working with PT Trial Sessions is the perfect gateway to becoming a full-time PT. It allows you to gain valuable experience in PT sales, build relationships with potential clients, and develop your business while receiving an introductory salary.

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will contribute to work that truly matters. You help people improve their quality of life, achieve important goals, and sometimes even realize long-held dreams. That is why we believe a career at SATS offers a more meaningful and rewarding workday than many others.

SATS Group, through our brands and concepts SATS, ELIXIA and Fresh Fitness, is the leading provider of fitness and training services in the Nordics with over 275 clubs, some 10 000 employees and around 700,000 members. At SATS, everyone is welcome and our members have full flexibility to tailor packages for their individual needs. We offer cutting-edge studio facilities for individual training, the broadest offering of group training programs, and highly qualified personal trainers for specialized training and individual coaching. title: Senior Logistics Engineer
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.

Lastly we are entering the space of becoming a logistics systems provider to serve other online grocery players meaning we are commercializing our hardware blueprint, our proprietary smart software and our ways of working into Oda systems - our new brand and business area!

We’re looking for a Senior Logistics Engineer to join Oda!

As our new Senior Logistics Engineer, you will take ownership of core physical process flows, optimize layout solutions, and lead physical installation projects from concept to commissioning. You will play a vital role in ensuring that our technical and physical solutions optimize unit economics, maximize throughput, and eliminate waste across our operations.

What you’ll be doing

  • Process Ownership & Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve physical process flows, layout solutions, process dependencies, and supporting systems to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Lead Installation Projects: Drive and manage physical installation projects for equipment, hardware, and infrastructure from initial concept through to commissioning.

  • Cost Control & Insights: Analyze cost drivers within the process flow and ensure all technical and physical solutions directly optimize unit economics and bottom-line results.

  • Lean Application: Apply Lean manufacturing principles to eliminate waste, enhance safety, and foster a continuous improvement culture.

  • Operational Collaboration: Work closely with on-site operational teams to ensure drawings and technical designs function seamlessly in daily operations and execute smooth handovers.

  • Flexibility: Step up and contribute to responsibilities beyond the core job description when the team or business needs it.

To thrive in this role,

You are analytical and strategic with a sharp eye for cost drivers and unit economics. You excel at switching abstraction levels effortlessly, combining a precise attention to detail with the strategic bird’s-eye view. As a highly structured project manager, you have the drive to push process improvements and complex physical implementations forward.

You are communicative and highly collaborative, capable of building strong bridges between on-site operations, software developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers. Above all, you are self-driven, confident in taking full ownership of entire processes, and act in alignment with our shared behaviors and values.

What you’ll need to succeed

Education: Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or an equivalent relevant field.

Operational Experience: 5–10 years of hands-on experience within Lean manufacturing, industrial production, or logistics environments.

Project Management: Proven track record of successfully leading complex, physical installation projects from concept to completion (delivered on time and within budget).

Technical Competence: A solid understanding of modern software development methodologies.

Business Acumen: Strong financial and operational understanding of cost drivers and how process design impacts the bottom line.

Language: Fluent in spoken and written English.

What would be nice to have

  • Experience scaling logistics or fulfillment center infrastructure in rapid-growth environments.

  • You value innovation and enjoy working in an AI-integrated environment where we constantly iterate on what’s possible.

What we offer

  • A chance to make a real impact in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by amazing chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach-we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.

Practical Information

  • Application deadline: 08.11.26

  • Percentage: 100%

  • Location: Tøyen, Oslo OR Larsboda, Sverige

  • Background check: required prior to hire

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Deltidsmedarbeider hos Hertz Stavanger – 30–50 %
description:
Hertz Bilutleie ved Auto Finans AS søker en serviceinnstilt deltids medarbeider til vår avdeling på Stavanger lufthavn.

Stillingsprosenten avtales med riktig kandidat. Vi ser for oss en stilling på omtrent 30--50 %. Arbeidstid vil omfatte kveld og helg, noe som kan passe godt ved siden av studier.

Stillingen passer for deg som liker kundekontakt og logistikk, har god oversikt og trives i en travel arbeidshverdag.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Besvare og følge opp kundehenvendelser i skranke, på e-post og telefon

  • Veilede kunder og presentere Hertz' produkter og tjenester

  • Planlegge og koordinere bilflåte ut fra reservasjonene

  • Kontrollere og følge opp leiekontrakter

  • Utføre rapportering og andre daglige kontoroppgaver

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B, innehatt i minst ett år

  • Gode norskkunnskaper og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du trives med kundekontakt og høyt tempo

  • Du er fleksibel og tar ansvar for oppgavene dine

Personlige egenskaper

  • Serviceinnstilt og imøtekommende

  • Strukturert og god til å holde oversikt

  • Positiv og løsningsorientert

  • Samarbeidsvillig

Tiltredelse etter avtale. Søknad og CV sendes til [roy@autofinans.no] (snarest mulig).

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med på laget bak gode reiseopplevelser

Når noen skal på ferie, på jobb eller trenger en bil for å komme seg videre, er Hertz der. Siden oppstarten i Chicago i 1918 har Hertz vokst til å bli verdens eldste bilutleieselskap, med over 10 000 lokasjoner i mer enn 150 land og over 33 millioner bilutleier hvert år.

Hertz åpnet sin første lokasjon i Norge i 1968. I dag er Hertz Norge markedsledende, med over 500 utleiepunkter over hele landet, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Nettverket omfatter rundt 170 corporate-utleiepunkter og cirka 250 lisenstakere.

Auto Finans AS representerer Hertz i Stavanger, Sola, Egersund, Haugesund, på Karmøy og Stord. Med mer enn 50 års erfaring innen bilutleie kjenner vi bransjen godt. Målet vårt er alltid å drive Norges beste Hertz-stasjoner. Med ekstra god kundeservice sørger vi for at både mennesker og biler kommer dit de skal.

Hos oss blir du en del av et lokalt lag med en sterk merkevare i ryggen -- og får en viktig rolle i kundenes reise.

description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Olemme rakentaneet uuden palvelumallin ja työkalun, jonka avulla et vain ohjaa asiakasta eteenpäin. **Viet rahoitushankkeen itse ensimmäisestä keskustelusta loppuun saakka.****Trusty Finance Broker** tuo asiakastyön, rahoitusanalyysin ja rahoittajille valmisteltavan aineiston samaan työympäristöön. Sinulle se tarkoittaa **vähemmän rutiinia ja enemmän aikaa asiakkaalle**. Voit hoitaa useampia rahoitushankkeita laadusta tinkimättä.**Trusty Finance Broker muuttaa rahoitusasiantuntijan arjen**Hyvä asiakaskeskustelu on vasta alku. Sen jälkeen yrityksen tilanne pitää jäsentää, rahoituksen perusteet arvioida ja aineisto valmistella. Trusty Finance Broker vie tämän työn kanssasi järjestelmällisesti maaliin.- **Asiakastyötila pitää kokonaisuuden käsissäsi.** Asiakkaat, rahoitushankkeet, sovitut asiat ja seuraavat askeleet ovat yhdessä näkymässä. Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. Se opastaa työympäristön peruskäytöstä aina vaativiin yritysrahoituksen tilanteisiin.Opiskelet omaan tahtiisi, harjoittelet käytännön tilanteita ja osoitat osaamisesi osaamiskokeilla. Etenemisestä saat osaamismerkkejä. **Harjoituksia voit uusia rajattomasti.****Mitä teet Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijana?**- hankit yritysasiakkaita ja avaat keskustelun yrittäjien kanssa heidän hankkeistaan - kartoitat rahoitustarpeen ja kokoat tilinpäätös- ja tapaamistiedot - tarkistat rahoitusanalyysin ja käyt Asiakasraportin läpi asiakkaan kanssa - valmistelet Rahoittajapaketin ja huolehdit sovituista jatkotoimista - pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla hankkeen loppuun saakka **Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti.** Ymmärrät asiakkaan tilanteen ja rakennat sille oikean rahoitusratkaisun. **Trusty Finance on yritykselle maksuton**, mikä madaltaa kynnystä aloittaa keskustelu.**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Voit tulla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnin, yritysasiakastyön, pankin, rahoituksen tai taloushallinnon parista. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. Voit toimia oman yrityksen kautta tai kevytyrittäjänä, tai voit perustaa yrityksen aloituksen yhteydessä. **Yhteistyö edellyttää Y-tunnusta.** Voit hakea myös, jos olet valmis hankkimaan sen ennen aloittamista.**Ansainta perustuu toteutuneisiin rahoituksiin**Ansaitset provisiota toteutuneista rahoituksista. Aktiivisella tekemisellä ansaintatavoite on **noin 2 000–10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**, ja kokeneilla tekijöillä **yli 10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**. **Palkkiokattoa ei ole.**Kyse on yrittäjän provisiotulosta, ei kiinteästä palkasta eikä taatusta ansiosta. Ansainta riippuu toteutuneista rahoituksista, ja käteen jäävään tuloon vaikuttavat omat yrityskulut ja verot.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- **Trusty Finance Broker** -työympäristön koko asiakastyöhön - **FSG Trusty Finance Akatemian**, jossa osaamisesi kasvaa vaihe vaiheelta - **laajan suomalaisten ja pohjoismaisten rahoittajien verkoston** - oman trustyfinance.fi-sähköpostiosoitteen - perehdytyksen ja tuen perustajatiimiltä - mahdollisuuden edetä vaativampiin asiakassuhteisiin ja suurempiin rahoitushankkeisiin FSG Financial Services Groupin perustajatiimillä on yhteensä **yli 95 vuotta kokemusta** rahoituksesta, varainhoidosta ja teknologiasta. Tämä kokemus on tukenasi alusta alkaen.**Mitä tarvitset aloittaaksesi?**- oman tietokoneen, puhelimen ja internetyhteyden - sujuvan suomen kielen taidon ja ammattimaisen otteen asiakasviestintään - Y-tunnuksen tai valmiuden hankkia se ennen yhteistyön alkua **Hae Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijaksi**Haluatko ottaa vastuun koko rahoitushankkeesta ja rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi uuden työympäristön tuella? Kerro hakemuksessa taustastasi ja vahvuuksistasi sekä siitä, miksi yritysasiakkaiden auttaminen kiinnostaa sinua.Tutustu rekrytointiprosessiin ja lähetä hakemuksesi.Suora linkki hakemukseen: https://www.financialservicesgroup.fi/rekry/haku**Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.**

title: Driftsleder Høyspent/Prosjektleder
description:
Hydro Energi har mer enn 100 års erfaring fra produksjon av fornybar energi. I dag er vi en av de tre største vannkraftprodusentene i Norge, og en betydelig kraftmarkedsaktør i Norden og Brasil. Vi er ansvarlig for å utvikle nye forretningsmuligheter og støtter Hydros forretningsområder innen kontrakter, forsyningssikkerhet og energipolitiske rammevilkår.

Hva vi tilbyr deg

 

Form fremtidens vannkraft som prosjektingeniør i Hydro Energi!

Hydro Energi er operatør for 40 vannkraftverk og en vindpark i Norge, med en total produksjon på 14 TWh. Kraftverkene ligger i områdene Røldal-Suldal, Sogn, Telemark, Stavanger og Tonstad.    

Hydro Energi Stavanger har ansvar for drift og vedlikehold av 15 vannkraftverk og to pumpestasjoner i Stavangerregionen. Vi identifiserer, utvikler og gjennomfører investeringsprosjekter i tett samarbeid med våre eiere (Lyse og Hydro Energi). Kraftverkene driftes kostnadseffektivt og har høy markedstilgjengelighet.  

Hos oss får du

  • Muligheten til å påvirke prosjekter som vil ha en direkte innvirkning på samfunnet og miljøet.  
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver som utfordrer din faglige ekspertise og kreativitet.  
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med høy kompetanse både lokalt og sentralt.   
  • Stort faglig miljø og muligheter i et solid norsk industrikonsern.  
  • Klar for å bli en nøkkelperson i Hydros tekniske fremtid? Vi vil vi høre fra deg!
Hva du skal gjøre

 

Som driftsleder høyspent har du det lovpålagte ansvaret for sikker drift, vedlikehold og etterlevelse av forskrifter i våre høyspentanlegg. Du har evnen til å omsette forskrifter og lovkrav til praktiske tiltak i tett samarbeid med våre fagfolk, ingeniører og mellomledere. Samarbeid med vedlikeholdspersonell for oppdatering av vedlikeholdsrutiner, er en viktig oppgave for å ivareta og for å løfte anleggspåliteligheten. Oppdatering av anleggsdata i Fosweb utføres ofte av driftsleder selv, eller av andre i forståelse med driftsleder. 

Driftsleder rapporterer direkte til kraftverkssjef og inngår i vår utvidede ledergruppe. 

I rollen prosjektleder vil du jobbe med modning og gjennomføring av prosjekter. Alt fra modifikasjoner, erstatninger og nybygg inngår i eksisterende prosjektportefølje. Oppdatering av tegninger og annen dokumentasjon inngår også som en viktig del av prosjektarbeidet, såvel som i rollen som driftsleder.  

  • Prosjekt- og detaljoppgraderinger: Planlegge, koordinere og gjennomføre oppgraderings- og vedlikeholdsprosjekter innen kontrollanlegg, automasjon, energitilførsel og høyspenningsanlegg. 
  • Feilsøking og teknisk forbedring: Bidra i utredning av avvik, programmering og oppfølging av PLS- og styringssystemer, samt kontinuerlig optimalisering av anleggene. 
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid: Delta i prosjekter og disiplinteam på tvers av fagområder som mekanisk, elektro, samband og driftssentral.
Hva som vil bidra til din suksess?

 

Vi ser etter deg som er  serviceinnstilt, praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert elektroingeniør som trives i spennet mellom feltarbeid og teknisk fordypning. Du bygger gode relasjoner og kommuniserer godt med både operatørene ute på kraftverkene og prosjektlederne på kontoret. 

Utover det ser vi for oss at du har følgende bakgrunn: 

  • Utdanning: Relevant master- eller bachelorgrad (ingeniør), eller toårig utdanning som fagskoleingeniør innen elkraft, pluss relevant fagbrev (energimontør eller elektriker).  
  • Det er et fortrinn om du har bestått elektroinstallatørprøven.  
  • Yrkeserfaring: Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring fra kraftproduksjon, elektroinstallasjon og/eller vedlikehold.  
  • Språkferdigheter: Sterke kommunikasjons- og presentasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig. 

Sjekker du ikke av alle boksene? Ikke la noen manglende punkter holde deg tilbake! Dersom du har den faglige bakgrunnen og motivasjonen til å lære, ønsker vi veldig gjerne å høre fra deg. 

Like muligheter

I vårt selskap mener vi at mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ønsker ulike erfaringer og perspektiver velkommen. Vi vurderer hver søknad rettferdig, og ønsker å gi like muligheter for alle til å vokse og lykkes i Hydro.

Søk før: 08.11.2026

Hvis du har spørsmål kan du kontakte:

LederTrond Thiis Head of Power Operations +4790132801 

RekruttererMarit Bratseth HR Spesialist+4795908036

Om arbeidsgiveren:

title: Sykepleier

Har du lyst til å bidra med dine sykepleierkunnskaper på Døli?

Korttids og rehabiliteringsavdelingen ved Døli pleie og omsorgssenter har 1 ledig fast stillinger i 100%. Stillingen er todelt turnus med arbeid hver 3. helg.  

Vi trenger deg- sykepleier med stort faglig engasjement, entusiasme, humor og som brenner for rehabilitering, eldreomsorg og gode pasientforløp. Vi kan tilby varierte arbeidsdager med givende og utfordrende oppgaver. Er du en fagperson med et helhetsperspektiv på beboeren og de tjenestene vi skal gi? 

Hvem er vi?Døli pleie- og omsorgssenter ligger idyllisk til rett ved Varingskollen alpinsenter i Nittedal kommune. Sykehjemmet ligger nedenfor Varingskollen togstasjon og bussen stopper 3 minutter unna sykehjemmet. Dersom du kjører bil fra Oslo, kjører du mot køen begge veier. Kjøretid fra Oslo er beregnet til ca. 30 minutter.Sykehjemmet har flotte, lyse lokaler og består av 77 rom fordelt på fire avdelinger, hvorav tre er langtidsavdelinger og en korttids-/rehabiliteringsavdeling. Raushet, redelighet og respekt er viktige prinsipper som vi bygger på. Vi er opptatt av at brukere opplever respekt og integritet. Brukers medbestemmelse og trygghet står sentralt i våre tjenester.Vi har god kompetanse på geriatri og demens og har fokus på fagutvikling innen området. Vi har en stor flott sansehage som innbyr til å være ute. Det er sansesti, flere sittegrupper og grillhytte i hagen. Vi er opptatt av å benytte musikk, erindring og måltider som miljøbehandling. Vår visjon er "omsorg møter livshistorie". Vi jobber personsentrert for å kjenne mennesket bak sykdommen.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Autorisert sykepleier 
  • Ønskelig med videreutdanning innen geriatri, AKS og rehabilitering.
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra institusjon eller kommunehelsetjenesten
  • Gode IKT-kunnskaper

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Interesse for fagutvikling og kvalitet i tjenesten

Personlige egenskaper

  • Bevisste og gode samarbeidsevner.
  • Være en god rollemodell.
  • Evnen til å planlegge, prioritere og koordinere.
  • Evnen til å arbeide selvstendig og i team.
  • Kompetanse til å avdekke og imøtekomme individuelle behov hos tjenestemottaker.
  • Etisk oppmerksom, fokusert og reflektert.
  • Fleksibel og løsningsorientert.
  • Kreativ, motivert og nysgjerrig.

Vi tilbyr

  • Et solid og aktivt fagmiljø med kvalitet og pasientsikkerhet i fokus.
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø og lagfølelse.

  • Mulighet for egen utvikling og kompetanseøkning.
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Tillitsbasert ledelse og mulighet for medvirkning.
  • Gode forsikring- og pensjonsordninger.

Vi kan tilby nedbetaling av studielån med 20 000 per år i en treårs periode mot bindingstid.

title: Serviceinnstilt hotellresepsjonist
description:
Er du den nye stjernen i resepsjonen vår? Elsker du mennesker og trives i en vertskapsrolle? Har du god digital kompetanse? Ja, da venter vi spent på akkurat deg!

Hva vi ser etter

Du elsker mennesker og trives i en vertskapsrolle.

Du har en positiv holdning som smitter over på både kolleger og gjester

Du er strukturert, selvgående og komfortabel med å håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig.

Du har god digital kompetanse. Evne til å lære bookingsystemer raskt, og jobbe effektivt med data.

Du kan snakke flytende både norsk (eller et skandinavisk språk) og engelsk.

Kjenner du deg igjen i punktene over, trenger du ikke å ha erfaring fra hotell. Du vil få den opplæringen som er nødvendig for å føle deg trygg i jobbsituasjonen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Reservasjon og booking:

  • Besvare telefoner og e-poster, og sikre rask og korrekt kommunikasjon.

  • Håndtere bookingsystemer.

  • Oppdatere bookingsystemet med ledig kapasitet og priser.

  • Svare på tilbudsforespørsler.

  • Følge opp gruppereservasjoner og konferansegjester.

Betjening av resepsjonen og gjestehåndtering:

  • Ønske gjester velkommen med en varm og profesjonell holdning.

  • Sørge for smidig innsjekk og utsjekk av hotellgjester.

  • Tilby informasjon om hotellet, nærområdet og lokale aktiviteter.

  • Svare på gjestenes spørsmål og løse eventuelle klager på en profesjonell måte.

  • Tilby anbefalinger for å sikre en minneverdig opplevelse for gjestene.

Arrangementsstøtte:

  • Assistere konferansegjester og sikre at teknisk utstyr fungerer som planlagt.

  • Tilrettelegge for møter og andre arrangementer på hotellet.

Sikkerhet og orden:

  • Overholde sikkerhetsrutiner og håndtere nøkkeladministrasjon.

  • Holde resepsjonsområdet ryddig og representativt.

Salg og mersalg:

  • Promotere hotellets tjenester, som restaurant, aktiviteter og eventer.

  • Aktivt tilby oppgraderinger eller tilleggsprodukter som kan forbedre gjestens opphold.

Administrasjon:

  • Oppdatere daglogg/skiftlogg og følge opp administrative oppgaver.

  • Kommunisere med ledelse og andre avdelinger for en sømløs drift.

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt hos Ørland Kysthotell kan vi tilby en spennende og variert jobb. Møte gjester fra hele verden, og være en del av et team med flinke og hyggelige kolleger. Hos oss får du utvikle deg i et trygt og godt miljø i en bedrift som er opptatt av personlig og profesjonell vekst og som setter menneskene i fokus.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ørland Kysthotell har en unik beliggenhet helt nede i sjøkanten, og har en visjon om å være det mest attraktive konferansehotellet i Midt-Norge. Vi har en fantastisk nærhet til naturen, nye konferansefasiliteter, nytt kjøkken, 91 rom for større arrangementer, og spennende aktiviteter for teambuilding.

Stillingens tiltredelse er mai, men opplæring og tilkalling kan gjelde omgående.

Søknader blir også behandlet fortløpende.

title: Montør for innovativt teknologiselskap
description:
Vil du jobbe som montør for innovativt teknologiselskap?

Liberty Now AS har på kort tid blitt den ledende aktøren i Norge på utvikling av høyteknologiske dagligvarebutikker, og jobber tett sammen med bransjen på utviklingen av fremtidens dagligvarehandel.

Vi har økende pågang etter våre tjenester, og trenger flere dyktige og teknologi-hungrige personer inn i vårt arbeidsmiljø. Liberty Now AS holder til i Seljord kommune i Telemark, med avdelinger i Midt-Telemark og Sandefjord kommune.

Vi søker montører!

Liberty Now AS søker montører til hel- og deltidstilling som skal jobbe med produksjon av utstyr til høyteknologiske butikker.

Du vil bli en del av produksjonsteamet i avdelingen Midt-Telemark som har bred kompetanse på mange spennende områder.

Hvem søker vi?

Vi søker deg som vil være med å forme fremtiden i butikk-Norge.

Du er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert, tar ansvar, ønsker jobb i et fremtidsrettet og innovativt selskap, samt å levere gode resultater og løsninger. I en variert og hektisk hverdag er det viktig å kunne jobbe strukturert og være fleksibel på arbeidsoppgaver. Du er motivert, har gode samarbeidsevner og kommuniserer godt både på norsk og engelsk. Vi ser etter deg med relevant utdanning eller kompetanse innen håndverksfag som elektro, automasjon, montørfaget, industrimontør eller tavlemontør. Kandidater med annen relevant erfaring oppfordres også å søke.

KUNNSKAP

Fordel med kjennskap til, eller interesse,

for følgende områder

  • Elektro/Automasjon

  • Montering

  • IT og IT-systemer

  • IOT

  • Innovative løsninger

ARBEIDSOPPGAVER

Fordel med kjennskap til, eller interesse, for følgende områder

  • Montering av utstyr til høyteknologiske butikker

  • Oppsett og vedlikehold av IT-systemer

  • Utvikling og testing av nye og eksisterende løsninger

  • Teknisk support

  • Lagerstyring

  • Andre forefallende oppgaver

HVA VI TILBYR?

  • En spennende arbeidsplass i et selskap i sterk vekst

  • Opsjonsavtale

  • Interessante prosjekter og arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kompetent arbeidsmiljø, muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

  • Kantineordning

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Liberty Now AS (tidligere Mat-Norge) er et norsk teknologiselskap som ble stiftet i 2018. Selskapet er markedsleder på robotisering og digitalisering av friksjonsfrie kundereiser og handel. Teknologien heter Retail Multi Automation, og er også kjent under navnet RMA-Butikkstyring.

Teknologien står sentralt i arbeidet med å revitalisere dagligvarebransjen i første omgang. I tillegg til at den har blitt tatt i bruk i butikker over hele Norge, har teknologien også gjort sitt inntog i reiselivs- og avfallsbransjen.

Liberty Now har en sterk vekst med gode resultater. All utvikling av teknologien skjer i Norge, men vi har også ansatte i Storbritannia og Spania. Vi jobber kontinuerlig med å finne nye, innovative løsninger, og følger nøye med på den teknologiske utviklingen og de regulatoriske endringene i og utenfor Norge.

title: Open application
description:
Don't see a role that fits? We still want to hear from you.

Photoncycle is building the digital and physical infrastructure for Europe's next-generation energy services. We're a small team moving fast, and the right people matter more to us than having the perfect job title ready.

If you're excited about what we're doing — whether you come from software, energy, operations, hardware, or somewhere in between — send us a note. Tell us what you do well and what kind of problem you'd love to work on.

We're based in Oslo at Forskningsparken and backed by leading Nordic investors.

What to include: A short message about yourself and what draws you to Photoncycle, plus a CV or LinkedIn profile.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store this energy next to house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems combine solar energy, long-duration storage, and energy trading, so households can use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy for households. We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

title: Graduate Process Engineer
description:
Shape the future of industrial operations with Falkor

At Falkor, we’re building technology that helps industrial companies understand, optimise and operate complex assets more intelligently.

We combine deep industrial domain expertise with advanced simulation, software and AI to solve some of the toughest challenges in energy and industrial operations. We’re now looking for a Graduate Process Engineer to join our Energy Simulation team in Fornebu or Horten.

This is an opportunity to begin your career at the intersection of process engineering, industrial operations and technology, learning from experienced engineers while developing specialist expertise in dynamic process simulation.

The role

You’ll work with our dynamic process and flow simulators, K-Spice® and LedaFlow®, helping customers model, understand and optimise complex industrial processes.

Our technology is used across the energy industry for engineering studies, design verification, virtual commissioning, operator training, real-time production monitoring and flow assurance. It also supports Falkor’s Digital Twin solutions and applications including CO₂ capture, transportation and storage.

You’ll receive support as you learn to build and run simulation models, understand customer processes and contribute to simulator deliveries.

What you’ll do

  • Build, configure and run dynamic process simulation models.

  • Support the integration of dynamic models with control systems.

  • Help prepare simulators for engineering testing, virtual commissioning and operator training.

  • Work with experienced colleagues to understand customer processes and technical challenges.

  • Apply your engineering knowledge to practical industrial problems.

  • Test and document simulation models and technical solutions.

  • Collaborate with process engineers, software specialists and other technical disciplines.

  • Contribute ideas that improve our tools, products and ways of working.

  • Build your technical knowledge and gradually take on greater responsibility.

What we’re looking for

  • A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed BSc or MSc in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation or another relevant technical discipline.

  • A structured and analytical approach to solving technical problems.

  • Curiosity and a genuine appetite to learn.

  • An interest in process simulation, industrial software or energy operations.

  • A collaborative and solution-oriented approach.

  • The ability to communicate and work effectively across technical disciplines.

  • Fluency in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.

  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites when required.

Interest or academic experience in Python programming, digitalisation, industrial AI, energy-transition technologies or CO₂ capture, transportation and storage would be an advantage.

We know that graduates will not arrive with experience in every area. We’re looking for strong engineering foundations, learning agility and the potential to develop into a specialist within our team.

Why Falkor?

Industrial companies generate enormous amounts of data, but turning that data into better decisions remains a complex challenge.

At Falkor, you’ll work on technology designed for the realities of industrial operations. You’ll learn how sophisticated simulation and software can help customers understand complex systems, test decisions before putting them into practice, train operators safely and operate assets more effectively.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, software specialists and industry experts, giving you the opportunity to build deep technical expertise and develop your career in industrial technology.

Application process

Send us your CV and tell us why you’re interested in beginning your career with Falkor.

We’re interested in your potential, so you should still apply if you don’t meet every requirement. Please upload your diploma, academic transcript and/or other relevant documentation under Additional files. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Different perspectives make better technology

The problems we’re solving are complex, and we believe solving them requires different perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are valued, respected and able to contribute at their best. We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds and experiences.

Recruitment agencies

Falkor occasionally partners with recruitment agencies for specific roles. We work with a limited number of preferred suppliers under agreed terms and processes. We therefore cannot accept responsibility for unsolicited candidate submissions or associated fees unless terms have been agreed with our Procurement team in advance.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

title: Data Analyst - Digitalisation & Automation
description:
About us

At Flowcase, we’re revolutionizing the way companies win business. Our mission? To help clients save time, win more bids, and achieve better results.

As a leading SaaS solution for public tenders, bids, and proposals, Flowcase is trusted by top consulting, engineering, IT, and legal firms in over 35 countries. Our platform streamlines the creation and management of CVs, resumes, and case studies, cutting bid preparation time in half—so teams can focus on what they do best.

With a fast-growing, globally distributed team of 30+ talented and friendly professionals, we’re headquartered in Oslo and have offices in London, Copenhagen, Helsinki, and Toronto. Join us as we continue to expand and make an impact on the future of bidding and proposal management.

Role purpose

Drive and support the company’s ongoing journey within data, digitalisation, automation and business intelligence.

The role combines data analysis, business process improvement, HubSpot development, automation and systems integration. Working closely with Management and teams across the organisation, the role helps turn business needs and data into better processes, improved efficiency and stronger decision-making.

As the main resource in this area, the role offers significant autonomy to identify opportunities, develop initiatives and shape its own agenda, while working in close alignment with Management and the company’s strategic priorities.

Key responsibilities

Data & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and improve dashboards, reporting and BI solutions to support Management and business decision-making.

  • Analyse business data and translate findings into clear, actionable insights.

  • Establish reliable reporting and data structures across key business areas.

  • Identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement through data.

  • Support Management with ad-hoc analysis and data-driven decision support.

HubSpot & Business Processes

  • Develop and continuously improve HubSpot as a key business platform.

  • Design and optimise workflows, processes, automations and reporting within HubSpot.

  • Improve data quality, structures and processes across the CRM.

  • Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective HubSpot solutions.

  • Identify opportunities to further digitalise and streamline processes across sales, marketing, customer and other business functions.

Automation & Digitalisation

  • Identify manual, repetitive or inefficient processes that could benefit from automation.

  • Design and implement automated workflows and solutions across the business.

  • Continuously evaluate opportunities to simplify processes and improve efficiency through technology.

  • Support the organisation in adopting new digital tools and ways of working.

Systems & Integrations

  • Develop and maintain integrations between HubSpot and internal and external software systems.

  • Work with APIs, integration platforms and data flows to connect systems and reduce manual data handling.

  • Help ensure data is consistent, accessible and reliable across different platforms.

  • Collaborate with external software providers and internal stakeholders on system improvements and integrations.

Collaboration & Business Support

  • Work closely with Management to understand priorities, challenges and opportunities where data and technology can create value.

  • Collaborate with teams across the company to map processes, understand requirements and implement improvements.

  • Proactively identify opportunities rather than working solely from predefined requirements.

  • Communicate insights and technical solutions in a clear and business-oriented way.

Role characteristics

This is a broad and hands-on role sitting at the intersection of Data, Technology, Operations and Business.

While working closely with Management and other teams, the role has the freedom to identify areas for improvement, propose initiatives and shape its own roadmap. The focus is not only on producing analysis, but on turning insights into practical improvements through better processes, automation, systems and data.

The role therefore combines analysis, problem-solving, implementation and collaboration, with the opportunity to have a visible impact on how the company operates and makes decisions.

If you like one of our open job posts, we encourage you to apply. We are less concerned with a person meeting 100% of the job requirements, and are more interested in working with friendly and genuine, people. Flowcase is made up of caring, empathetic people who lift each other up, and we do not discriminate against any protected group. We are committed to equal opportunities, inclusive working, and fairness for all.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the interview process or beyond, please inform us, and we will work with you to ensure the necessary support is in place.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Flowcase (formerly CV Partner), is a SaaS tool that helps automate the process of filtering, tailoring, and formatting CVs, resumes, and case studies, enabling professional services firms to build bid proposals more efficiently. Present in over 35 countries and boasting hundreds of thousands of users, Flowcase has become an integral solution to the tedious and time-consuming data collection process for bid applications. Flowcase’s clients include professional services firms PwC and BDO, global law firm DLA Piper, and leading tech consultancy Capgemini.

title: Product-Minded Software Engineer (.NET/C#)
description:
About Photoncycle

Photoncycle is reimagining the energy landscape by delivering energy as a service. We build, install, own, and operate distributed energy storage systems, together with the digital infrastructure needed to scale as an aggregator and electricity provider across European markets.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems combine solar energy, long-duration storage, and energy trading, so households can use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy for households.

Our software platform is critical to that mission. It supports the digital services, fleet operations, and market capabilities required to operate Photoncycle systems safely, efficiently, and at scale.

We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures, and joined by Lifeline Ventures, Luminar Ventures, Momentum Partners, and Eviny Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

The Role

We are looking for a Product-Minded Software Engineer to help design and implement core backend software for Photoncycle’s next-generation energy platform. You’ll start by contributing to the team building our core energy platform software, and grow into adjacent product and business domains as the platform expands.

This role is primarily focused on backend development in C#/.NET. You’ll help build the software that represents, monitors, and interacts with deployed Photoncycle systems in the field, including telemetry, communication with units, operational health checks, and diagnostic data retrieval.

Much of this space is still unbuilt. You'll spend as much time prototyping, exploring, and testing ideas as shipping finished features. Enjoying the process of figuring out the right model before the answer is obvious is a core part of the job, not a detour from it.

As Photoncycle scales, you can also expect to contribute to broader platform capabilities such as fleet operations, customer and operator workflows, market-facing services, and integrations across the business.

This is a hands-on engineering role for a person, who is curious about the business, the users, and the operational reality behind the software. You don’t need to have it all figured out from day one; we value motivation, curiosity, holistic thinking, and the ability to connect what you're building to what the company and the customer actually need, not just the ticket in front of you. You will work closely with control system engineers, operations, product stakeholders, and other software developers to turn ambiguous real-world problems into reliable software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to backend services for our core energy platform using C#/.NET.

  • Build reliable telemetry, command, health-check, and diagnostic workflows for deployed Photoncycle units.

  • Help model equipment state, configuration, and lifecycle as a foundation for future platform capabilities.

  • Design clear domain models, APIs, and data flows that support operators, engineers, customers, and market-facing services.

  • Contribute to adjacent platform domains as the product matures, including fleet operations, customer-facing services, market capabilities, and business integrations.

  • Work with control system, operations, and product stakeholders to make pragmatic tradeoffs and validate features in real operational use.

What We’re Looking For

Must-have experience

  • Backend development experience with C# and .NET.

  • Experience designing and implementing production software with clear domain boundaries, robust data flows, and maintainable architecture.

  • Experience working with relational databases and event-driven or message-based systems, for example Postgres and RabbitMQ.

  • Ability to reason for reliability, observability, and failure modes in production.

  • Product mindset: curiosity about the “why”, interest in business and user outcomes, and willingness to challenge or refine requirements.

  • Comfortable working with stakeholders such as control system engineers, operations, and customer-facing teams.

  • Ability to turn unclear operational needs into concrete, incremental software deliveries and equally comfortable exploring open-ended problems where the right answer isn't known yet.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with industrial systems, IoT, energy systems, telemetry platforms, or equipment monitoring.

  • Experience with DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, modular monoliths, or event-driven integration.

  • Exposure to software that interacts with physical assets or field-deployed devices.

  • Experience with security-sensitive communication patterns, Zero-Trust networking, or authenticated device communication.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

We welcome applicants across experience levels, from motivated junior and mid-level engineers to more senior profiles. If you bring solid engineering fundamentals and genuine curiosity for this domain, we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every item above exactly.

What Success Looks Like for the Team You’ll Join

  • Photoncycle has a reliable software foundation for understanding and operating deployed equipment, and a platform that can expand into adjacent business domains.

  • Engineers and operators can see system state, investigate issues, and trigger safe actions with confidence.

  • Telemetry, events, commands, and diagnostic workflows are modeled clearly and can scale with the fleet.

  • The team makes better product and engineering decisions by bringing tradeoffs, data, and operational context into the discussion, and you’ll be part of making that happen.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to build foundational software for a high-impact climate technology company.

  • A central role in shaping the software that connects Photoncycle’s physical systems, customers, operations, and market activities to its digital platform.

  • A collaborative, mission-driven engineering culture with significant ownership.

  • A conveniently-located office in Forskningsparken, easily reachable by T-bane, with strong amenities and social activities.

  • A flexible work culture that encourages in-person collaboration, with one designated focus day per week for remote work.

Photoncycle is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store this energy next to house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems combine solar energy, long-duration storage, and energy trading, so households can use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy for households. We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

title: Head of Sales (Nordics)
description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Norwegian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity - Head of Sales, Nordics

You’ve led sales teams selling to kommuner and other public sector clients. You know how to multi-thread across multiple stakeholders, navigate decision and budget processes, and like being hands-on the most important of deals. Now you want a new challenge with a strong team to develop, and a solution customers actually need and want.

The Nordics are our home market - with some of our best market penetration, where customers rarely churn, yet with lots of market opportunity still to capture. We’re looking for someone who will lead from the front and help a small team across Norway, Sweden and Denmark drive our growth.

What your week looks like

  • Joining your Account Managers in their customer meetings and helping them close.

  • Deal reviews and pipeline check-ins with the team.

  • Working with Marketing, Product and Customer Success on what’s coming next.

  • Attending and speaking at industry events where our customers are.

What you’ll own

  • Your own portfolio of key municipal and education accounts, from first meeting to signed agreement.

  • The move from single-school sales to framework agreements with kommuner and education authorities.

  • The team’s results across three markets that each need their own plan.

  • Where we focus: which segments, territories and accounts are worth the push.

  • A pipeline and forecast in HubSpot that you’re happy to stand behind.

You are probably someone who

  • Has a track record leading B2B/B2G sales teams - ideally has sold to Norwegian kommuner or other public sector clients, and knows how budgets, politics and procurement work. Experience from other Nordic countries or the Baltics is a plus.

  • Until recently carried a quota, and/or has remained heavily involved in shaping and closing deals yourself.

  • Has led and coached account managers, and knows that different people need different support to improve and perform their best.

  • Understands the importance of sales methodologies, whether that’s MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger or similar.

  • Is data driven and uses CRM (HubSPot a plus) to understand trends and drive performance.

  • Speaks fluent Norwegian and English. Swedish or Danish is a bonus.

  • Is based in Oslo and happy with a hybrid setup.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report to our CCO, Sanjeev, who is based in London and previously led Vodafone business units across Africa and Europe. From our Oslo HQ you’ll work closely with our CEO, Morten, a former McKinsey Partner, and an experienced Leadership Team.

What’s in it for you

  • Real earning potential. We offer uncapped commission beyond OTE. The need is high and the solution proven - it now requires someone to drive systematic execution.

  • A solution that sells. It’s unique, backed by evidence of impact and significantly more cost-effective compared to alternatives. Our churn is very low - the solution works and customers love it.

  • Something to build on. You’re taking over a successful team that now needs taking up to the next level.

  • A place people like working. Our engagement scores are above benchmark, and we have structured onboarding with a buddy, an annual company trip and great collaboration across teams.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Flexible hours around a 10:00–15:00 core, with the option to work remotely.

  • Central office in Oslo.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel insurance for you and your immediate family.

  • Mobile phone and internet subscription.

Location

This role is based in our Oslo HQ office, with regular travel across Norway, Sweden and Denmark to support your team in the field.

We believe in-person leadership matters, so we work a flexible hybrid model built around real collaboration.

How to Apply

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you’d like, you can also include a short video (in English) as part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!

If you're looking for a leadership role where the demand is already proven and the job is to build on that - not create it from scratch - we'd love to hear from you.

🎥 You can watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You can explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies and consultants to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Graduate Process Engineer
description:
Shape the future of industrial operations with Falkor

At Falkor, we’re building technology that helps industrial companies understand, optimise and operate complex assets more intelligently.

We combine deep industrial domain expertise with advanced simulation, software and AI to solve some of the toughest challenges in energy and industrial operations. We’re now looking for a Graduate Process Engineer to join our Energy Simulation team in Fornebu or Horten.

This is an opportunity to begin your career at the intersection of process engineering, industrial operations and technology, learning from experienced engineers while developing specialist expertise in dynamic process simulation.

The role

You’ll work with our dynamic process and flow simulators, K-Spice® and LedaFlow®, helping customers model, understand and optimise complex industrial processes.

Our technology is used across the energy industry for engineering studies, design verification, virtual commissioning, operator training, real-time production monitoring and flow assurance. It also supports Falkor’s Digital Twin solutions and applications including CO₂ capture, transportation and storage.

You’ll receive support as you learn to build and run simulation models, understand customer processes and contribute to simulator deliveries.

What you’ll do

  • Build, configure and run dynamic process simulation models.

  • Support the integration of dynamic models with control systems.

  • Help prepare simulators for engineering testing, virtual commissioning and operator training.

  • Work with experienced colleagues to understand customer processes and technical challenges.

  • Apply your engineering knowledge to practical industrial problems.

  • Test and document simulation models and technical solutions.

  • Collaborate with process engineers, software specialists and other technical disciplines.

  • Contribute ideas that improve our tools, products and ways of working.

  • Build your technical knowledge and gradually take on greater responsibility.

What we’re looking for

  • A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed BSc or MSc in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation or another relevant technical discipline.

  • A structured and analytical approach to solving technical problems.

  • Curiosity and a genuine appetite to learn.

  • An interest in process simulation, industrial software or energy operations.

  • A collaborative and solution-oriented approach.

  • The ability to communicate and work effectively across technical disciplines.

  • Fluency in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.

  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites when required.

Interest or academic experience in Python programming, digitalisation, industrial AI, energy-transition technologies or CO₂ capture, transportation and storage would be an advantage.

We know that graduates will not arrive with experience in every area. We’re looking for strong engineering foundations, learning agility and the potential to develop into a specialist within our team.

Why Falkor?

Industrial companies generate enormous amounts of data, but turning that data into better decisions remains a complex challenge.

At Falkor, you’ll work on technology designed for the realities of industrial operations. You’ll learn how sophisticated simulation and software can help customers understand complex systems, test decisions before putting them into practice, train operators safely and operate assets more effectively.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, software specialists and industry experts, giving you the opportunity to build deep technical expertise and develop your career in industrial technology.

Application process

Send us your CV and tell us why you’re interested in beginning your career with Falkor.

We’re interested in your potential, so you should still apply if you don’t meet every requirement. Please upload your diploma, academic transcript and/or other relevant documentation under Additional files. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Different perspectives make better technology

The problems we’re solving are complex, and we believe solving them requires different perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are valued, respected and able to contribute at their best. We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds and experiences.

Recruitment agencies

Falkor occasionally partners with recruitment agencies for specific roles. We work with a limited number of preferred suppliers under agreed terms and processes. We therefore cannot accept responsibility for unsolicited candidate submissions or associated fees unless terms have been agreed with our Procurement team in advance.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

title: Process Engineer
description:
Shape the future of industrial operations with Falkor

At Falkor, we’re building technology that helps industrial companies understand, optimise and operate complex assets more intelligently.

We combine deep industrial domain expertise with advanced simulation, software and AI to solve some of the toughest challenges in energy and industrial operations. We’re now looking for an experienced Process Engineer to join our Energy Simulation team in Fornebu or Horten.

This role offers the opportunity to apply your process or operational experience to complex simulation projects, work directly with customers and take technical responsibility for simulator deliveries.

The role

You’ll work with our dynamic process and flow simulators, K-Spice® and LedaFlow®, helping customers model, understand and optimise complex industrial processes.

Our technology is used across the energy industry for engineering studies, design verification, virtual commissioning, operator training, real-time production monitoring and flow assurance. It also supports Falkor’s Digital Twin solutions and applications including CO₂ capture, transportation and storage.

You’ll join a global team building full-scale dynamic process simulators, operating at the intersection of process engineering, industrial operations and technology. You’ll use your experience to develop effective technical solutions and take ownership of complete or significant elements of simulator deliveries.

What you’ll do

  • Build, configure, validate and run dynamic process simulation models.

  • Integrate dynamic models with industrial control systems.

  • Prepare and deliver simulators for engineering testing, design verification, virtual commissioning and operator training.

  • Work directly with customers and other stakeholders to understand their operations and technical challenges.

  • Translate process and operational requirements into effective simulation solutions.

  • Provide technical advice based on your understanding of industrial processing facilities.

  • Take technical ownership of complete simulator deliveries or major work packages.

  • Coordinate technical activities across process, control and software disciplines.

  • Support technical reviews, testing, troubleshooting and customer acceptance activities.

  • Improve simulator-building processes, tools and engineering practices.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of our simulation technology and software products.

  • Share knowledge and support the development of less-experienced engineers.

What we’re looking for

  • A BSc or MSc in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Professional experience in process engineering, process operations, industrial automation, dynamic simulation or a related environment.

  • A strong understanding of industrial processes and processing facilities.

  • The ability to structure and solve complex technical problems.

  • Experience working with customers or other technical stakeholders.

  • The confidence to take ownership of technical deliverables.

  • A collaborative, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

  • The ability to work effectively across engineering and software disciplines.

  • Fluency in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.

  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites when required.

Previous experience as a process operator would be highly advantageous. First-hand knowledge of how industrial processing facilities operate can provide valuable practical insight when developing simulations, advising customers and addressing real-world operational challenges.

Experience with dynamic process simulation, industrial control systems, energy operations or similar industrial environments would also be valuable. Interest or experience in Python programming, digitalisation, industrial AI, energy-transition technologies or CO₂ capture, transportation and storage is an advantage.

Why Falkor?

Industrial companies generate enormous amounts of data, but turning that data into better decisions remains a complex challenge.

At Falkor, you’ll apply your engineering and operational knowledge to technology designed for the realities of industrial operations. You’ll help customers understand complex systems, test decisions before putting them into practice, train operators safely and operate assets more effectively.

You’ll work alongside engineers, software specialists and industry experts in an environment where deep domain expertise meets advanced technology. As the team grows, you’ll have the opportunity to take greater technical ownership and help shape how we approach increasingly complex customer challenges.

Application process

Send us your CV and tell us why you’re interested in joining Falkor. Please also upload your diploma and/or other relevant documentation under Additional files.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Different perspectives make better technology

The problems we’re solving are complex, and we believe solving them requires different perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are valued, respected and able to contribute at their best. We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds and experiences.

Recruitment agencies

Falkor occasionally partners with recruitment agencies for specific roles. We work with a limited number of preferred suppliers under agreed terms and processes. We therefore cannot accept responsibility for unsolicited candidate submissions or associated fees unless terms have been agreed with our Procurement team in advance.

Main changes: the graduate version now emphasises foundations, learning, supported development and progressively increasing responsibility. The experienced version places greater weight on customer advisory work, operational insight, technical ownership, cross-disciplinary coordination and complete simulator deliveries.
