You are included, just as you are, from day one. With the right mindset, there’s no limit to how far we can go together.

title: AI Knowledge Architect
description: Shape the future of enterprise knowledge with Multiply. Design semantic information architectures, develop ontologies and knowledge graphs, and build AI-ready data foundations while contributing to VisFlow Runa, our Knowledge Platform.About MultiplyMultiply Teknik & IT AB is a Sweden based End-to-End solution Provider specializing in Enterprise Architecture, Data & Information Management, AI, Software Engineering, and Digital Transformation.We combine specialist knowledge solutions with the development and deployment of our own technology solutions, giving our colleagues the opportunity to work on challenging enterprise initiatives while contributing to innovative products.We are now looking for experienced Information & Knowledge Architects to join our growing team in Stockholm.About VisFlow & RunaVisFlow (visflow.io) is our technology ecosystem focused on connecting enterprise information, processes, knowledge, and operational intelligence.An important part of VisFlow is Runa, our Knowledge Platform, which focuses on ontology management, knowledge graphs, semantic modelling, metadata, and enterprise information architecture.Our vision is to be the preferred partner for Flow thinking and End-to-End Operations aspects of any business, semantically enriched knowledge foundations that bring together business concepts, information structures, relationships, and context to support data governance, interoperability, and AI-driven applications.As part of Multiply, you will have opportunities to contribute to the evolution of Runa and explore how its capabilities can address real enterprise challenges.The RoleYou will work at the intersection of Information Architecture, Data Management, Semantic Technologies, and AI, supporting organizations in developing trusted, connected, and AI-ready information foundations.Your work will include customer-facing enterprise transformation and architecture assignments, using the technologies, platforms, and approaches best suited to each organization's needs.Alongside these engagements, you will have opportunities to contribute to VisFlow Runa, bringing practical enterprise experience into our product development and exploring its application where relevant.Your responsibilities include:    Design and govern enterprise information models, conceptual models, ontologies, and knowledge graphs.    Establish semantic and context layers connecting business concepts, metadata, and technical data structures.    Support enterprise transformation towards AI-ready Data & Information Management.    Develop practical Data Governance frameworks, standards, and information management principles.    Improve Data Quality, Metadata Management, Master Data Management (MDM), and information interoperability.    Apply semantic technologies and knowledge representation approaches to complex enterprise challenges.    Collaborate with business, IT, architecture, and AI teams to implement sustainable information management capabilities.    Contribute expertise and practical insights to the development and application of VisFlow Runa's ontology management and Knowledge Graph capabilities.Your ProfileWe are looking for experienced, pragmatic, and hands-on professionals who combine architectural expertise with an understanding of business needs and enterprise transformation.Ideally, you have:    7+ years of experience in Information Management, Data Management, Information Architecture, or related fields.    Experience supporting enterprise-wide Data & Information Management initiatives and transformations.    Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM, and Metadata Management.    Experience with enterprise information modelling, ontologies, semantic architecture, or knowledge graphs.    Knowledge of semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL.    Understanding of AI-ready data foundations, knowledge representation, and contextualized information.    Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.    A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree.    Fluent professional English. Swedish is advantageous.    Experience with Knowledge Graph platforms such as GraphDB, Stardog, Neo4j, or Apache Jena, as well as GraphRAG and knowledge-driven AI applications, is considered advantageous.Why Join Multiply?    Work on challenging enterprise Data & Information Management and AI-readiness initiatives.    Combine customer-facing consulting with opportunities to contribute to our own technology development.    Help shape VisFlow Runa's evolution in ontology management, semantic architecture, and knowledge graphs.    Work with different technologies and architectural approaches across complex enterprise environments.    Collaborate with specialists in Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Software Development, and AI.    Influence how organizations connect, understand, govern, and utilize enterprise knowledge.Location & EmploymentLocation: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö AreaEmployment: Permanent, full-time position with Multiply Teknik & IT AB.Working arrangement: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö AreaStart: As soon as possible. Candidates available immediately or within 1–2 months are particularly welcome.Join UsAre you passionate about Information Architecture, Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs, and building AI-ready enterprise information foundations?Join Multiply, contribute to meaningful enterprise transformation initiatives, and help us advance the future of knowledge management through VisFlow Runa.www.multiply.tech | www.visflow.io

title: Senior Process Specialist - Accounts Payable & SAP, Solna
description: Are you an experienced Accounts Payable professional with deep SAP expertise and a passion for process excellence? Do you enjoy combining operational expertise with process development and continuous improvement in a Nordic organization?At PostNord, we are looking for a Senior Process Specialist to join our Purchase to Pay team. This is a key role for an AP and SAP expert who will act as the go-to person for the business and our outsourcing partner, ensuring stable operations while driving continuous improvements across our Nordic finance organization.You, Us & The JobPostNord is an important and sustainable part of society. We are proud of our expertise and our ability to drive development across the Nordic region. As a Senior Process Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence within Purchase to Pay and Accounts Payable.You will join our Shared Service Finance Unit and work closely with stakeholders across the Nordic organization as well as our outsourcing partner. The role requires a combination of deep process knowledge, SAP expertise, stakeholder management, and a continuous improvement mindset. You will help shape and develop Accounts Payable processes while ensuring efficient and compliant operations.What will you do?In the role of Senior Process Specialist, Accounts Payable & SAP, you will be the subject matter expert for Accounts Payable and SAP within the Purchase to Pay area. You will own and develop AP processes end-to-end, support stakeholders across the business operationally, and act as the primary point of contact for our outsourcing partner.You will ensure stable operations while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, standardization, and automation across Accounts Payable. Your tasks will include:    Acting as the AP and SAP subject matter expert across PostNord within our Shared Service Finance Unit    Serving as the main point of contact and trusted advisor for the business and outsourcing partner on AP processes and SAP-related matters    Driving process improvements, standardization, and automation initiatives across Accounts Payable    Ensuring high-quality, efficient, and compliant AP processes    Supporting SAP enhancements, implementation activities, and issue resolution    Monitoring process performance and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality    Maintaining process documentation, controls, and governance frameworks    Supporting finance transformation and continuous improvement initiatives    Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the Nordic organization and external partnersWho are we looking for?You are a highly experienced Accounts Payable professional who understands end-to-end AP processes and enjoys solving complex operational and process-related challenges hands-on. You are recognized as a trusted expert and are comfortable advising stakeholders, driving improvements, and translating business needs into efficient solutions.Development and continuous learning are important to you. You take ownership of your work, drive initiatives forward, and collaborate effectively across teams and organizations. You are service-minded, proactive, and committed to delivering high-quality results.Your experience    5+ years of experience within Accounts Payable, Shared Services, or Finance Operations.    Deep expertise in Accounts Payable processes and a strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay related processes.    Extensive hands-on SAP (Fiori) experience within AP processes.    Experience working closely with outsourced service providers.    Proven track record of driving process improvements and standardization.    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.    Solid understanding of financial controls and compliance requirements.    Professional proficiency in English; proficiency in the Nordic languages is a plus.    5+ years of experience within Accounts Payable, Shared Services, or Finance Operations.We offer youWe are a modern, customer-oriented company that cares as much about our employees as we do about our customers. With us, you will be offered a varied role in an international environment with ongoing transformation, development opportunities, and close collaboration across the Nordic organization.In addition to fair employment conditions according to collective agreements, we offer:    Flexible hybrid workplace. Watch the film about our office.    Great insurance and occupational pension terms.    Wellness allowance and access to health-promoting benefits.    Employee benefits through PostNord Plus - PostNord´s own personnel foundation.    The opportunity to play a key role in shaping and improving Accounts Payable processes across the Nordic organization.About usWe move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
description: TL;DR – We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help scale the future of AI-powered software creation. You'll build and lead the FDE team and partner with our most ambitious customers to turn ideas into real products. This is still a hands-on role: you'll design, write, and ship production code alongside your team, while partnering with our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. It's a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems that no one has solved before.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.About the roleMost engineering leadership roles move you away from the code. This one keeps you close to the craft and the customer.You'll build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who partner with our customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving hard technical problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn't just to make individual deployments succeed. It's to spot what should become part of the Lovable platform and act on it.As one of a small group of FDE leaders, you'll set the technical bar for the function and help define how it scales, from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it works with customers and our core product teams.If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself, this is that role.What we're looking for    12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering        Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams    A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown    Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development    Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems    Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end    Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users    Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior stakeholders    Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and velocityBonus if you've:    Scaled a team or technical function from zero        Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production    Led zero-to-one product development    Worked in a founding or early startup environment    Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AIWhat you'll do    Build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers        Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems    Design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team    Own and guide projects end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration    Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering    Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements    Partner with other FDE leads to shape the function's engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks as it scales globally    Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundationsOur Tech Stack    Backend: Golang & Rust        Frontend: React, TypeScript    Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers    Tooling: GitHub Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and moreAbout your application    Please submit your application in English - it's our company language        We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Software Developer, C++
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Would you like to develop software that moves beyond the screen and into real mining machines? Join a highly experienced team in Örebro and work close to both the code and the hardware behind advanced video and remote-control solutions. Join our teamWe are looking for a Software Developer to join a five-person team developing video software for Epiroc machines. The team combines deep technical experience with a collaborative way of working, giving you strong support while also creating room to contribute with new ideas.The solutions include camera systems such as surround-view functionality as well as base-system software for connected remote-control panels. You will work in an environment where the distance between software and hardware is short, and where developers can test their solutions in the lab and, at times, in mining environments. Your missionAs a Software Developer, you will design, build and improve software used in Epiroc equipment for the mining industry. Your main focus will be C++ development for video systems, with some work connected to remote machine control. You will collaborate closely with other developers and contribute throughout the development cycle, from design and code review to testing and integration.Design and develop robust software, primarily in C++.Collaborate with experienced developers through technical discussions, reviews and shared problem-solving.Test solutions in the target lab and, when relevant, on real machines.Contribute to integration testing and continuous improvement of the team’s products and ways of working. Profile description:Your profile You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable taking initiative. Because the role involves a broad and technically advanced product area, your motivation to build new knowledge is just as important as the number of years you have worked. You enjoy collaborating in a team, sharing ideas and turning complex challenges into practical solutions. We believe you have:     A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar field, or equivalent relevant experience.     Experience with C++ software development. Experience from embedded systems, Linux, robotics or video technology is an advantage.     A collaborative mindset and the ability to communicate and work effectively with others. Experience with Python, Pytest, Git, Azure or modern frontend frameworks such as React is beneficial. We welcome applications from both experienced developers and recent graduates who have strong technical foundations and the drive to grow into the role. Location and otherThis position is located in Örebro, Sweden. The role is daytime-based and requires a close connection to the team, the laboratory and the physical products. Why Epiroc?At Epiroc, you will work with high-technology solutions that have a clear connection to real equipment and real customer environments. You will be part of a flat and collaborative organization with short decision paths, while benefiting from the stability and opportunities of a global company. By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:     Global career opportunities     Learning & Development programs     Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)     Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being     Global Parental Leave Policy     Community involvement Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 4, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date.We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience. For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager: Mikael Hallgren, Team Manager / Team Product Owner, mikael.hallgren@epiroc.com Recruitment Specialist: Susanne Kjellman, susanne.kjellman@external.epiroc.com Please note that, due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received by email.

title: Product Manager at Fergas
description: Fergas is looking for a Global Product Manager who wants to help develop the products of the future and create value for customers around the world.In this role, you will work closely with customers, sales, engineering and production to ensure that market needs are translated into competitive products. You will be responsible for driving product development throughout the full lifecycle, from customer needs and business opportunities to development, launch and continuous improvement.The role combines strategic product work with hands-on involvement in customer dialogues and development projects. title: Software Test Engineer
description: About Us Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on. Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development. We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries. About the RoleAs a Software Test Engineer, your primary focus will be on test execution and test automation. You will design, implement, and evolve testing strategies that ensure product quality from early development to release. You will work closely with development teams to improve testability, identify risks early, and build confidence in every release through effective automation and integration testing.You will act as a quality advocate across teams, supporting engineers with best practices, tools, and frameworks while helping shift testing efforts toward scalable, automated solutions.What You'll Do    Perform and contribute to release testing, verifying end‑to‑end functionality and validating that releases meet agreed‑upon quality criteria.    Design, develop, and execute high‑quality test plans and test cases for both manual and automated testing, with strong emphasis on testing across components and services.    Build, maintain, and continuously improve test automation frameworks and contribute to automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.    Supporting development teams in adopting effective testing strategies, including unit and integration testing.    Identifying risks, defects, and quality gaps early, and communicating them clearly to stakeholders.    Collaborating in planning, design, and requirement discussions to ensure quality is built into solutions from the start.    Improving test frameworks, documentation, and processes to enhance long-term efficiency and reliability.    Supporting troubleshooting, debugging, and incident analysis across development and release cycles.What You Bring to the TableYou are a collaborative and quality-driven engineer who works closely with developers and stakeholders to improve outcomes, not just processes. You proactively communicate, share knowledge, and help teams adopt practical and effective testing approaches.You take a holistic view of quality, focusing on integration, system behavior, and real-world usage rather than isolated test cases. You are pragmatic, continuously improving systems step by step instead of waiting for perfect solutions.    Experience in software testing with a strong focus on integration testing and automation.    Hands-on experience with Python and/or Ruby for test automation.    Familiarity with test frameworks such as Pytest, Squish, or similar tools.    Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) and development tools like GitLab, Jira, or Artifactory.    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify risks and dependencies early.    Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and influence quality practices.    Conversational Swedish and fluency in English, both spoken and written.Bonus Points For....    Experience testing C++ software and understanding of C++ code.    Familiarity with embedded systems, compilers, or tool chains.    Experience with build systems such as CMake.Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters. We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.     Flexibility You Can Count On     We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.     Meaningful Wellbeing Support     From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.     Opportunities to Grow     Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.     Inclusive by Design     You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.     Rewarding Your Impact     Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are. Bring Your Whole Self The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference. We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.

title: Application & Physics Specialist
description: RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia &amp; New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.Clinical experience as a medical physicist, dosimetrist, radiation therapist or treatment planner and ready for a new challenge? Or just graduated and looking for your first job to use your new skills? Join RaySearch in Stockholm and help us help clinics improve their treatments with innovative medical technology software!Location: Stockholm, SwedenWe prefer a candidate who can work from our headquarters in Stockholm. For a strong candidate we are however willing to consider work from a home office in Denmark, Norway or Finland.About the positionAs an Application & Physics Specialist you will join a diverse and dedicated specialist group with clinical experience from different countries. The group is part of the global service organization responsible for the promotion, deployment and support of our products as well as the education of our customers.  The emphasis of the position will be on working with potential and current customers in the Nordic region to introduce them to our treatment planning system RayStation through demonstrations and training. This is done on client sites, in our training center in Stockholm, by webinars and at conferences. Another core task is creating and maintaining training materials on various formats such as interactive e-learning courses, PPT presentations and videos for students.For a candidate with medical physics competence, you will also play an important role in assisting our customers during the beam commissioning process, for example by creating beam models and advising them on measurement requirements.Up to 25% travel is required, primarily within the Nordic region and Europe.Your main tasks    Planning, performing and documenting product trainings for customers and distributors    Demonstrating RaySearch products at trade shows and onsite for prospective customers    Develop and maintain training materials    Answering tenders and explain product functionality    Collaborating with our development department through exploratory testing of new product versions     Assisting and guiding customers during the beam commissioning processYour introductionWhen starting in this position, you will get a mentor and a solid introduction to our products and ways of working following a formal certification program. You will gradually take more responsibility and start working independently.Your profileWe believe that our new Application & Physics Specialist has a great sense for service and customer support and a strong motivation to work in a highly dynamic environment. You are a social and positive person with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy presenting and teaching to bigger and smaller crowds. Further, you can quickly adapt to new contexts and appreciate various environments as well as a variety of different tasks.  You enjoy facing new challenges and solving complex problems, both independently and in collaboration with your team members. You are comfortable with working proactively, taking initiatives and have the ability to prioritize your work and adapt to sudden changes. Experience & skills    Proficiency in spoken and written English    Swedish/Danish/Norwegian/Finnish skills are meriting    BSc or MSc degree in medical physics/dosimetry/RTT or equivalent, medical physics is meriting    Clinical experience in radiotherapy, especially proton therapy or brachytherapy, is meriting    Ability to travel up to 25%     Medical device industry experience is meritingOur cultureCulture at RaySearch is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.Our offerAt RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.ApplicationPlease apply through the application form below. The selection and interviewing process will be ongoing. We do not accept applications by e-mail.

description: About the jobAs our Finance Systems Business Analyst, you will be the functional expert for CCH Tagetik within Corporate Finance. CCH Tagetik is Alfa Laval's strategic Corporate Performance Management platform for Corporate Finance. It supports how financial information is planned, reported, controlled and governed across the Group. Your scope spans the full breadth of the Corporate Finance capability area at a group wide level, including how financial information is planned, reported, controlled and governed, as well as how Treasury and Tax are supported in our systems. You play a central role in making sure the platform truly serves these needs.  Key responsibilities     Act as system owner and subject matter expert for our Corporate Performance Management platform (CCH Tagetik)     Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, understanding their needs and advising on how this can and should work in the platform, including which data flows and setups are appropriate     Own the functional Finance perspective in discussions with the Product Owner, Solution Architect, IT teams and implementation partners.     Provide Finance expertise to the Solution Architect on business rules, data requirements and how processes should work, while ensuring that proposed solutions fit the overall architecture.     Manage master data, system controls, and user access     Act as the first point of contact for users, providing training, guidance and ongoing support     Stay close to the platform's roadmap and new features, keeping ahead of changes and guiding others through them     Perform advanced support, maintenance and administration within your area of expertise     Contribute to project activities and smaller deliveries, depending on experience, in collaboration with the Product Owner and Solution Architect     Analyze, configure, test and deploy changes to optimize existing solutions, meeting agreed time, cost and quality requirements   Who are youYou are curious, structured and comfortable working between Finance and IT. You enjoy turning business needs into practical solutions and are confident challenging unclear requirements in a constructive way. You are collaborative rather than directive, and you bring people together through open dialogue, clear explanations and sound judgement. You are also patient and service-minded when supporting users, while being proactive enough to identify improvements and take ownership of issues through to resolution. What you knowTo be successful in this role, you combine a strong understanding of Corporate Finance with an interest in business systems and digital transformation. We believe our ideal candidate has:     Solid understanding of Corporate Finance processes, rules and terminology at a group-wide level.     Knowledge of Treasury and Tax processes and how they may be supported through finance systems.     Experience translating business needs and financial logic into functional system requirements.     Ability to explain complex financial concepts to non-expert technical and IT teams, and translate technical concepts into clear business language.     Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.     Experience with CCH Tagetik is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important qualities are your Finance knowledge, motivation and ability to build deep platform expertise quickly.     Experience from an international environment or a larger global company is beneficial, as is familiarity with complex, group-wide processes.     Relevant university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related field. title: Price Management Analyst
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too  About the job As a Price Management Analyst, you will help ensure that our global service rates are accurate, competitive, and aligned with business goals. You will maintain and develop relevant information, support commercial decisions, and contribute to consistent practices across the aftermarket organization. This role offers the opportunity to work with data, processes, and stakeholders across the business, while contributing directly to profitability and customer value.  Key responsibilities     Maintain and develop global cost rate structures, models, and guidelines.     Conduct regular reviews based on costs, market conditions, and profitability.     Ensure consistency across the aftermarket product and service lifecycle.     Monitor commercial performance and identify opportunities for improvement.     Provide analysis, insights, and operational support to relevant stakeholders.     Collaborate with teams across the organization to improve data quality and processes.  What you know     A relevant university degree or equivalent experience in pricing, business analysis, finance, commercial operations or a related field.     Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data and translate it into clear recommendations.     Good understanding of pricing principles, profitability, and cost structures.     Experience working with Excel and data analysis tools; familiarity with ERP or pricing systems is an advantage.     Ability to manage details accurately and work with structured processes.     Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal.  Who you are     Analytical, structured, and curious mindset.     Strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering results.     Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.     Clear communication skills and a talent for building positive stakeholder relationships.     Enthusiasm for improving processes and finding practical solutions.     Motivation to create value for customers and businesses.  For more information, please contact Bjarne Lorenzen, Manager, Service Technology & Business Operations,  Regina García Moguel, Talent Acquisition Partner,   Union information Axel Schäring, Akademikerna,  Anders Jansson, Unionen,    Please send your application no later than 8th of November 2026. We are conducting a continuous review of the received applications. We do not accept applications via email; they will be deleted, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).  We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this, we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the preemployment process.   #LI-RG1

title: Head of Finance HAL
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Head of Finance HallsbergAs Head of Finance Hallsberg, you will manage and develop the site’s Finance team and take full responsibility for the financial agenda of our operations.This is a senior role in which you will act as a trusted business partner to the site organization. Combining strong financial expertise with a deep understanding of manufacturing, you will provide insights that support both strategic direction and operational priorities.You will play a key role in driving profitability and business performance through financial planning, forecasting, cost management, investment analysis, business cases and structured performance management. Working close to the operations, you will translate financial data into clear priorities and actions that create long-term value.You and your team will support the site’s strategy deployment and continuous improvement journey, ensuring that financial objectives and operational priorities are connected throughout the organization. Financial insights will be an important enabler for productivity, cost competitiveness, efficient resource utilization and sound investment decisions.Reporting to the Head of Operations & Site Hallsberg. Laila Österholm, you will be a member of the site management team and contribute to Volvo CE’s strategy, Building Tomorrow Together.Who are you?We are looking for a business- and people-focused finance colleague with a passion for manufacturing, performance improvement and sustainable value creation.You understand how financial performance is created in daily operations and how Finance can help turn strategy into measurable results. You are comfortable moving between strategic perspectives and operational details, partnering with senior leaders while remaining close to the business and the shop floor.You build trust through financial expertise, sound judgement and integrity. You communicate complex financial matters in a clear and accessible way and contribute perspectives that help the organization make informed decisions and continuously improve.As Head of Finance, you create clarity, engagement and shared accountability. You enjoy developing people, strengthening team capabilities and building an inclusive environment where different perspectives contribute to better collaboration and stronger results.Beyond the local site responsibility, you will be an active contributor to Volvo CE's global Finance network. Through close collaboration with Finance colleagues and business leaders across regions and functions, you will help drive common priorities, exchange knowledge and contribute to the continued development of our Finance organizationTo succeed in this role, we believe you have:    A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or equivalent    Relevant experience from finance, controlling or business-partnering roles, including experience working in complex business environments.    Experience of leading people, including a demonstrated ability to develop individuals and teams    Experience of manufacturing, industrial operations or a similarly complex business environment    Solid competence in financial planning, forecasting, costing, investment analysis and performance management    A good understanding of operational drivers, profitability and value creation    Experience from Lean, operational excellence, strategy deployment or continuous improvement    The ability to influence and support decision-making at senior management level    The ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively in a global, matrix organization, creating value through networks and cross-functional partnerships    Good communication and collaboration skills    Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and writtenAre we a perfect match?At Volvo CE, we believe that diverse perspectives and inclusive teams create better business results. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and ways of thinking.We cannot promise you an effortless job, but we can promise talented colleagues, meaningful business impact and exciting challenges.This is an opportunity to shape the financial agenda of Hallsberg and make a visible contribution to the site’s long-term success. You will work at the intersection of Finance, Operations and people leadership, supporting commitments that strengthen profitability, operational performance and sustainable development.You will become part of a global organization with strong opportunities for professional and personal growth, while remaining close to the daily operations where results are created.We welcome your application!Location: Hallsberg, Sweden, onsiteLast day to apply: 2026-11-10For more information, please contact:Hiring Manager: Laila Österholm, Laila.osterholm@volvo.comWe value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

title: Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
description: Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost CompetitivenessAbout the roleWe are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness to lead and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.This role combines people leadership, program execution, and cost competitiveness. You will ensure that key development, industrialization, improvement, and transformation initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong execution, and measurable business impact.A central part of the role is driving our Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) agenda, identifying and implementing opportunities to reduce product and manufacturing costs while maintaining or improving quality, reliability, and customer value.You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, and Finance to turn business priorities into successful programs and projects.Key responsibilitiesLead the Program & Project Management organization    Lead, coach, and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.    Establish effective ways of working, governance, and project management standards.    Ensure projects are prioritized, resourced, and executed according to business needs.    Support teams in managing risks, resolving issues, and improving project performance.    Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.Program Management & Strategic Execution    Translate business strategy into executable programs and projects.    Maintain program and project roadmaps and manage priorities and dependencies.    Ensure projects are aligned with strategic and financial objectives.    Monitor progress, risks, resources, costs, and expected benefits.    Provide transparent reporting and facilitate timely decision-making.Drive VAVE & Cost Competitiveness    Establish and lead a structured VAVE process across products and manufacturing.    Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities with measurable business impact.    Lead cross-functional workshops and initiatives involving Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, and Finance.    Drive Design-to-Cost and Design-for-Manufacturing activities.    Build and maintain a pipeline of cost-saving initiatives and ensure benefits are tracked and realized.    Verify savings together with Finance while safeguarding quality, reliability, and customer requirements.Cross-functional Leadership    Build strong collaboration across functions.    Drive fact-based decision-making and root-cause problem solving.    Challenge existing solutions and encourage continuous improvement.    Ensure focus on speed, simplicity, and execution.Hands-on LeadershipWhile primarily a leadership role, you will also take personal ownership of selected strategic and complex initiatives, including major transformation programs and critical VAVE projects.Leadership expectationsWe are looking for a leader who:    Takes ownership and delivers results.    Creates momentum and drives execution.    Makes decisions based on facts and business priorities.    Holds teams accountable while building trust and engagement.    Communicates clearly and effectively across the organization.    Leads through influence and develops people and capabilities.Success in the role requires the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.QualificationsRequired    Several years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related industrial environment.    Proven track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives.    Experience managing and developing people.    Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies.    Experience with cost-reduction, VAVE, Design-to-Cost, or similar initiatives.    Strong business and financial understanding.    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.    Fluent in Swedish and English.Preferred    Experience from manufacturing industries.    Engineering or technical university degree.    Experience with product development and industrialization.    Knowledge of Lean, continuous improvement, or operational excellence.    Experience with manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing/Assembly.    Familiarity with ERP, PLM, MES, or project management systems.    Project or Program Management certification.Personal profileYou combine strong leadership capability, technical understanding, and business acumen. You are:    Results-oriented and structured.    Hands-on and action-focused.    Commercially minded and analytical.    Collaborative and influential.    Confident in challenging the status quo.    Decisive and comfortable driving change.Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality and are motivated by turning opportunities into measurable business results.Our missionLead people, programs, and projects that transform business priorities into measurable results while continuously improving the competitiveness and profitability of our products and operations through VAVE.

title: Analysis Engineer to Beyond Gravity Linköping
description: 🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​ About Beyond GravityBeyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com Your crewYou will become part of the Dispenser organization. Today, we are a team of approximately 60 people with diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise, such as Design Engineer, System Engineer, Analysis Engineer, and Verification and Test Engineer. Together, we form a strong team with a great passion for technology – we are responsible for the development, design, structural analysis, and testing of our products. Alongside us, you will help transform and refine our ways of working within an innovative industry full of endless improvement opportunities. We are currently in an exciting transformation where we are growing a Tech Hub in Portugal and you will become part of a dedicated team with the ambition to revolutionize space! Your mission •  Perform structural analyses by independently conducting static strength and dynamic simulations with minimal supervision, applying relevant industry standards and engineering best practices.•  Execute engineering calculations using hand methods to size components and validate or cross-check numerical analysis results.•  Conduct advanced CAE simulations by performing finite element analysis (FEA) on complex systems and multi-physics problems, defining effective modeling strategies, and balancing accuracy with computational efficiency.•  Develop and enhance analysis tools by designing automation frameworks and leading the creation of custom solutions for model setup, simulation execution, and result interpretation.•  Collaborate across disciplines by integrating inputs from various engineering domains into structural analyses and working closely with subject matter experts to ensure consistency and accuracy.•  Support testing activities by contributing to test planning, predicting structural behavior, assisting with sensor placement and load case definition, and correlating simulation results with physical test data.•  Provide production and quality support by participating in Non-Conformance Review Boards (NRBs), proposing technical solutions, supporting root cause analysis, and contributing to First Article Inspections (FAI) and operator training when required.•  Prepare technical documentation and reports by independently producing high-quality deliverables, maintaining traceability between requirements and outputs, and clearly communicating project status to stakeholders.•  Drive problem-solving and decision-making by applying structured methodologies, evaluating evidence, identifying biases, and making sound technical decisions while considering cost, schedule, and business constraints.•  Contribute to innovation and R&D by gathering and interpreting data, participating in brainstorming sessions, applying research methodologies, and leveraging lessons learned to improve engineering solutions.•  Support business development activities by contributing technical inputs to bids, proposals, Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), and Contract Change Notices (CCNs).•  Mentor and support team development by assisting in training material creation, coaching junior engineers and interns, and supporting onboarding activities.•  Manage tasks and project progress by tracking budgets and milestones, identifying risks and blockers, and ensuring efficient allocation of resources.•  Support product development and lifecycle activities by maintaining knowledge of the product portfolio, interacting with hardware, and contributing to continuous product improvement initiatives. Your story Must’s:•  B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical or other engineering, or equivalent experience.•  3+ years of analysis experience in aerospace or equivalent industry.•  Proficiency in FEA tools and standard analysis workflows (MSC Nastran, Hyperworks, NX, Abaqus).•  Experience in linear static and dynamic analysis.•  Experience in writing technical documentation.•  Basic scripting (Python/VBA) for analysis automation. Nice to have’s:•  Knowledge of detailed stress analysis using aerospace methodologies.•  Knowledge of mechanical layout of aerospace structures and materials.•  Familiarity with nonlinear analysis. Why Beyond Gravity •  To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.•  You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!•  We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!•  Overtime and travel compensation and you have the right to 25 days of vacation/year.•  Wellness allowance of 3000 SEK/year via the benefits portal Epassi.•  Lunch subsidy via Edenred, which means you are offered a card loaded with 1520 SEK/month 🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. Propel your career to new heights by applying before 30/06/2026. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​​Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​

title: Senior Data Center Technician
description: OverviewAs a Senior Data Center Technician (SDCT) at Microsoft, you will support the deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and decommissioning of critical IT infrastructure within our datacenters. You will apply your technical expertise across server and network hardware, diagnose complex issues, and ensure work is completed safely and to required quality standards.As a senior member of the team, you will also provide technical guidance, coaching, and on-the-job training to other technicians, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team powers the infrastructure behind services including Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. Our global datacenter organization operates at significant scale, supporting more than one billion customers and millions of businesses worldwide.At Microsoft, we work with a growth mindset, collaborate to achieve shared goals, and are committed to our mission of empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.Responsibilities    Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve hardware, server, and network-related issues.    Install, deploy, replace, and decommission datacenter hardware in accordance with documented procedures and standards.    Perform and support complex infrastructure changes, including rack-level hardware upgrades and decommissions.    Provide technical guidance to technicians during hardware preparation, staging, installation, startup, shutdown, and replacement activities.    Coordinate planned work and downtime with relevant stakeholders to ensure quality execution and minimise operational impact.    Assist technicians with complex technical tasks and escalate issues when required.    Complete and oversee post-execution quality checks, ensuring grounding, cabling, staging, and labelling meet deployment and safety standards.    Ensure appropriate security processes are followed when decommissioning equipment and handling data-bearing devices.    Monitor operational performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and performance reviews.    Train, coach, and mentor technicians through on-the-job training and practical technical guidance.    Participate in and support daily safety briefings and required safety training.    Promote compliance with safety procedures including PPE, equipment operation, lifting, electrical safety, and ladder or rolling stair use.    Identify opportunities to improve technical processes, procedures, service quality, and operational efficiency.    Demonstrate accountability for the quality, completeness, and reliability of work delivered.    Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of your work.Required Qualifications    High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.    Knowledge of computer hardware, servers, networking equipment, and related components.    Experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, or deploying IT equipment or related technology.    Ability to follow technical procedures and operate safely within a datacenter or similarly controlled environment.    Strong troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.Preferred Qualifications    Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Experience supporting IT infrastructure, server hardware, networking equipment, or related technology.    Experience working in a production or mission-critical 24x7x365 datacenter environment.    Experience coaching, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other technicians.    Relevant technical certifications such as CompTIA A+, Server+, Network+, Basic Structured Cabling (BSC), Data Center Foundation Certification (DCFC), Microsoft certifications, or vendor-specific networking certifications.Background Check RequirementsAbility to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role.This position requires successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Service Manager Zinkgruvan
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Servicechef till Zinkgruvan Är du en trygg, närvarande och coachande ledare som trivs med att leda en etablerad verksamhet? Vi söker nu en Servicechef till vår serviceverksamhet i Zinkgruvan – en roll för dig som vill förvalta, skapa stabilitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer med både medarbetare och kund. Här blir du en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten, nära både människor och maskiner, i en miljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och kontinuitet är avgörande. Ditt uppdrag Som Servicechef i Zinkgruvan har du det övergripande ansvaret för den lokala serviceverksamheten. Du leder och planerar arbetet för servicetekniker, administrativ/lagerfunktion samt supervisor och säkerställer att verksamheten fungerar stabilt och effektivt över tid. Rollen är operativ och närvarande, med stor del av arbetet kopplat till den dagliga driften och kundkontakten. Fokus ligger på att förvalta befintliga arbetssätt, säkerställa god leverans och skapa en trygg och välfungerande arbetsmiljö. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden: •    Planera, leda och fördela arbetet i den lokala personalstyrkan.•    Vara en närvarande chef som stöttar, coachar och skapar struktur i vardagen.•    Säkerställa ett gott säkerhets-, arbetsmiljö- och förebyggande arbete.•    Vara kundens primära kontakt och bygga långsiktiga relationer.•    Ansvara för serviceverkstad, administration och lagerverksamhet.•    Ekonomiskt ansvar för verksamheten, inklusive budget, uppföljning och rapportering.•    Beräkna och lämna offerter vid behov.•    Arbeta för god samverkan med försäljningsorganisationen.•    Bibehålla och utveckla befintliga serviceavtal samt stötta lokal marknadsföring. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar. Är du den vi söker? Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av ledarskap från arbetsledande- eller chefsroller och har en god förståelse för vad som krävs för att driva en välfungerande serviceverksamhet. Du är praktisk, strukturerad och bekväm med att ta ansvar för både människor och resultat. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha: •    Tidigare erfarenhet av ledarskap med arbetsledande- och/eller personalansvar.•    Teknisk bakgrund eller starkt tekniskt intresse.•    Grundläggande kunskaper inom ekonomi, uppföljning och rapportering.•    God datorvana och erfarenhet av affärs-/ERP-system (gärna SAP).•    God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.•    B-körkort. Placering och resor Denna tjänst är placerad i Zinkgruvan. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten. Ansökan och kontaktinformation Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 10 november. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Lund
description: Mechanical Engineer with passion for product development!At Axis, our passion is to create a smarter and safer world! We have delivered several groundbreaking products and look forward to paving the way for many more. Come join our team and help us in finding smart solutions for fantastic products!We are now seeking a mechanical engineer to join our mechanics team within System Products at Axis HQ in Lund.System Products is responsible for developing a wide and exciting product portfolio, which includes body-worn cameras, video recorders, microphone products, video decoders, sirens, and other system accessories. Your future teamWe who work in your future team are passionate engineers who love technology and tough technical challenges. We highly value creativity, collaboration, and openness. You will be overwhelmed by your colleagues' helpfulness and their willingness to help you develop.We are multiple functions working together to develop, improve, and deliver world-class products! What you'll do here as a mechanical engineerAs a mechanical engineer on System products, you will work on product development in areas such as body-worn cameras, recorders, microphone products, and other system devices. Much of your daily work is in projects where the project team consists of different functions and competencies. The length of a project typically ranges from 6 months to 2 years. In the project, you work closely with electronics, firmware, and many other internal functions such as quality, testing, production, and purchasing. In the projects, you drive the mechanical development together with a few colleagues from concept study to mass production. These tasks include designing the product, creating prototypes, communicating with suppliers, verifying the product, and preparing the product for mass production. To optimize the production of the design, you also have close contact with our suppliers around the world. The portfolio includes both large and small projects, and several of the product types we develop are new to us, so unknown challenges and opportunities for variation are promised. In your work, you will also meet and work together with product managers, project leaders, line managers, and engineers from other departments and competencies. Who are you?We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with a positive mindset. You love challenges and working together with others. You are passionate about product development from the first idea to holding the product in your hand. You like to challenge old truths and develop new innovative products. You are considerate and value good communication. Finally, and most importantly, you love being part of a creative and happy team that delivers outstanding products!In our department, we work with both mechanical designs, electromechanics, and several different types of manufacturing methods. We would like you to have experience or a strong interest in some of these areas (new graduates are welcome to apply):     Knowledge of at least one 3D CAD system, preferably Creo.    Prototype creation    Mechanical engineering background    Windchill/Creo knowledge    Injection molding/diecast/sheet metal    Design for production    Product development in telecommunications (4G, 5G), Wi-Fi, or GPS    Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. What can Axis offer you?A fantastic team with colleagues who want to succeed together with you. We learn and develop through our work with product development, and we are not afraid to try new things. Internal courses and external education are part of your work life here. From your first day, you will have a mentor colleague who helps you and teaches you how we work at Axis. Axis also has an excellent introduction program for new employees. We strive to give each individual great personal responsibility and opportunity to grow both as a person and professionally. You become part of a well-functioning team with engaged people who like going to work in the morning. We want you to thrive with us. Therefore, we offer fantastic benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday coffee, company bonus, health insurance, paid vacation, generous parental leave, generous sick/accident insurance, and your very own Axis bike - just to mention a few. What Axis has to offerWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis  Ready to act?If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Engineering Manager Maiko Karlsson at phone number 046-272 1800.We review applications continuously, so don't wait to send in your application!

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: The OpportunityWe are looking for a motivated and skilled Mechanical Engineer to join our Local Product Support team for Live Tank Breakers. In this role, you will provide hands-on engineering expertise, contribute to product care activities, and support both internal and external stakeholders with technical solutions. You will work closely both with our teams in the factory and global product support to secure high-quality performance of our products.How You Will Make an Impact    Provide hands-on troubleshooting and technical investigations/testing for complex issues.    Drive mechanical product improvements to enhance performance, robustness, and manufacturability.    Create/maintain drawings and technical documentation (test instructions, procedures) to meet quality and compliance needs.    Collaborate with R&D, Global Product Support, factory teams, customers and suppliers to align, transfer knowledge, and deliver solutions.Your Background    Degree in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent experience).    Hands-on mechanical work experience; high-voltage equipment knowledge is a plus.    CAD proficiency (CREO or similar 3D tools) and ability to produce clear drawings/documentation.    Collaborative, proactive communicator, comfortable in cross-functional and international settings.    Structured, solution-oriented, and able to work both independently and in teams.    English proficiency and basic Swedish.More about usWe believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Why Doktor.seDoktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.What you'll doOur infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:    Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.    Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.    Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.    Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.    Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.    Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.    Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.    You will report to to, and work close with, our Head of Product and Technology. You will be the go to person in technical strategical questions and the technical sounding board — advising on complex technical decisions and translating product/business direction into what's actually feasible.Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.What we're looking for    You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.    You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.    You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.    You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.    You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.    You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.    University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.Tech stackCloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKSIaC - TerraformCI/CD - GitHub ActionsLanguages - Python, TypeScriptAI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)What we offer    Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.    Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.    Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.    Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.    AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.    Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.Practical details    Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.    Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.    Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.    Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.    Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.    Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technologyWe handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.
