description: - Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Pfäffikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Bezugspflege.### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Pfäffikon**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH**Fachbereich:** Bezugspflege**Pensum:** 80–100 %**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung**Arbeitsort:** Region Pfäffikon**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im GesprächKurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.Pfäffikon liegt strategisch günstig am Zürichsee und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist über die Bahn und mehrere Buslinien schnell erreichbar und ermöglicht Sie eine gute Verbindung zu anderen Wirtschaftszentren. Als Arbeitsort besticht die Gegend durch ihre attraktive Lage zwischen Natur und Stadt, wodurch Sie von Lebensqualität und modernen Infrastrukturen profitieren.### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Pfäffikon- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: BezugspflegeSie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Pfäffikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.**Inspired by Innovation**  At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.**An inclusive culture**  Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  **Health \& Wellbeing**  We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities\-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.**Pension Fund**  We offer above\-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.**Our Commitment**  Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Aufsicht und Weisungsrecht gegenüber der Polizei* Strafuntersuchungen (Fallmanagement) effektiv und effizient führen* Anklageerhebung und persönliche Anklagevertretung vor erstinstanzlichen Gerichten* Fachliche Führung, Instruktion und Kontrolle der Arbeitsergebnisse von Mitarbeitenden der Strafbefehlsabteilung* Strafbefehle, Einstellungs\-, Nichtanhandnahme\- und Sistierungsverfügungen erlassen* Einlegen von Rechtsmitteln* Allgemeine und persönliche Leistungsvorgaben innerhalb der Staatsanwaltschaft erfüllen* Regelmässiger Pikettdienst leisten **Ihr Profil*** Anwalts\- oder bernisches Notariatspatent* Qualifizierte Kenntnisse des Strafrechts und des Strafprozessrechts* Mehrjährige Tätigkeit in der Strafjustiz von Vorteil* Gutes Verständnis für Fallmanagement* Sicherheit in Schrift und Auftritt* Kommunikationsfähigkeit* Deutsche Muttersprache mit guten ösischkenntnissen (B1\) **Wir bieten Ihnen**Davon, dass der Kanton Bern ein in jeder Hinsicht fairer Arbeitgeber mit sehr guten Anstellungsbedingungen ist, dürfen Sie zu Recht ausgehen. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Kundenberater/in Ergänzungsleistungen (Zusatzleistungen) 80% - 100%--- Kundenberater/in Ergänzungsleistungen (Zusatzleistungen) 80% \- 100%=====================================================================Ihre Aufgabe ist anspruchsvoll und vielseitig.  Sie wünschen sich eine Stelle mit Verantwortung, ein dynamisches Umfeld, eine offene Feedback\-Kultur sowie Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten? Das ist okay, denn wir erwarten auch einiges von Ihnen. Aber erst einmal der Reihe nach:  Reicht eine AHV\- oder IV\-Rente zum Leben nicht, entstehen oft viele Fragen. Auf diese gibt niemand kompetenter und freundlicher Antwort als unsere Kundenberaterinnen und –berater. Die Auskünfte erfolgen meist auf telefonischem oder schriftlichem Weg.  Sie berechnen und verfügen Ergänzungsleistungen. Bei Ihren Entscheiden berücksichtigen Sie die verschiedenen Gesetzgebungen. Auch in anspruchsvollen Dossiers behalten Sie stets den Überblick. Bei Änderungen unternehmen Sie die richtigen Schritte. Bei aller Fachkompetenz agieren und kommunizieren Sie stets mit Einfühlungsvermögen, denn Sie wissen, dass Ihre Berechnungen Auswirkungen haben. In Ihrer Tätigkeit stossen Sie auch immer wieder auf komplexe juristische Fragen und nehmen zur Klärung Kontakt mit unserem Rechtsdienst auf. Sie arbeiten eng mit externen Stellen wie Gemeinden, Bezirksgerichten oder Konkursämtern zusammen.  Sie sehen es, Ihr Arbeitsalltag ist abwechslungsreich und anspruchsvoll zugleich. Aber diese Challenge suchen Sie ja genau, oder?  Sie überzeugen uns fachlich und menschlich.  Sie haben sich mit einer kaufmännischen Ausbildung (E\- oder M\-Profil) auf diese anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit vorbereitet. Alternativ verfügen Sie über eine qualifizierte kaufmännische Weiterbildung mit Handelsdiplom und Erfahrung im Versicherungswesen. Besonders beeindrucken können Sie uns mit einem Fachausweis im Bereich Sozialversicherungen oder mit der Bereitschaft, ihn zu erlangen. Arbeitserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen administrativen Tätigkeit wird Ihnen den Einstieg bei uns sehr erleichtern.  Neben Ihren fachlichen Qualifikationen verfügen Sie über eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit zu vernetztem Denken. Sie haben Freude an komplexen versicherungstechnischen Sachverhalten. Sie entscheiden gerne und kommunizieren klar. Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsraum ist ganz nach Ihren Geschmack und in konstruktivem Feedback sehen Sie die Chance zur Weiterentwicklung.  Wer viel mitbringt, darf auch viel erwarten.  Die SVA Zürich ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Sozialversicherungen. Sie gehört zu den Top\- Arbeitgebenden im Kanton und liegt in Fussdistanz zum Hauptbahnhof Zürich. Dass unsere rund 1200 Mitarbeitenden überdurchschnittlich zufrieden sind, hat gute Gründe: eine Tätigkeit, die Sinn macht, flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home\-Office, gute Sozialleistungen und eine wertschätzende Du\-Kultur. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Portfolio Manager--- Portfolio Manager=================**About Millennium**Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989\. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.Employer: MCP (Switzerland) GmbHTitle: Portfolio ManagerOffice Location: Zug, Switzerland **Meet the Team**We are seeking a Portfolio Manager to manage risk and generate returns while utilizing cutting\-edge machine learning and agentic AI solutions within our Quantitative Trading divisions. title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description: Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen alsInternistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.Zuständigkeiten / HauptaufgabenDie folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.- Umfassende Betreuung:Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. En tant que leader du numérique couvrant l'ensemble du domaine du diagnostic, les plus de 13'000 collaborateurs d'Unilabs dans le monde sauvent des vies chaque jour. Unilabs investit massivement dans la technologie, l'équipement et le personnel et utilise les technologies numériques de pointe dans ses laboratoires et instituts d'imagerie pour améliorer la vie de près de 100 millions de personnes chaque année.**Vos responsabilités**Vous aimez accompagner une équipe et rester proche du terrain ?  Unilabs recherche une ou un Team Leader à 80%, basé à Genève, pour encadrer son équipe d'infirmiers à domicile en Suisse romande, dès le 1er janvier 2027\.  Vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'organisation des tournées, la qualité des prélèvements et l'accompagnement des collaborateurs.**Compétences requises****Vos missions:**  Encadrer, motiver et accompagner l'équipe au quotidien.  Organiser les plannings et les tournées selon les besoins des patients et les disponibilités de l'équipe.  Accueillir les nouveaux collaborateurs et suivre leur intégration, leurs compétences et leurs besoins de formation.  Veiller au respect des procédures de prélèvement, des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité ainsi que des conditions de conservation des échantillons.  Assurer une coordination efficace avec la responsable, les laboratoires.  Suivre l'activité, identifier les difficultés et proposer des améliorations.  Veiller à la disponibilité du matériel et participer aux prélèvements à domicile selon les besoins.**Votre profil:**  Formation en soins infirmiers et expérience confirmée dans les prélèvements sanguins.  Une expérience à domicile et dans l'encadrement d'équipe constitue un atout.  Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les imprévus.  Maîtrise du français ; anglais souhaité**Vos qualités humaines sont essentielles:**  Nous recherchons une personne à l'écoute, bienveillante et fiable, capable de créer une relation de confiance avec les patients et les collaborateurs.  Vous savez fédérer une équipe, reconnaître les contributions de chacun et encourager l'entraide. Vous communiquez avec clarté et respect, donnez des retours constructifs et gérez les tensions avec calme et équité. Votre disponibilité et votre exemplarité font de vous un véritable soutien pour l'équipe.  **Envie de nous rejoindre ?**  Adressez\-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant votre motivation.  Lieu de travail : Genève, avec un périmètre d'activité en Suisse romande  Taux d'activité : 80%  Entrée en fonction : 1er janvier 2027**Nous offrons*** Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique, avec une dimension internationale* La possibilité de prendre des responsabilités et de développer votre potentiel* Une atmosphère de travail positive dans un cadre collaboratif et une culture d'entreprise pronant le respect et la reconnaissance* Des avantages sociaux attractifs, ainsi qu'une semaine de travail de 40 heures et 5 semaines de vacances par année* Un forfait annuel pour vos analyses personnelles et tarifs spéciaux pour les actes de radiologie effectués au sein du Groupe Unilabs**Contact**  Envoyer cette annonce à un amijpidafd84e3jm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

title: Middle School German  Teacher
employer: International School of the Basel Region AG
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Technicien·ne de maintenance à 100 %
======================================

*Depuis plus de 60 ans, nous nous engageons auprès des Organisations internationales en leur offrant des surfaces administratives et de conférences idéales. Expression concrète et active de la politique d’Etat hôte de la Confédération suisse et de celle du Canton de Genève, la Fondation des Immeubles pour les Organisations Internationales (FIPOI) propose une série de prestations destinées à faciliter l’implantation et les activités des organisations internationales qui s’installent à Genève. Pour les concevoir, les gérer et les entretenir dans le respect des plus hauts standards de qualité que nous nous fixons, nous pouvons compter sur les compétences et l’engagement d’une équipe performante d’une soixantaine de collaboratrices et collaborateurs.*

 

Afin de renforcer le secteur technique de notre Service Immobilier, nous recherchons :

 

### Un·e **Technicien·ne de maintenance à 100 %**

 

**Votre mission**

 

Basé\-e à proximité de la Place des Nations à Genève, vous travaillerez en lien direct avec le Chef d’Unité du secteur Technique, votre mission principale est d’assurer la maintenance technique des installations CVCSE du parc immobilier propriété de notre Fondation.

 

**Vos responsabilités**

* Effectuer la maintenance des installations CVC, sanitaires, éclairages, courant fort, courant faible ainsi que des systèmes de régulation numérique.
* Participer au suivi et au dépannage niveau 1 des installations de sécurité : contrôles d’accès, détection incendie, extinction automatique, énergies et éclairages de secours.
* Intervenir sereinement et efficacement sur des dépannages urgents, notamment sur des recherches de pannes dans des tableaux électriques de commande.
* Être force de proposition dans l’amélioration des installations et des équipements.
* Collaborer activement à la conduite de certains projets et assurer le suivi des interventions liées aux contrats de maintenance.
* Optimiser le fonctionnement des installations d’un point de vue énergétique.


 

**Votre profil**

* Formation dans le domaine électrique (CFC ou équivalent).
* Première expérience réussie dans la maintenance de bâtiments.
* Connaissance des systèmes d’automates programmables et de supervision MCR, GTC.
* Esprit d’analyse et solide maîtrise technique.
* Polyvalent·e, sérieux·se et autonome.
* De nature ouverte, vous échangez avec facilité et courtoisie dans l’objectif d’entretenir une relation orientée client.


 

**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Rejoindre la FIPOI, c’est intégrer une organisation au cœur de la Genève internationale, porteuse d’une mission d’intérêt public et évoluant dans un environnement multiculturel stimulant.

 

La FIPOI est certifiée Great Place to Work® depuis 2021, une reconnaissance qui reflète son engagement durable en faveur d’un climat de travail fondé sur la confiance, le respect, la collaboration et le développement des compétences.

 

Elle propose des conditions de travail attractives, un cadre professionnel stable et exigeant, ainsi que l’opportunité de s’inscrire dans un projet à long terme au service des organisations internationales établies à Genève.

 

**Candidature**

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description et que vous êtes prêt·e à relever ce défi avec engagement, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature via la plateforme JobUp. Nous vous garantissons une parfaite discrétion. Délai de candidature au 26 novembre 2026\.

title: Invigilator
description: Postulation : https://www.eteach.com/job/invigilator-1576140Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualifiedInvigilatorto join the school from: ASAPYour profileThe role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  About usLocated in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting. The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes. What we offerAiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.How to applyDeadline for applications: 02.11.2026Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered. Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.JOB PURPOSEThe role of the Invigilator is to play a crucial part in maintaining the integrity, confidentiality, and security of the assessment and examination process. The Invigilator ensures that all examinations are conducted strictly according to required regulations, providing all candidates with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their abilities while preventing candidate malpractice and administrative errors. The invigilator also adheres to the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures at all times. KEYS TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIESConduct examinations in strict adherence to the regulations and guidelines of Aiglon College and relevant exam boards (including SAT, CollegeBoard, IB, JCQ, Pearson and CIE).Ensure all candidates have an equal opportunity to demonstrate their abilities.Safeguard and ensure the security of examination materials before, during, and after each examination.Prevent potential candidate malpractice and administrative failures.Follow the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures at all times. Invigilators are required to:Declare if they have invigilated previously and whether they have any current invigilation maladministration/malpractice sanctions applied to them.Confirm their availability in advance of main examination periods.Ensure a strong understanding of current exam board regulations, guidelines, and confidentiality requirements by studying provided materials.Complete relevant invigilator training prior to examination periods or at the start of each academic year as directed.An ideal candidate will:Be reliable, flexible, and readily available during major exam periods.Have clear, authoritative, yet calm verbal skills along with effective communication, interpersonal, and teamworking skills.Be a confident, reassuring presence to candidates in examination rooms and effectively manage group situations.Possess basic IT skills (e.g., familiar with the use of email and mobile messaging).Seek to achieve competence in the role and a rigorous understanding of examination board regulations.Have attention to detail, strict adherence to compliance and seating protocol.Main duties in detail:Before examinationsReport to and be briefed by the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator prior to each exam session.Keep confidential examination question papers and materials secure.Ensure examination rooms are set up according to required arrangements.Admit candidates into examination rooms under formal examination conditions.Give full attention to conducting the examinations properly.Identify candidates and seat them according to seating plans.Distribute the correct question papers and examination materials to candidates.Instruct candidates on the conduct of their exams and deal with candidate questions.Start examinations on time.During examinationsSupervise and observe candidates at all times and be vigilant throughout examinations.Keep disruption in examination rooms to a minimum.Deal with emergencies or irregularities effectively.Record/report any incidents, disruption, or irregularities.Complete attendance registers.Record accurate start and finish times and track times updates.Deal with candidate questions according to the regulations. After examinationsInstruct candidates on finishing their examinations and collect all examination scripts in attendance register order.Dismiss candidates from the examination room.Check candidates' names on scripts and match details against the attendance register.Securely return all examination scripts and materials to the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator.OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIESSupervise candidates with exam timetable clashes between sessions as required.Provide support to candidates with access arrangements (e.g., reading, scribing), following provided training.Assist with exam-related administrative tasks, such as "second pair of eyes" security checks.Take part in invigilator trainingUndertake any other reasonable tasks required by the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator to support smooth exam operations.Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Wir suchen engagierte Talente, um gemeinsam die Welt voranzutreiben. **Diese Position berichtet an:**Power Systems Engineering Manager \_\_As a Project Engineer in Power Systems at ABB, a global leader in technology, electrification, automation, and digitalization, you will be part of a dynamic international project team, playing a crucial role in providing innovative technical solutions for our clients. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver integrated engineering solutions.* Ensure the integration of all engineering disciplines and efficient execution in line with contract specifications, quality and technical standards, safety requirements, and product compliance. This makes us the world’s leading provider of ground handling services and larger than any single airline. With around 63,000 highly qualified employees, we ensure that travel and trade run smoothly worldwide every day, while driving innovation in the aviation industry. Together, we are shaping the airport experience of the future. **We are looking for a**  **HEAD OF QUALITY, HEALTH, SAFETY \& ENVIRONMENT (M/W/D)**WORKLOAD \| 100%  LOCATION I GENEVA AIRPORT   **YOUR MISSION**  As Head of QHSE, you will act as a trusted partner to the Station Manager while championing a strong and sustainable culture of quality, health, safety, security and environmental responsibility at Swissport Geneva. title: Senior Primary Teacher for Innovative Private School in Zurich (Grades 1–3)
description: Teaching jobs like this don’t come around often. The chance to know each child deeply because class sizes are deliberately small, one teacher for every seven children. To reimagine education for a rapidly changing world. To work alongside a deeply passionate and high-performing team of educators. To let your creative ideas flow and actually bring them to life.Full job description here  here https://tinyurl.com/2c3crwud Role at a glance-Role:Senior Primary Teacher, grades 1–3- Location: Adliswil, Switzerland- Start date: August 2027, with the possibility of starting part-time earlier if available- Commitment:80–100% (additional part-time arrangements may also be possible)- Languages:Fluent English; German proficiency is a strong plus but not required- Experience: Substantial teaching experience, typically 7+ years- Compensation:Typically 15–25% higher than most Zurich private schools, with salaries benchmarked to the official Zurich public teacher scale.About UsAt Lumos School, we believe education should be both academically rigorous and joyful. We are a small, innovative German–English bilingual private school in Zürich, currently serving Grades 1–7 and growing towards Grade 9.Our exceptionally low student-to-teacher ratio of 1:7 allows us to provide personalized learning, individual coaching and meaningful relationships with every child.Our educational philosophy focuses on four principles: learning how to learn, combining challenge with enjoyment (“hard fun”), developing student independence and balancing academic mastery with exploration.We embrace hands-on projects, mixed-age learning, creativity and innovative teaching methods.The RoleWe are looking for an experienced, passionate and creative Senior Primary Teacher to join our Grades 1–3 team.You will take responsibility for curriculum planning, classroom teaching, assessment and student development while working collaboratively with another experienced teacher.We encourage our teachers to go beyond prescribed curricula, using their expertise and creativity to design engaging, meaningful learning experiences.You will play a particularly important role in developing English language and literacy, including phonics, reading, writing, vocabulary and communication skills, while supporting multilingual learners at different proficiency levels.Our two-teacher classroom model encourages shared planning, flexible responsibilities, constructive feedback and genuine collaboration.What We're Looking ForA teaching degree and typically 7+ years of classroom experience, preferably in Grades 1–3.Fluent English; German is a strong advantage but not required.Strong expertise in early primary education, literacy, phonics and numeracy.Experience in curriculum planning, assessment and differentiated instruction.Understanding of bilingual education and multilingual learners.Excellent classroom organization and management skills.Confidence working with mixed-age groups and personalized learning approaches.Experience with Montessori, project-based learning or other innovative educational methods is advantageous.Familiarity with Swiss Lehrplan 21 is helpful but not essential.Eligibility to work in Switzerland.Who You AreWe are looking for someone who genuinely loves teaching young children and understands their need for warmth, encouragement, structure, movement and play.You are confident, creative, organized and proactive. You enjoy taking responsibility but are equally comfortable sharing ideas, decisions and classroom ownership.You value collaboration, communicate clearly, welcome feedback and continuously seek ways to improve your teaching.Most importantly, you are excited about helping children reach their potential while contributing to a thoughtful, ambitious and growing school.What We OfferCompetitive salaries: Typically 15–25% above most Zürich private schools, benchmarked against the Zürich public teacher salary scale.16+ weeks of school holidays.Significant protected planning time.Relocation support where needed.Exceptionally low student-to-teacher ratio of 1:7.Professional autonomy and freedom to develop creative teaching approaches.Supportive leadership and highly experienced international colleagues.Engaged families who share our educational values.A collaborative, innovative and forward-thinking working environment.The opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape the future of our school.Join UsAt Lumos, we believe exceptional teachers make exceptional schools.We are looking for someone who sees teaching as more than a profession: someone who brings experience, imagination, warmth and genuine enthusiasm to the classroom.If you believe children learn best when they are inspired, challenged and supported, we would love to hear from you.

title: Junior Chief of Staff
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chief of Staff (a) (80-100%)--- Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)=============================**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.****Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.****Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als « Chief of Staff».****Deine Herausforderung**Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen*** Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- z.B. via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit den beiden Eigentümern und Co\-CEOs von Consult \& Pepper zusammen und erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie ein KMU geführt und weiterentwickelt wird.**  **Du wirst dabei nicht nur an konzeptionellen und strategischen Themen arbeiten. Zu einem KMU gehören genauso administrative Aufgaben und ganz pragmatische Probleme, die gelöst werden müssen. Genau diese Mischung macht die aus.****Möchtest du Unternehmertum nicht nur aus dem Studium kennen, sondern im Alltag erleben und mitgestalten?**Dann freuen sich  **und Saia** über deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder deinen Anruf (\+ ).![Consult &amp; Pepper AG]()* Consult \& Pepper AG  Löwenstrasse 9  6004 Luzern*jide43662cjm jit1044jm jiy26jm

The company languages are and English* Excellent, flexible working arrangements to enable professional development and personal life balance* An attractive working environment: modern infrastructure with wheelchair\-accessible rooms, small fitness room, underground car park, subsidised meals, free snacks and drinks, various company events, internal and external training, home office options, after\-work beers and other joint leisure activities  Support Team  The DECTRIS Support \& Commissioning Team is the interface between our products and the customers at the synchrotron, in the laboratory and in industry. We analyze and solve problems in soft\- and hardware, support our customers in the use of our high\-end detectors, train users and partners in the use and integration of our detector systems, and bring customer feedback about existing products to the company. To achieve this, we work closely with our subsidiaries, product management, application scientists, development, production and sales on an interdisciplinary basis. International Corporate Communications Project Leader
=====================================================

**The company**

Tissot has been growing and developing its tradition of innovation since 1853\. From the early days to the present, in its home in Le Locle in the Swiss Jura mountains, Tissot has translated craftsmanship and precision into stylish timepieces now sold in over 160 countries around the world. Special materials, advanced functionality and meticulous design details join forces to create the luxury of accessibility.

Today Tissot is a member of the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch producer and distributor of Swiss watches. The tradition of innovation lives on, keeping closely in touch with the times.

We are looking for a **Senior International Corporate Communications Project Leader** to join our international team based in Le Locle. The successful candidate will be part of the international PR team and report to the PR Manager.

**Job description**

In this role, you will take ownership of corporate communications, ensuring clear, consistent and impactful messaging across key audiences and channels. Working closely with senior leadership and internal stakeholders, you will support high\-profile communications opportunities and lead a range of corporate communications projects.

The role combines strong editorial skills, strategic awareness, discretion and the ability to build trusted relationships across the organisation and with external stakeholders.

**Your responsibilities**

* Own and coordinate corporate communications activities, ensuring consistency of messaging and corporate narrative.
* Support the PR Manager and senior leadership on corporate communications, media opportunities and high\-profile engagements.
* Develop and coordinate corporate communications materials and messaging across relevant channels, including digital and social media.
* Lead selected corporate communications projects from development through to execution.
* Build strong relationships with media, internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Support communications in sensitive or high\-pressure situations, ensuring clear and consistent messaging.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen corporate visibility, reputation and positioning.
* Monitor relevant media, corporate and industry developments and provide insights to inform communications.
* Contribute to the continuous development of corporate communications tools and practices.


**Profile**

* Excellent communicator with strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills
* Strategic, creative and curious, with a strong understanding of corporate reputation and communications
* Confident working with senior stakeholders and handling sensitive information with discretion
* Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trusted relationships across functions and markets
* Detail\-oriented, agile and solutions\-focused, with the ability to see the bigger picture
* A genuine sensitivity to brand image, corporate reputation and the luxury environment


**Professional requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an international environment
* Proven experience in corporate communications, editorial content and media relations
* Experience working with senior executives and supporting high\-profile communications
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills
* Experience in luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or premium consumer sectors is a plus
* Experience in digital and social communications is an advantage


**Languages**

* Fluent in English and French, both written and spoken, is a must
* German is an advantage
* Additional languages are a plus


**Company address**

Chemin des Tourelles 17 \- 2400 Le Locle



**Contact**

\-

2400 Le Locle

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.  At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and /.  Applications can be submitted until the position is filled and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.  For further information, please contact Mengqi Zhu or Dr Derlon.  We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.  Apply now  Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology jpid92ba563jm jit0731jm jiy26jm

title: Field System Engineer (X-ray Detectors)
description: DECTRIS is a successful and expanding high\-tech company that develops and produces X\-ray and electron detectors. Our detectors are used worldwide in large\-scale research facilities and in industry. Their unique properties enable scientific breakthroughs in life sciences and material sciences. Our more than 170 employees are located in Switzerland, the United States and Japan. At DECTRIS, we combine innovation and development with agile industry practices. As a spin\-off of the Paul Scherrer Institute and by focusing on the needs of our customers, we are able to combine scientific excellence with qualified service and industrial know\-how.  Our scientists as well as our technical and commercial experts ensure that our customers benefit from the latest technologies.  Your Tasks  * Provide advanced technical support for DECTRIS detector systems (remote and on\-site)* Analyze, debug, and fix complex software and hardware issues* Commission detector systems and provide integration support* Perform diagnostics and repairs at DECTRIS and at customer sites* Develop scripts, tools, and procedures to improve customer support* Clearly communicate technical topics to non\-experts and experts alike* Collaborate closely with R\&D, product management, applications, and sales* Willingness to travel internationally up to 20%Your Skills  * Bachelor, Master or PhD degree in engineering, computer or natural sciences, or equivalent years of experience in industry* Programming/scripting experience, mainly Python* Comfortable using Linux* Ability to train customers by breaking down the complexity of our systems into understandable concepts* Hands\-on, solution\-oriented mindset with no fear of unfamiliar systems* Comfortable working with tools, lab equipment, and real hardware* Logical and analytical problem solver who can also improvise when needed* Curious, fast learner who takes initiative and responsibility* Reliable team player who can work independently when required* Stress\-resistant, flexible, and comfortable in customer environments of different cultures* Fluent in English; German or Chinese is a plus* Driving license (B)We Offer  * A successful and growing high tech company in an international, scientific environment* To join the global leader in HPC X\-ray detectors for science and industry. Our Developers design cutting\-edge detectors to support the state of the art science and technology* An international work environment formed by more than 170 experienced engineers, scientists and other professionals. The company languages are German and English* Excellent, flexible working arrangements to enable professional development and personal life balance* An attractive working environment: modern infrastructure with wheelchair\-accessible rooms, small fitness room, underground car park, subsidised meals, free snacks and drinks, various company events, internal and external training, home office options, after\-work beers and other joint leisure activitiesSupport Team  The DECTRIS Support \& Commissioning Team is the interface between our products and the customers at the synchrotron, in the laboratory and in industry. We analyze and solve problems in soft\- and hardware, support our customers in the use of our high\-end detectors, train users and partners in the use and integration of our detector systems, and bring customer feedback about existing products to the company. To achieve this, we work closely with our subsidiaries, product management, application scientists, development, production and sales on an interdisciplinary basis.
